It can also cause health problems.
It improves concentration.
questions.explanation: 一日中立つのも脚や足に問題を起こすことがあると述べている。

questions.question: What do researchers recommend?
choices: Changing positions regularly.
Sitting for no more than four hours.
Using a standing desk all day.
Exercising before work.
questions.explanation: 定期的に姿勢を変えることを勧めている。

questions.question: What is one concern of the Swedish government?
choices: Some people may find digital payments difficult.
Shops are making too much profit.
Robbery has become more common.
Mobile apps are too expensive.
questions.explanation: 高齢者や地方の人がデジタル決済に苦労するかもしれないと懸念している。

questions.question: What does the law require major banks to do?
choices: Stop accepting coins.
Continue offering cash services.
Develop new payment apps.
Lower their fees.
questions.explanation: 大手銀行に現金サービスの提供を続けることを義務づけている。

questions.question: Why have self-driving buses been introduced in some rural towns?
choices: Residents asked for faster buses.
Roads in these towns are very wide.
There are not enough bus drivers.
Tourists want to try new technology.
questions.explanation: バス運転手の深刻な不足(shortage of bus drivers)があるため。

questions.question: What is one problem with the self-driving buses?
choices: They have trouble in heavy snow.
They are too fast for elderly people.
They often get lost.
Residents do not trust them.
questions.explanation: 大雪のときに走行が難しいことがあると述べられている。

questions.question: What did the study find?
choices: Bored people performed tasks more slowly.
Bored people later had more creative ideas.
Smartphones improve creativity.
Children get bored more easily than adults.
questions.explanation: 退屈な作業をした参加者のほうが後でより独創的なアイデアを出した。

questions.question: What do the researchers suggest?
choices: People should use smartphones less at work.
Schools should give students more homework.
Adults should avoid boring tasks.
Children should sometimes be allowed to be bored.
questions.explanation: 特に子どもは、ときには退屈を感じることを許されるべきだと提案している。

questions.question: What is one reason people choose to live in tiny houses?
choices: To save money.
To live closer to the city center.
To have more possessions.
To avoid paying any taxes.
questions.explanation: 普通の家よりはるかに安いのでお金を節約したい人がいる。

questions.question: What problem do tiny house owners face?
choices: Moving their houses on wheels.
Finding legal places to put their houses.
Getting enough electricity.
Finding builders.
questions.explanation: 最小面積の規則があり、合法的に置ける場所を見つけるのが難しい。

questions.question: What is one cause of antibiotic resistance mentioned?
choices: Developing too many new drugs.
Using antibiotics for illnesses caused by viruses.
Patients refusing to take medicine.
A lack of hospitals.
questions.explanation: ウイルスが原因の風邪に抗生物質を処方するなどの使いすぎが原因とされている。

questions.question: What are health experts calling for?
choices: A complete ban on antibiotics.
Stricter rules on antibiotics in farming.
Fewer visits to doctors.
More farm animals.
questions.explanation: 農業での抗生物質使用の規則厳格化と新薬開発への投資を求めている。

questions.question: What is one criticism of volunteer tourism?
choices: It is too expensive for young people.
Volunteers rarely experience local culture.
Volunteers may take jobs from local workers.
The programs are too long.
questions.explanation: 地元の労働者の仕事を奪うことがあると批判されている。

questions.question: What do experts advise people to do?
choices: Volunteer only in their own country.
Choose programs that work with local communities.
Avoid working with children entirely.
Stay abroad for at least a year.
questions.explanation: 地域社会と協力して運営されているプログラムを選ぶよう助言している。

questions.question: What have some companies started?
choices: Early retirement programs.
Special training for managers.
Programs to hire only young people.
Mentoring programs led by older employees.
questions.explanation: 高齢の社員が若いスタッフに知識を伝える指導プログラムを始めた。

questions.question: What do experts say companies should do?
choices: Raise the retirement age.
Pay older workers more.
Reduce the number of older workers.
Offer flexible working hours.
questions.explanation: 柔軟な勤務時間(flexible working hours)を提供すべきだと述べている。

questions.question: What happened after wolves returned to Yellowstone?
choices: The number of deer increased.
Beavers disappeared from the park.
Trees were able to grow again.
Rivers became polluted.
questions.explanation: シカが特定の場所を避けるようになり、木が再び育つことができた。

questions.question: Why have some farmers complained?
choices: Deer have eaten their crops.
The park has taken their land.
Wolves have killed their animals.
Tourists have damaged their farms.
questions.explanation: オオカミに羊や牛を殺されたと言っている。

questions.question: What do participants do when they arrive at the camps?
choices: Hand over their devices.
Take a sleep test.
Set goals for their phone use.
Choose a roommate.
questions.explanation: 到着時に携帯電話などの機器を預ける。

questions.question: What do psychologists recommend?
choices: Attending a camp every month.
Buying a simpler phone.
Giving up smartphones completely.
Making small changes in daily life.
questions.explanation: 通知をオフにするなど、日常生活で小さな変化を起こすことを勧めている。

title: Real-Life: Museum tickets
situation: You want to visit the museum's special dinosaur exhibition with your two children, aged 8 and 13. You want to spend as little as possible. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy a family pass online.
Buy individual tickets at the entrance on a weekend.
Buy only general admission tickets.
Visit on a Wednesday and buy exhibition tickets.
questions.explanation: 水曜日なら入館は無料なので、特別展チケット(大人10ドル+子ども5ドル×2=20ドル)だけで済み最も安い。ファミリーパスは40ドル。

title: Real-Life: Lost luggage
situation: Your suitcase did not arrive at the airport. You are staying at a hotel downtown and are leaving the city in two days. You hear the following explanation at the baggage service counter.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Go to Chicago to get your bag.
Fill out a form with your contact details.
Buy a new suitcase.
Wait at the airport until tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 最初にすべきことは、帰る前に連絡先を用紙に記入すること。荷物の受け取りや買い物はその後。

title: Real-Life: Apartment repairs
situation: Water is leaking from the ceiling of your bathroom. You work from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call your building manager and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Fill out a form on the website.
Call the office again tomorrow at nine.
Turn off the valve under the kitchen sink.
Turn off the valve in the bathroom.
questions.explanation: 水漏れは緊急なので、まず台所の流し台の下の元栓を閉める(その後緊急ダイヤルに電話)。元栓は浴室ではなく台所にある。

title: Real-Life: Library books
situation: You borrowed three books from the library, and they are due today. You have finished two of them but want to keep reading the third. You hear the following message from the library.

questions.question: The book you want to keep reading is "The Silent River." What should you do?
choices: Return all three books today.
Renew the third book online.
Return two books and keep the third without renewing it.
Call the library to cancel the other user's reservation.
questions.explanation: 読み続けたい本は予約が入っていて延長できない。延滞料を避けるには、今日3冊すべてを返却するしかない。

title: Real-Life: Package delivery
situation: You missed a delivery while you were at work. You leave home at 8 a.m. and return at 7 p.m. on weekdays. You are free this Saturday. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Ask for redelivery tomorrow morning.
Go to the service center on Saturday afternoon.
Wait for the package to be delivered on Saturday.
Ask for redelivery tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 帰宅は午後7時なので、明日の午後6時から9時の再配達で受け取れる。土曜日のセンターは正午までなので午後では間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Hotel check-out
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves at 7 p.m. today, and you want to go sightseeing until 3 p.m. You do not want to carry your luggage. You hear the following information from the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for late check-out until two p.m.
Take your luggage with you while sightseeing.
Check out by eleven and leave your bags at the front desk.
Take the shuttle bus at five p.m.
questions.explanation: 11時にチェックアウトして荷物をフロントに無料で預ければ、3時まで手ぶらで観光でき、4時のバス(フライトの3時間前)に間に合う。

title: Real-Life: Smartphone repair
situation: The screen of your smartphone is cracked. You bought the phone 18 months ago. You need to use a phone for work every day. You hear the following explanation at a repair shop.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Use the express repair service.
Ask the manufacturer to repair it for free.
Have the phone repaired and borrow a replacement.
Wait three to five days without a phone.
questions.explanation: 特急サービスは対象外の機種で、保証も切れている。毎日電話が必要なので、通常修理を頼み代わりの電話を借りるのが正しい。

title: Real-Life: Office move
situation: You are an employee at a company that is moving to a new office. You have a lot of documents in your desk that you need to keep. You hear the following announcement from your manager.

questions.question: What should you do with the documents you need?
choices: Put them in the blue bins.
Pack them in boxes labeled with your name and desk number.
Give them to the IT team.
Leave them in your desk until the move.
questions.explanation: 持っていく書類は箱に詰め、名前と新しい机の番号を書く。青い箱は不要書類用で、机に残すと処分される。

title: Real-Life: Rental car return
situation: You rented a car and need to return it. Your flight leaves at 6 a.m. tomorrow, and the gas tank is half full. You hear the following explanation from the rental company.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Return the car at the counter at seven a.m.
Return the car without refueling.
Fill the tank and use the after-hours return area.
Leave the key at the counter tonight at eleven.
questions.explanation: 6時発の便ではカウンターが開く7時を待てない。ガソリンを満タンにして時間外返却エリアに停め、鍵を返却ボックスに入れる。

title: Real-Life: University course registration
situation: You are a university student. You want to take Professor Kim's economics course, but the online registration shows that it is full. You hear the following message from the student office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Add your name to the waiting list online.
Go to the first class and ask the professor.
Call the student office again next Friday.
Register for another economics course.
questions.explanation: キム教授の授業はキャンセル待ちリストを使わないので、初回の授業に出て教授に直接許可を求める。

title: Real-Life: Moving trash
situation: You are moving out of your apartment this weekend. You have an old sofa and a broken microwave oven to throw away. You call the city office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do with the sofa?
choices: Take it to the recycling center this weekend.
Book a pickup for next week.
Put it out with the regular trash.
Take it to an electronics store.
questions.explanation: 今週末に引っ越すので1週間前予約の回収には間に合わない。週末なら予約なしでリサイクルセンターに持ち込める。

title: Real-Life: Passport renewal
situation: Your passport expires in two months. You are going abroad on business in three weeks. You hear the following information at the passport office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply for standard processing.
Travel with your current passport.
Apply for express processing with proof of your flight.
Wait until after your trip to renew.
questions.explanation: 出発は3週間後で通常手続き(4週間)では間に合わず、残り2か月のパスポートでは入国できない国が多い。航空券の予約を示して特急手続きを申請する。

title: Real-Life: Cooking class
situation: You want to join a cooking class to learn how to make Italian food. You are a vegetarian. You hear the following information from a cooking school.

questions.question: Which class should you take?
choices: The Monday class.
The Saturday class.
The Wednesday class.
Both the Monday and Wednesday classes.
questions.explanation: 水曜の地中海の野菜料理はイタリア料理を含み、肉や魚を使わないのでベジタリアンに最適。月曜はミートソース、土曜は日本料理。

title: Real-Life: Job application
situation: You want to apply for a sales position at a company. You have three years of sales experience but no university degree. You hear the following message from the company's human resources department.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply online for the Sales Manager position.
Apply online for the Sales Representative position.
Get a university degree first.
Wait until next month to apply.
questions.explanation: 営業経験3年で学位なしなので、学位不要で経験2年以上の営業担当者職に応募できる。マネージャー職は学位と5年の経験が必要。

title: Real-Life: Ferry schedule
situation: You are on an island and need to catch a train on the mainland that leaves at 4:30 p.m. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the ferry terminal on the mainland. It is now 2:00 p.m. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the 3:30 ferry.
Wait for the winds to calm down.
Take the high-speed boat and walk to the station.
Take the high-speed boat and then a bus.
questions.explanation: 3時30分のフェリーは4時15分着で、駅まで徒歩20分では4時30分に間に合わない。高速船で3時15分に着き、駅前に停まるバスに乗れば間に合う。北桟橋から歩くと遠い。

title: Real-Life: Internet problem
situation: Your home internet has stopped working. The lights on your router are blinking red. You call the internet provider and hear the following message.

questions.question: You live in the Northfield area. What should you do?
choices: Wait until six p.m. for service to return.
Restart your router and then book a technician if needed.
Check your computer's settings.
Call back after the outage ends.
questions.explanation: 障害地域ではないので、まずルーターを再起動する。ランプが赤く点滅したままならケーブルの問題なので技術者を予約する。

title: Real-Life: Charity run
situation: You want to take part in a charity run with your 10-year-old daughter. Neither of you has run long distances before. You hear the following information.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Register together for the five-kilometer course.
Register your daughter alone for the fun run.
Register for the ten-kilometer course.
Register together for the three-kilometer fun run.
questions.explanation: 10歳の娘は5キロコース(12歳以上)に出られない。3キロのファンランなら大人同伴で一緒に参加できる。

title: Real-Life: Bank card
situation: You lost your bank card yesterday. You think you dropped it on the street. You call your bank and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Order a new card online.
Visit a branch for a temporary card.
Report to the fraud department.
Press one to stop the card.
questions.explanation: まず1を押してカードを停止する。新カードの注文や仮カードの発行は停止の後。

title: Real-Life: Hiking trail
situation: You are planning a hike with your friends tomorrow. You want a trail that takes less than four hours and has a view of the lake. You hear the following information at a visitor center.

questions.question: Which trail should you take?
choices: The Waterfall Trail.
The Ridge Trail.
The Forest Trail.
The Summit Trail.
questions.explanation: リッジ・トレイルは迂回で約4時間半になる。4時間未満で湖が見えるのは3時間半で湖畔を通るウォーターフォール・トレイル。

title: Real-Life: Office printer
situation: You need to print 200 color copies of a brochure by noon today. It is now 9 a.m. You call the office services department and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Contact Mark in the design department.
Submit your file through the print portal.
Use the printer on your own floor.
Print the brochure in black and white.
questions.explanation: 大量のカラー印刷を正午までに必要としている。印刷ポータル経由のカラーは1営業日かかるので、マークに連絡して5階の高速カラープリンターの使用許可を得る。

questions.question: How often do you visit the Chicago office?
choices: It's on Michigan Avenue.
For about two hours.
About once a month.
questions.explanation: How often は頻度を尋ねる。「月に1回くらい」が適切。所在地や所要時間(How long への答え)は不適切。

questions.question: Isn't the cafeteria closed for renovations?
choices: I'll have the soup, please.
Only until next Monday.
Close the window, please.
questions.explanation: 「食堂は改装で閉まっていませんか」に「来週の月曜までだけです」と答え、閉まっていることを認めつつ期間を補足している。注文の言葉は cafeteria からの連想、Close the window は closed の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Should we hire a caterer or prepare the food ourselves?
choices: A caterer would save us time.
Yes, we should.
The food was delicious.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。「ケータリング業者のほうが時間の節約になる」と一方を選んでいる。選択疑問文に Yes / No では答えられない。料理の感想は過去の話で、質問と合わない。

questions.question: The quarterly sales figures look much better than expected.
choices: Yes, the new campaign really helped.
I expected you at nine.
Four times a year.
questions.explanation: 「四半期の売上が予想よりずっと良い」という発言に「新しいキャンペーンが効いた」と応じている。expected の繰り返しと、quarterly からの連想(年4回)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Can you show me how to use the new scheduling software?
choices: The show starts at eight.
It's a new schedule.
Sure, I have some time after lunch.
questions.explanation: 「新しい予定管理ソフトの使い方を教えてくれますか」という依頼に「いいですよ、昼食後なら時間があります」と応じている。show、schedule の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How much will it cost to repair the copier?
choices: Make twenty copies, please.
It was repaired last year.
The technician hasn't given us an estimate yet.
questions.explanation: 「コピー機の修理はいくらかかりますか」に「技術者からまだ見積もりをもらっていない」と、金額が分からないことを伝えている。copies、repaired の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Why don't we have lunch on the patio today?
choices: That sounds nice—the weather is perfect.
Because I had a late breakfast.
Table for four, please.
questions.explanation: Why don't we ...? は「〜しませんか」という提案。「いいですね、天気も最高です」と応じている。Because で理由を答えるのは Why の誤解によるひっかけ。注文の言葉は lunch からの連想。

questions.question: Are you going to the trade show in Berlin or in Paris?
choices: Yes, I showed it to them.
By plane, probably.
Actually, neither—I have to stay here.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「実はどちらにも行かない、ここに残らないといけない」と答えている。選択疑問文に Yes は不適切。交通手段は How への答え。

questions.question: Who should I send the invoice to?
choices: Ms. Lopez in the billing department.
By the end of the month.
I sent the photos yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「請求書は誰に送ればいいですか」に「請求担当部署のロペスさん」と人物を答えている。期限は When への答え、sent の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: The elevator on the east side is out of order again.
choices: I'll call the maintenance office.
In alphabetical order.
On the fifth floor, I think.
questions.explanation: 「東側のエレベーターがまた故障している」という発言に「保守管理室に電話します」と対応を述べている。order の別の意味(順番)や、elevator からの連想の階数はひっかけ。

questions.question: How long does it take to get to the factory from here?
choices: It's a long table.
About forty minutes by car.
They make auto parts.
questions.explanation: How long は所要時間を尋ねる。「車で40分ほど」が適切。long の繰り返しと、factory からの連想(自動車部品を作っている)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
choices: Whichever is closer to the front.
Yes, I would.
I saw it in the window.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「前のほうに近いほうならどちらでも」と答えている。選択疑問文に Yes は不適切。window の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: I can't find the agenda for this afternoon's meeting.
choices: No, I didn't meet him.
At two thirty.
I just e-mailed it to everyone.
questions.explanation: 「今日の午後の会議の議題が見つからない」という発言に「さっき全員にメールで送った」と応じている。meet の音のひっかけや、会議の時刻は発言への応答になっていない。

questions.question: Who approved the new travel policy?
choices: The board voted on it last week.
To Singapore and Tokyo.
I'd prefer to travel light.
questions.explanation: 「新しい出張規程を承認したのは誰ですか」に「先週、取締役会が採決した」と答えている。行き先は travel からの連想、travel の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Is there a pharmacy near the hotel?
choices: Yes, I booked the hotel.
Take two tablets a day.
There's one on the next block.
questions.explanation: 「ホテルの近くに薬局はありますか」に「次の区画に1軒あります」と答えている。hotel の繰り返しと、pharmacy からの連想(錠剤を1日2回)はひっかけ。

questions.question: What did you think of the candidate we interviewed?
choices: In the second interview room.
She seemed very well prepared.
Around ten applicants.
questions.explanation: 「面接した候補者をどう思いましたか」に「とても準備ができているようだった」と感想を述べている。場所や人数は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Shouldn't we update the price list before the sale?
choices: Yes, I'm working on it now.
Twenty percent off everything.
It was sold out.
questions.explanation: 「セールの前に価格表を更新すべきでは」に「はい、今やっています」と答えている。割引率や sold out は sale からの連想。

questions.question: Where's the nearest place to get coffee around here?
choices: There's a café in the lobby.
Two sugars, please.
Yes, it's near here.
questions.explanation: 「この辺りで一番近いコーヒーが飲める場所は」に「ロビーにカフェがあります」と答えている。砂糖の注文は coffee からの連想、疑問詞の質問に Yes は不適切。

questions.question: We're running low on printer paper.
choices: He's running in the marathon.
I'll order more this afternoon.
The paper said it would rain.
questions.explanation: 「プリンター用紙が少なくなってきた」という発言に「今日の午後に追加で注文します」と応じている。running、paper(新聞)の別の意味を使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: Did Mr. Kim call back about the shipment?
choices: The ship is very large.
Not yet, but he said he would by noon.
Please call me Ken.
questions.explanation: 「キムさんから出荷の件で折り返し電話はありましたか」に「まだですが、昼までにすると言っていました」と答えている。ship、call の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How many people signed up for the workshop?
choices: Over fifty so far.
Sign here, please.
On the third floor.
questions.explanation: How many は数を尋ねる。「今のところ50人以上」が適切。sign の繰り返しや場所は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you want to review the proposal now or after lunch?
choices: Yes, it's a good proposal.
Let's do it now while it's quiet.
I had a sandwich.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「静かなうちに今やりましょう」と一方を選んでいる。Yes は不適切、サンドイッチは lunch からの連想。

questions.question: Why hasn't the website been updated?
choices: Yes, on the home page.
The designer is still working on the new photos.
I updated my phone yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「なぜウェブサイトが更新されていないのですか」に「デザイナーがまだ新しい写真を作業中」と理由を述べている。Yes で始まる応答や、updated の繰り返しは不適切。

questions.question: The client wants to change the delivery date.
choices: Yes, it was delivered.
Twenty dollars in change.
Did she say what date works better?
questions.explanation: 「顧客が納品日を変更したがっている」という発言に「どの日が都合がいいか言っていましたか」と聞き返している。delivered、change(おつり)の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Who's going to pick up the visitors from the station?
choices: The train leaves from platform three.
Kevin volunteered to do it.
Yes, they're visiting tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「駅まで来客を迎えに行くのは誰ですか」に「ケビンが引き受けてくれた」と人物を答えている。station からの連想(ホーム)や、Yes で始まる応答は不適切。

questions.question: Which room is the orientation being held in?
choices: Room 204, at the end of the hall.
For all new employees.
Hold the door, please.
questions.explanation: 「オリエンテーションはどの部屋で行われますか」に「廊下の突き当たりの204号室」と答えている。対象者の説明や held と hold の音のひっかけは不適切。

questions.question: Can I get a refund if the jacket doesn't fit?
choices: Yes, within thirty days with the receipt.
The fitting room is busy.
Fund-raising starts in May.
questions.explanation: 「ジャケットが合わなかったら返金してもらえますか」に「はい、レシートがあれば30日以内なら」と答えている。fitting、fund(refund の一部)の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: When are you moving into your new office?
choices: It's on the tenth floor.
As soon as the furniture arrives.
The movie starts at seven.
questions.explanation: 「新しいオフィスにいつ移りますか」に「家具が届いたらすぐに」と時を答えている。場所は Where への答え、movie は moving の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Haven't the tickets for the concert sold out?
choices: The concert hall is downtown.
I'll take a ticket to Boston.
There are a few left in the back row.
questions.explanation: 「コンサートのチケットは売り切れていないのですか」に「後ろの列に少し残っています」と答えている。会場の場所や、ticket の別の意味(乗車券)は不適切。

questions.question: I think we should postpone the product launch.
choices: Lunch is at twelve.
I agree—the packaging isn't ready.
The post office closes at five.
questions.explanation: 「製品の発売を延期すべきだと思う」という意見に「賛成です、パッケージが間に合っていない」と応じている。lunch(launch の音)、post(postpone の一部)はひっかけ。

questions.question: How do I connect to the guest Wi-Fi?
choices: Yes, the guests arrived.
Very fast connections.
The password is posted by the front desk.
questions.explanation: 「ゲスト用 Wi-Fi にはどう接続すればいいですか」に「パスワードはフロントの横に貼ってあります」と方法を答えている。guests、connections の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Is the budget meeting today or tomorrow?
choices: It's been moved to next week.
Yes, the budget is approved.
About an hour long.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「来週に移りました」とどちらでもない答えを返している。Yes は不適切、長さは How long への答え。

questions.question: Who left this umbrella in the lobby?
choices: I think it belongs to the courier.
It might rain later.
Turn left at the lobby.
questions.explanation: 「ロビーにこの傘を置いていったのは誰ですか」に「配達員のものだと思います」と答えている。雨は umbrella からの連想、left(左)の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: Why don't you take tomorrow off?
choices: Because the flight took off late.
Take off your shoes, please.
I have a deadline to meet.
questions.explanation: Why don't you ...? は「〜したらどうですか」という提案。「締め切りがあるので」と断っている。Because で答えるのは Why の誤解、take off の別の意味もひっかけ。

questions.question: Ms. Chen's flight has been delayed.
choices: Then let's start the meeting without her.
It's a delightful view.
Near the emergency exit.
questions.explanation: 「チェンさんの便が遅れている」という発言に「それなら彼女抜きで会議を始めましょう」と応じている。delightful は delayed の音、座席の位置は flight からの連想。

questions.question: Where should I park for the job interview?
choices: Visitors can use the lot behind the building.
At ten o'clock sharp.
In the park across town.
questions.explanation: 「面接のときはどこに駐車すればいいですか」に「来訪者は建物の裏の駐車場を使えます」と答えている。時刻は When への答え、park(公園)の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: Hasn't the shipment from Mexico arrived yet?
choices: It's stuck in customs.
Yes, I've been to Mexico.
The customers are waiting.
questions.explanation: 「メキシコからの荷物はまだ届いていないのですか」に「税関で止まっている」と答えている。Mexico の繰り返しや、customers(customs と似た音)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Would you mind closing the door?
choices: It's closer to the station.
The store closes at nine.
Not at all.
questions.explanation: Would you mind ...? は「〜してもらえますか」という依頼。「いいですよ(まったく構いません)」と応じている。closer、closes の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: What's the best way to contact the editor?
choices: The best edition so far.
Contact lenses, please.
She prefers e-mail.
questions.explanation: 「編集者に連絡を取るにはどうするのが一番いいですか」に「彼女はメールを好みます」と答えている。edition(editor と似た音)、contact の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: Our team won the industry award this year.
choices: It weighs about a kilogram.
Two or three times a year.
Congratulations! That's wonderful news.
questions.explanation: 「うちのチームが今年の業界賞を受賞した」という報告に「おめでとう、すばらしい知らせだ」と応じている。重さは award(トロフィー)からの連想、頻度は year の繰り返しによるひっかけ。

questions.question: How did the product demonstration go?
choices: Several clients placed orders afterward.
By train, I think.
Go straight and turn right.
questions.explanation: 「製品の実演はどうでしたか」に「その後、何社かの顧客が注文した」と結果を答えている。交通手段は How の別の意味、go の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Should I print the handouts in color or black and white?
choices: Yes, please hand them out.
The prints are on the wall.
Black and white is fine.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「白黒で大丈夫です」と一方を選んでいる。Yes は不適切。hand、prints の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Who's responsible for ordering office supplies?
choices: In the storage room.
That's Linda's job.
I ordered a salad.
questions.explanation: 「事務用品の注文は誰の担当ですか」に「リンダの仕事です」と人物を答えている。場所の応答や、ordered の繰り返しは不適切。

questions.question: Didn't you say you'd worked in Singapore?
choices: No, I didn't sing.
Yes, for two years at our branch there.
Six hours by plane.
questions.explanation: 「シンガポールで働いていたと言っていませんでしたか」に「はい、そこの支店で2年」と答えている。sing は Singapore の音、所要時間は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: When do you expect the renovations to be finished?
choices: I expected it, too.
Probably by the end of March.
They're renovating the lobby.
questions.explanation: 「改装はいつ終わる見込みですか」に「おそらく3月末までに」と時を答えている。expected、renovating の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Why are there so many people in the lobby?
choices: About a hundred, I think.
There's a fire drill this morning.
Yes, it's very popular.
questions.explanation: 「なぜロビーにこんなに人がいるのですか」に「今朝、避難訓練がある」と理由を述べている。人数は How many への答え、Yes は疑問詞の質問に合わない。

questions.question: Could you send me the updated schedule?
choices: He was sent to Tokyo.
I'll forward it right away.
It's printed on both sides.
questions.explanation: 「更新された予定表を送ってもらえますか」という依頼に「すぐに転送します」と応じている。sent の繰り返しや、予定表の印刷の説明は依頼への応答になっていない。

questions.question: Which of these designs do you like better?
choices: Yes, I like it.
The blue one looks more professional.
She designed our logo.
questions.explanation: 「これらのデザインのどちらが好きですか」に「青いほうがよりプロらしく見える」と選んでいる。Yes は不適切、designed の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: The air conditioner in the meeting room isn't working.
choices: Yes, it's on the air.
We're meeting at three.
I'll ask facilities to look at it.
questions.explanation: 「会議室のエアコンが動いていない」という発言に「設備担当に見てもらうよう頼みます」と応じている。air、meeting の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Are you taking the early flight or the late one?
choices: Yes, I'm taking it.
The early one, so I can rest before the meeting.
It was a long flight.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「早い便です、会議の前に休めるので」と一方を選んでいる。Yes は不適切、過去の便の感想は質問に合わない。

questions.question: When does the cafeteria start serving lunch?
choices: Yes, they serve salads.
At eleven thirty.
On the first floor.
questions.explanation: 「食堂はいつ昼食を出し始めますか」に「11時半です」と時刻を答えている。Yes は疑問詞の質問に合わず、場所は Where への答え。

questions.question: Who's covering the reception desk while Amy is away?
choices: A temporary worker from the agency.
The cover of the magazine.
Please take a seat.
questions.explanation: 「エイミーの不在中、受付は誰が担当しますか」に「派遣会社の臨時職員」と人物を答えている。cover(表紙)の別の意味や、受付からの連想の言葉は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Should we take a taxi or walk to the restaurant?
choices: Yes, we should.
Table for six.
It's only five minutes on foot.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「歩いて5分だけです」と、歩くほうを間接的に選んでいる。Yes は不適切、予約人数は restaurant からの連想。

questions.question: I heard the company is opening a branch in Seoul.
choices: The branch of that tree fell.
I'll open the window.
Yes, it's scheduled for next spring.
questions.explanation: 「会社がソウルに支店を開くと聞いた」という発言に「はい、来春の予定です」と応じている。branch(枝)の別の意味、open の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How can I reduce my monthly phone bill?
choices: Bill is in a meeting.
You could switch to a cheaper plan.
Once a month.
questions.explanation: 「毎月の電話代を減らすにはどうすればいいですか」に「もっと安いプランに切り替えては」と方法を提案している。Bill という人名、monthly からの連想の頻度はひっかけ。

questions.question: When can you send me the revised estimate?
choices: It was revised twice.
By the end of the day.
I sent it to the wrong address.
questions.explanation: 「修正した見積もりはいつ送れますか」に「今日中に」と時を答えている。revised の繰り返しや、過去に送った話は質問に合わない。

questions.question: Which bus goes to the convention center?
choices: Number 15 stops right in front of it.
About an hour.
Yes, it's very convenient.
questions.explanation: 「コンベンションセンターに行くのはどのバスですか」に「15番が目の前に止まります」と答えている。所要時間は How long への答え、convenient は convention の音。

questions.question: Don't you need to renew your passport?
choices: I already did it last month.
The news starts at six.
Pass me the salt, please.
questions.explanation: 「パスポートを更新しなくていいのですか」に「先月もう済ませました」と答えている。news は renew の音、pass は passport の一部の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Would you like some help carrying those boxes?
choices: Thanks, that would be great.
They're made of cardboard.
I carry my own bag.
questions.explanation: 「その箱を運ぶのを手伝いましょうか」という申し出に「ありがとう、助かります」と受けている。箱の素材の説明や、carry の繰り返しは申し出への応答になっていない。

questions.question: The printer on the second floor is jammed again.
choices: I like strawberry jam.
Two floors up.
Let's use the one downstairs for now.
questions.explanation: 「2階のプリンターがまた詰まっている」という発言に「とりあえず下の階のを使おう」と応じている。jam(ジャム)の別の意味、floor からの連想はひっかけ。

questions.question: How many copies of the brochure should I print?
choices: It's on page five.
Yes, I'll copy it.
Two hundred should be enough.
questions.explanation: 「パンフレットを何部印刷すればいいですか」に「200部で足りるはず」と数を答えている。ページの位置や、Yes で始まる応答は質問に合わない。

questions.question: Isn't the store manager on vacation this week?
choices: Store it in a cool place.
She came back yesterday.
I manage the sales team.
questions.explanation: 「店長は今週休暇中ではないのですか」に「昨日戻ってきました」と答えている。store(保管する)、manage の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Where should we put the new sofa?
choices: It's very comfortable.
Next to the window would be nice.
So far, so good.
questions.explanation: 「新しいソファをどこに置きましょうか」に「窓の隣がいいですね」と場所を答えている。座り心地の感想は質問に答えておらず、so は sofa の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: The marketing team needs the survey results by Friday.
choices: I'll have them ready by Thursday.
Yes, I'm on the team.
The market opens at nine.
questions.explanation: 「マーケティングチームが金曜までに調査結果を必要としている」という発言に「木曜までに用意します」と応じている。team の繰り返し、market は marketing の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: What did the customer complain about?
choices: Customer service is on line two.
About twenty minutes ago.
The package arrived damaged.
questions.explanation: 「顧客は何について苦情を言ったのですか」に「荷物が破損して届いた」と内容を答えている。customer の繰り返しや、時期の答えは質問に合わない。

questions.question: What will the man do first?
choices: Check for his file on a library computer.
Take his laptop to a repair shop.
Ask his teacher for more time.
Buy a new laptop.
questions.explanation: 女性の提案に従い、昼食後すぐ図書館のパソコンでファイルを確認する。修理は後回しで、期限の延長や購入の話は出ていない。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do?
choices: Join the cheaper gym near her office.
Join the gym near her home.
Start getting up earlier every day.
Exercise at home instead of joining a gym.
questions.explanation: 早起きが苦手なので、少し高くても続けやすい家の近くのジムが良いと納得している。

questions.question: What does the man decide to do?
choices: Sit on the outdoor terrace at seven.
Book a table inside at eight thirty.
Look for a different restaurant.
Change the reservation to another day.
questions.explanation: 寒さと高齢の客を理由にテラス席を避け、遅い時間(8時半)の予約にしている。

questions.question: What will the man do next?
choices: Teach a class this Saturday.
Ask his boss for weekdays off.
Take a computer course himself.
Sign up for a training session.
questions.explanation: 最後に「まずそれ(新しいボランティア向けの説明会)に申し込む」と言っている。

questions.question: What is the woman's problem?
choices: She cannot find an affordable apartment in a convenient location.
She does not get along with her current roommate.
Her apartment is too far from her office.
She has to move out of her apartment by next week.
questions.explanation: 駅の近くは高すぎ、安い所は遠いと言っている。手頃で便利な部屋が見つからないことが問題。

questions.question: What does the man suggest?
choices: Adding more charts to the speaker notes.
Reducing the amount of text on the slides.
Postponing the presentation.
Reading the slides aloud during the meeting.
questions.explanation: 文字が多すぎるので、詳細は発表者用メモに移しスライドには要点とグラフだけ残すよう提案している。

questions.question: What will probably happen to the man's suitcase?
choices: It will be sent to his hotel in another city.
He will pick it up at the airport tomorrow.
It will be returned to the airport he left from.
It will arrive on his flight tonight.
questions.explanation: 男性が明朝別の都市へ発つので、係員はそちらのホテルに直接届けると言い、住所を書くよう頼んでいる。

questions.question: What will they probably give their father?
choices: A set of gardening tools.
Some vegetable seeds.
A gardening class.
A trip with Grandpa.
questions.explanation: 道具はすでにあるので、人とも知り合える園芸教室にすることで意見がまとまった。

questions.question: What will the woman do tomorrow?
choices: Ask a coworker to help with her projects.
Take a day off to rest.
Discuss her workload with her manager.
Look for a new job.
questions.explanation: 男性の提案を受け、今の仕事のリストを見せて優先順位を相談するために明日上司と話すと言っている。

questions.question: What will the man probably do?
choices: Buy a resale ticket online.
Go to the concert without a ticket.
Ask the woman to buy a ticket for him.
Try to buy a ticket for the extra show on Friday.
questions.explanation: 追加公演のチケットが金曜正午に発売されると聞き、逃さないようアラームをかけると言っている。転売品は高すぎるという流れ。

questions.question: What will the man do this afternoon?
choices: Leave another note for his neighbors.
Visit his neighbors to complain.
Call the building manager's office.
Start looking for a new apartment.
questions.explanation: メモでは効果がなかったので、今日の午後に管理事務所へ電話すると言っている。

questions.question: What will the woman do?
choices: Cook a new curry herself.
Ask the guests to come later.
Order takeout food from a restaurant.
Go shopping for more ingredients.
questions.explanation: 近くのインド料理店に電話して持ち帰りを注文すると言っている。

questions.question: Where will the boy probably study from now on?
choices: At the city library.
In the living room at home.
At a friend's house.
In his school's study room.
questions.explanation: 図書館は満席だったので、空いている学校の自習室に授業後残ると言っている。

questions.question: How will they probably travel?
choices: On a direct flight this evening.
On their original flight with a connection in Chicago.
On a flight booked at the airline counter.
By train instead of by plane.
questions.explanation: アプリで今夜の直行便に2席残っているのを見つけ、すぐ予約するよう言っている。

questions.question: What will the woman do today?
choices: Book a restaurant for the dinner.
Create an online poll to choose a date.
Email each team member individually.
Ask Mr. Lee which date he prefers.
questions.explanation: 男性の提案を受け、日程を決めるオンライン投票を今日作ると言っている。

questions.question: Why do teenagers find it hard to wake up early?
choices: Their internal clocks shift during adolescence.
They spend too much time using smartphones.
They do not get enough exercise.
Their schools start later than before.
questions.explanation: 思春期には体内時計がずれて自然と夜遅くに眠くなる、と説明されている。単なる怠けではないとも述べている。

questions.question: What was one problem with later school start times?
choices: Some parents found transportation harder to arrange.
Students' grades became worse.
Students were absent more often.
Teachers had to work longer hours.
questions.explanation: 最後に、送迎や放課後の活動の調整が難しくなると不満を言う保護者がいたとある。成績や欠席はむしろ改善した。

questions.question: What have tests shown about the new sails?
choices: They allow ships to travel twice as fast.
They work best when there is no wind.
They can reduce fuel use on some routes.
They have replaced engines on most ships.
questions.explanation: 航路によっては燃料の使用を最大20%減らせると述べている。

questions.question: What is one limitation of the sails?
choices: They make ships more dangerous.
They are costly to install.
They can only be used on small ships.
They increase greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation: 取り付け費用が高く、強く安定した風の航路でしか最も効果がないとある。

questions.question: Why is much glass not recycled?
choices: It loses quality each time it is recycled.
People rarely put glass in recycling bins.
It breaks and becomes mixed with other materials.
Recycling plants refuse to accept colored glass.
questions.explanation: 回収中に割れてほかの素材と混ざり分別が難しくなる、と説明されている。品質は落ちないとあるので2つ目は誤り。

questions.question: What have some towns done?
choices: Stopped collecting glass completely.
Collected glass separately and built facilities nearby.
Asked people to reuse glass bottles at home.
Replaced glass bottles with plastic ones.
questions.explanation: ガラスを分けて回収し、住民の近くにリサイクル施設を建てたとある。

questions.question: What do many customers complain about?
choices: Paper straws are too expensive.
Paper straws become soft in drinks.
Plastic straws are no longer available anywhere.
Paper straws change the taste of drinks.
questions.explanation: 紙のストローは飲み物の中で柔らかくなって崩れると不満を言う人が多いとある。

questions.question: What have some businesses done?
choices: Returned to using plastic straws.
Stopped selling cold drinks.
Asked customers to bring paper straws.
Designed lids that do not need straws.
questions.explanation: 米や竹のストローを試すほか、ストローが要らないふた付きカップを考案した店もあるとある。

questions.question: What did the university study find?
choices: People took better notes while walking.
Walking meetings were shorter than normal meetings.
People had more original ideas while walking.
Employees preferred meeting in conference rooms.
questions.explanation: 座っているときより歩いているときのほうが独創的なアイデアを多く出したとある。

questions.question: When are walking meetings unsuitable?
choices: When the weather is warm.
When employees want to speak openly.
When only two people are meeting.
When people need to read documents.
questions.explanation: 最後に、書類を見たり詳しいメモを取ったりするときには向かないとある。

questions.question: What problem can planting trees on grasslands cause?
choices: It can destroy habitats for some animals and plants.
It increases the amount of carbon dioxide.
It makes the soil too wet for farming.
It attracts too many tourists.
questions.explanation: 自然の草原に木を植えると、開けた土地に頼る動植物のすみかを壊してしまうとある。

questions.question: What do experts say is often more effective?
choices: Planting billions of trees quickly.
Planting trees only on grasslands.
Cutting down old trees to plant new ones.
Protecting forests that already exist.
questions.explanation: 最後に、既存の森林を守るほうが効果的なことが多いと述べている。

questions.question: What is one thing smart cities can do?
choices: Adjust traffic lights according to traffic.
Provide free buses for all residents.
Stop all air pollution in the city.
Reduce the number of cars to zero.
questions.explanation: 車の数に応じて信号を調整できると述べている。

questions.question: How have some cities responded to privacy concerns?
choices: By removing all cameras from the streets.
By selling residents' data to companies.
By making clear rules about data collection.
By stopping the use of sensors completely.
questions.explanation: 最後に、どのデータを集めてよいかについて明確な規則を作ったとある。

title: Real-Life: Museum tour
situation: You are visiting a museum with your eight-year-old son. You want to join a guided tour that he will enjoy. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the dinosaur hall at eleven.
Join the pottery tour at eleven.
Register for the photography tour by 2:15.
Register at the information desk by 12:45.
questions.explanation: 8歳の息子に合うのは6〜12歳向けの1時の恐竜ファミリーツアー。開始15分前までに案内所で申し込む必要があるので12時45分までに登録する。

title: Real-Life: Apartment heating
situation: The heater in your apartment has stopped working. It is Saturday evening. You call the building management office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Call the twenty-four-hour maintenance line.
Leave a message for the management office.
Call the office again on Monday morning.
Call 911 immediately.
questions.explanation: 土曜の夜で事務所は閉まっているが、冬の暖房の故障は緊急扱いなので24時間対応の保守窓口に電話する。

title: Real-Life: Gym membership
situation: You want to join a gym. You can only exercise on weekends, and you want to use the swimming pool. You hear the following explanation from a staff member.

questions.question: Which plan should you choose?
choices: The weekend plan.
The basic plan.
The premium plan.
The standard plan.
questions.explanation: 週末にプールを使いたい。週末プランはプールなし、ベーシックは平日のみ。プールを含む最も安いのはスタンダードプラン。フィットネスクラスは必要ないのでプレミアムは不要。

title: Real-Life: Package delivery
situation: You missed a package delivery today. You will be at work tomorrow from eight a.m. to six p.m. You call the delivery company and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do to get your package as soon as possible?
choices: Pick it up at the local depot after work tomorrow.
Ask for redelivery tomorrow afternoon.
Have it sent to a convenience store.
Wait until the weekend for redelivery.
questions.explanation: 明日は8時から6時まで仕事なので9〜5時の再配達は受け取れない。コンビニ転送は2日余計にかかる。午後9時まで開いている営業所に仕事帰りに取りに行くのが最も早い。

title: Real-Life: Conference sessions
situation: You are attending a business conference. You want to learn about marketing on social media, and you must leave the conference by three p.m. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to Room C at two o'clock today.
Attend the workshop in Room A tomorrow morning.
Attend Ms. Harris's talk at one o'clock.
Join the panel discussion in Room B.
questions.explanation: SNSのワークショップは今日2時から90分で、3時までに出なければならないので最後まで受けられない。明日10時の同じワークショップに出ればよい。

title: Real-Life: Library books
situation: You borrowed three books from the library, and they are due today. You have finished two of them, but you want to keep the third one for another week. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Return all three books today.
Keep the book and pay the late fee.
Check whether the third book has been reserved by someone else.
Borrow the book again next week.
questions.explanation: 延長できるのはほかの会員が予約していない場合だけなので、まず3冊目が予約されていないか確認する必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Volunteer work
situation: You want to do volunteer work at an animal shelter. You are available on Saturday mornings, and you have no experience with animals. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply to be a dog walker.
Go to the shelter next Saturday to care for cats.
Sign up for an orientation session on the website.
Gain experience with large dogs first.
questions.explanation: 土曜の午前に活動でき経験不要なのは猫の世話チーム。ただし新人はまずオリエンテーションに出る必要があり、申し込みはウェブサイトから。

title: Real-Life: Hotel check-out
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves at eight p.m., and you want to go sightseeing after checking out. You hear the following information from the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for a late check-out until two p.m.
Take your luggage with you while sightseeing.
Leave your luggage at the hotel and take the shuttle by five p.m.
Take the shuttle bus at seven p.m.
questions.explanation: チェックアウト後に荷物を無料で預けて観光でき、8時の便の3時間前、つまり午後5時までにシャトルに乗ればよい。7時では遅すぎる。

title: Real-Life: Cooking class
situation: You want to take a cooking class to learn how to make healthy meals. You are a beginner and can only attend on weekday evenings. You hear the following information.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Sign up for the Tuesday evening class.
Join the Saturday baking class.
Visit the school on Wednesday to register.
Book the Wednesday course online soon.
questions.explanation: 初心者で平日の夜しか出られず健康的な料理を学びたいので水曜の夜のコース。残りわずかなので早くオンラインで予約する。

title: Real-Life: Bicycle rental
situation: You are visiting a city for one day and want to rent a bicycle for about five hours. You do not have a credit card. You hear the following explanation at a rental shop.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay five dollars per hour and give your card details.
Pay twenty dollars for a day rental and a fifty-dollar cash deposit.
Rent a bicycle for five hours with no deposit.
Pay twenty-five dollars for an hourly rental with no deposit.
questions.explanation: 5時間の時間貸しは25ドル、1日貸しは20ドルなので1日貸しが安い。カードがないので現金で50ドルの保証金を払う必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Doctor's appointment
situation: You have had a high fever since last night, and you want to see a doctor today. You call a clinic and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the clinic's waiting room this afternoon.
Book an online consultation through the website.
Make a regular appointment for next week.
Go to the emergency room at City Hospital.
questions.explanation: 今日受診したいが通常予約は満員で、発熱があるので待合室に直接行ってはいけない。当日のオンライン診療をウェブサイトで予約する。呼吸困難などはないので救急は不要。

questions.question: When is the quarterly report due?
choices: By the end of next week.
It's a quarterly meeting.
Yes, I reported it.
questions.explanation: 「四半期報告書の締め切りはいつですか」に「来週末までに」と時を答えている。quarterly の繰り返しや、reported の音を使った Yes の応答はひっかけ。

questions.question: Who's going to replace Ms. Carter while she's on leave?
choices: She'll leave at five.
Someone from the Boston office.
The lease expires in May.
questions.explanation: 「カーターさんの休職中、代わりは誰ですか」に「ボストン支社の人」と答えている。leave の別の意味(出発する)や、lease(leave と似た音)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Would you like a receipt?
choices: Yes, please put it in the bag.
The recipe is online.
I received it yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「レシートは要りますか」に「はい、袋に入れてください」と応じている。recipe(receipt と似た音)、received の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Why is the parking garage closed today?
choices: They're repainting the lines.
About two hundred cars.
Close to the main entrance.
questions.explanation: 「なぜ今日は駐車場が閉まっているのですか」に「線を塗り直しているから」と理由を答えている。台数や、close(近い)の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: Have you met the new sales director?
choices: Not yet, but I'm seeing her this afternoon.
The sales went up last month.
It's directly across the street.
questions.explanation: 「新しい営業部長に会いましたか」に「まだですが今日の午後会います」と答えている。sales の繰り返し、directly(director と似た音)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Where should I leave these documents?
choices: Leave at noon.
They're very important documents.
In the tray on my desk.
questions.explanation: 「この書類をどこに置けばいいですか」に「私の机のトレーに」と場所を答えている。leave の別の意味、documents の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Is the cafeteria open on Saturdays?
choices: I'll have the chicken.
Open the window, please.
Only until two o'clock.
questions.explanation: 「食堂は土曜日に開いていますか」に「2時までだけです」と答え、開いていることを示している。注文の言葉は cafeteria からの連想、open の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How many people applied for the position?
choices: Apply the cream twice a day.
It's a full-time position.
More than we expected.
questions.explanation: 「その職に何人応募しましたか」に「予想より多く」と答えている。apply の別の意味(塗る)、position の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Could you send me the slides from yesterday's presentation?
choices: She presented it very well.
I'll e-mail them right after this meeting.
The slide in the park is closed.
questions.explanation: 「昨日のプレゼンのスライドを送ってもらえますか」という依頼に「この会議の後すぐにメールします」と応じている。presented の音、slide(すべり台)の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: Should we book the conference room or meet at the café?
choices: I read that book last month.
The café would be more relaxing.
Yes, we should meet.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「カフェのほうがくつろげる」と一方を選んでいる。book(本)の別の意味、Yes で始まる応答はひっかけ。

questions.question: What time does the store close tonight?
choices: It's close to the bank.
At nine, as usual.
Yes, I'm closing the store.
questions.explanation: 「今夜は何時に閉店しますか」に「いつも通り9時です」と時刻を答えている。close(近い)の別の意味や、Yes で始まる応答はひっかけ。

questions.question: Didn't the client approve the design?
choices: The sign is on the door.
Yes, I'm the client.
She asked for a few small changes.
questions.explanation: 「顧客はデザインを承認しなかったのですか」に「いくつか小さな変更を求めてきた」と答えている。sign(design と似た音)、client の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Who should I talk to about my paycheck?
choices: I'll check the pay phone.
Talk to you later.
Someone in the payroll office.
questions.explanation: 「給与について誰に話せばいいですか」に「給与担当部署の人」と答えている。check、talk の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Let's take a short break before we continue.
choices: The brakes were repaired.
Good idea—I need some coffee.
Continue straight ahead.
questions.explanation: 「続ける前に少し休憩しましょう」という提案に「いい考えです、コーヒーが欲しいです」と賛成している。brakes(break と同じ音)、continue の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How far is the hotel from the airport?
choices: About twenty minutes by taxi.
It's far better than the old one.
It's a five-star hotel.
questions.explanation: How far はどのくらい離れているかを尋ねる。「タクシーで20分ほど」が適切。far better(ずっと良い)は far の別の用法のひっかけ、hotel の繰り返しも質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Which printer should I use for color copies?
choices: Ten copies, please.
The one next to the reception desk.
I prefer the blue color.
questions.explanation: 「カラーコピーにはどのプリンターを使えばいいですか」に「受付の隣のもの」と特定している。copies、color の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Are you coming to the training session tomorrow?
choices: The train leaves at eight.
It was a long session.
I'm afraid I have a client meeting.
questions.explanation: 「明日の研修に来ますか」に「あいにく顧客との会議があります」と断っている。train は training の音、session の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Why don't we ask Mr. Kim to review the budget?
choices: He's on vacation until Monday.
Because the budget is too high.
Yes, it's a good view.
questions.explanation: Why don't we ...? は提案。「彼は月曜まで休暇中です」と、すぐには頼めないことを伝えている。Because で答えるのは Why の誤解、view は review の一部の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: The new software update is available now.
choices: The data is up to date.
I'll install it this afternoon.
It's very soft.
questions.explanation: 「新しいソフトの更新が利用可能になった」という発言に「今日の午後インストールします」と応じている。up to date は update の音、soft は software の一部の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: Where do you usually buy office supplies?
choices: About once a month.
Yes, we need more supplies.
From an online store.
questions.explanation: 「事務用品はふだんどこで買いますか」に「オンラインストアで」と答えている。頻度は How often、Yes は疑問詞の質問に合わない。

questions.question: When did you start working here?
choices: It starts at nine.
Here's the work schedule.
About three years ago.
questions.explanation: 「ここで働き始めたのはいつですか」に「3年ほど前」と答えている。starts、here、work の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
choices: There's a great Thai place on Fifth Street.
I recommended him for the job.
Yes, it was very good.
questions.explanation: 「近くにいいレストランを勧めてもらえますか」に「5番街においしいタイ料理店がある」と答えている。recommended の繰り返しや、過去の感想は合わない。

questions.question: Wasn't the shipment supposed to arrive this morning?
choices: The ship is in the harbor.
It's been delayed until tomorrow.
Yes, I'm supposed to work.
questions.explanation: 「荷物は今朝届くはずではなかったのですか」に「明日に遅れている」と答えている。ship、supposed の音の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Who left the lights on in the meeting room?
choices: Turn left at the corner.
The cleaning staff, probably.
The room is too bright.
questions.explanation: 「会議室の電気をつけっぱなしにしたのは誰ですか」に「たぶん清掃スタッフです」と答えている。left(左)の別の意味、明るさの話はひっかけ。

questions.question: Do you want to share a taxi to the convention center?
choices: Sure, that would save us money.
The center of the room.
I'll take a train to Boston.
questions.explanation: 「コンベンションセンターまでタクシーに相乗りしませんか」に「いいですね、お金の節約になります」と応じている。center の繰り返しや、別の行き先の話はひっかけ。

questions.question: How long will the maintenance work take?
choices: It should be finished by noon.
It's a long hallway.
Maintenance is on the first floor.
questions.explanation: 「保守作業にどのくらいかかりますか」に「昼までには終わるはず」と答えている。long、maintenance の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Is this seat taken?
choices: It took two hours.
The seats are blue.
No, please go ahead.
questions.explanation: 「この席は空いていますか(誰か座っていますか)」に「いいえ、どうぞ」と答えている。took(taken の過去形)、seats の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: What should we do with the old computers?
choices: They're very old friends.
Let's donate them to a local school.
I'll compute the total.
questions.explanation: 「古いパソコンをどうしましょうか」に「地元の学校に寄付しよう」と提案している。old の繰り返し、compute は computers の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: The marketing team is presenting the results today.
choices: The present was wrapped nicely.
What time does it start?
I bought it at the market.
questions.explanation: 「マーケティングチームが今日結果を発表する」という発言に「何時に始まりますか」と聞き返している。present(贈り物)、market の音はひっかけ。

questions.question: Haven't you finished the inventory yet?
choices: I invented a new product.
I still need to count the items in the warehouse.
Yes, the finish is shiny.
questions.explanation: 「在庫調査はまだ終わっていないのですか」に「まだ倉庫の品を数えないといけない」と答えている。invented は inventory の音、finish の別の意味(仕上げ)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Why was the flight canceled?
choices: The flight attendant is friendly.
Because of the snowstorm.
I canceled my subscription.
questions.explanation: 「なぜ便が欠航になったのですか」に「吹雪のため」と理由を答えている。flight、canceled の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Would you mind if I opened the window?
choices: The store opens at ten.
I don't mind the movie.
Go ahead—it's warm in here.
questions.explanation: Would you mind if I ...? は許可を求める表現。「どうぞ、ここは暑いですから」と許可している。opens、mind の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Which department does Mr. Ito work in?
choices: It's a department store.
He's in human resources.
He works very hard.
questions.explanation: 「イトウさんはどの部署で働いていますか」に「人事部です」と答えている。department の別の意味(百貨店)、works の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Should I call the client now or wait until tomorrow?
choices: It's already late in her time zone.
Yes, call me tomorrow.
I'll wait in the lobby.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「彼女の時間帯ではもう遅い」と答え、明日まで待つべきだと間接的に伝えている。Yes は不適切、wait の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: When will the renovation of the lobby be completed?
choices: Sometime next month.
The lobby is on the ground floor.
It was a complete success.
questions.explanation: 「ロビーの改装はいつ完了しますか」に「来月のどこかで」と答えている。lobby の繰り返し、complete の別の用法はひっかけ。

questions.question: Where can I get my parking ticket validated?
choices: At the front desk.
It's valid for one year.
Park the car over there.
questions.explanation: 「駐車券の認証はどこで受けられますか」に「受付で」と場所を答えている。valid は validated の音、park の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: How did you hear about our company?
choices: I can hear you clearly.
A friend of mine works here.
It's a large company.
questions.explanation: 「当社をどうやって知りましたか」に「友人がここで働いている」と答えている。hear、company の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: You've been to the Tokyo office, haven't you?
choices: Yes, twice last year.
The office is closed.
I'll be there in two minutes.
questions.explanation: 付加疑問文「東京オフィスに行ったことがありますよね」に「はい、去年2回」と答えている。office の繰り返し、be there の音はひっかけ。

questions.question: Who's organizing the company picnic this year?
choices: Maria volunteered again.
In Central Park.
It was organized last year.
questions.explanation: 「今年の会社のピクニックは誰が企画しますか」に「マリアがまた引き受けてくれた」と答えている。場所の応答や、organized の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: I can't log in to my e-mail account.
choices: The log is very heavy.
He accounts for most of the sales.
Have you tried resetting your password?
questions.explanation: 「メールのアカウントにログインできない」という発言に「パスワードを再設定してみましたか」と提案している。log(丸太)、account の別の意味はひっかけ。

questions.question: How often does the shuttle run to the train station?
choices: It runs very smoothly.
Every fifteen minutes.
The station is crowded.
questions.explanation: How often は頻度を尋ねる。「15分ごとに」が適切。runs の別の意味、station の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Did you remember to lock the storage room?
choices: I remember him well.
Yes, I did it before I left.
Store it in a cool place.
questions.explanation: 「倉庫の鍵をかけるのを忘れませんでしたか」に「はい、出る前にかけました」と答えている。remember の繰り返し、store は storage の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: What's the name of the caterer we used last year?
choices: I'll look it up in the files.
Lunch for twenty people.
She was named manager.
questions.explanation: 「去年頼んだケータリング業者の名前は何ですか」に「ファイルで調べます」と、分からないので調べると答えている。食事の注文は caterer からの連想、named の音はひっかけ。

questions.question: Let's post the job opening on our website.
choices: The post office opens at nine.
I'll ask the web team to do it today.
Yes, the job was difficult.
questions.explanation: 「求人をウェブサイトに掲載しよう」という提案に「今日ウェブチームに頼みます」と応じている。post office、opens の音、job の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Is the quarterly meeting on Monday or Tuesday?
choices: Neither—it's been moved to Thursday.
Yes, it's a quarterly meeting.
Four times a year.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文に「どちらでもなく木曜に移った」と答えている。Yes は不適切、四半期からの連想の頻度はひっかけ。

questions.question: Why did Mr. Davis leave the meeting early?
choices: He had to catch a flight.
He'll leave the report on your desk.
The meeting room is early.
questions.explanation: 「デイビスさんはなぜ会議を早退したのですか」に「飛行機に乗らなければならなかった」と理由を答えている。leave の別の意味(置いていく)、meeting の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Could you help me move these boxes?
choices: The movie was boring.
Sure, where do they go?
They're made of wood.
questions.explanation: 「この箱を動かすのを手伝ってもらえますか」という依頼に「いいですよ、どこに運びますか」と応じている。movie は move の音、素材の説明は依頼への応答になっていない。

questions.question: How much does the annual membership cost?
choices: It's ninety dollars a year.
Every member received a card.
It costs nothing to remember.
questions.explanation: 「年会費はいくらですか」に「年90ドルです」と答えている。member、costs の繰り返し、remember は membership の音のひっかけ。

questions.question: The client's flight was delayed by two hours.
choices: Two hours by plane.
She's a frequent flyer.
Then let's push the meeting back.
questions.explanation: 「顧客の便が2時間遅れた」という発言に「それなら会議を遅らせよう」と応じている。two hours の繰り返し、flight からの連想はひっかけ。

questions.question: Where did you learn to speak Spanish so well?
choices: Speak more slowly, please.
Yes, it went very well.

title: Real-Life: Airport check-in

Check in using the mobile app.
Go directly to the security area.
Use an automatic check-in machine.

Press 3.

Pay for a repair at a service center.
Fill out a form on the website.
Buy a new extended warranty.
questions.explanation: 購入から18か月なので1年の標準保証は切れているが、3年の延長保証に入っている。延長保証の客は、ウェブサイトの修理フォームに記入して自宅からの無料引き取りを依頼できる。販売店への持ち込みは標準保証期間内の人向け。

Go to the box office after it opens.
Reserve two orchestra seats.
Wait for tickets for a different day.

Put the sofa outside on Wednesday.
Take the sofa back to a store.
Apply online for a collection date.
questions.explanation: 大型品を処分するには、まず処分シールを買う必要があると説明している。収集日の申し込みはその後。店への返却は冷蔵庫とテレビの場合。

choices: Buy a one-week pass.
Book a free trial class on Saturday.
Join the club immediately.
Try a different program instead.

Use a self-service machine.
Ask a staff member at the store counter.
Call the main factory.

Arrive at the museum by 11 a.m.
Call the museum again on a weekday afternoon.
Visit the museum without a reservation.

Cancel the service and choose a new company.
Call again after you move.
Request a portable router right away.

Book the Station Inn through the conference website.

Refuse to take part in the merger.

It stays open later.
Its staff seemed more caring.

Submit his paper to the international conference.

Fill out the claim forms again.

Apply for financial support from the university.
Wait until next summer to volunteer.
questions.explanation: 大学の国際交流課が海外でボランティアをする学生に助成金を出していると教え、早めに話しに行くよう勧めている。

questions.question: How much will the woman probably pay?
choices: 60 dollars.
About 73 dollars.
20 dollars.
80 dollars.
questions.explanation: 合計240ドルのうちケビンが20ドルを払い、残りの220ドルを3人で分けるので、1人約73ドル。均等に割った場合の60ドルではない。

questions.question: Haven't the new laptops been delivered yet?
choices: The supplier said they'd arrive Thursday.
Yes, I'll deliver the speech.
They're lighter than the old ones.
questions.explanation: 「新しいノートパソコンはまだ届いていないのですか」に、「業者は木曜に届くと言っていました」と、まだ届いていないことを間接的に伝えている。deliver の音の繰り返しと、laptops からの連想(軽さ)はひっかけ。

questions.question: Who approved the changes to the budget?
choices: About ten percent more.
Yes, they were approved.
I believe it was the finance director.
questions.explanation: 「予算の変更を承認したのは誰ですか」に「財務部長だったと思います」と人物を答えている。金額の応答と、疑問詞の質問に Yes で答える応答は不適切。

questions.question: Would you rather meet in the morning or after lunch?
choices: Yes, I'd like that.
The restaurant on the corner.
My afternoon is completely free.
questions.explanation: 「午前と昼食後のどちらに会いたいですか」という選択疑問文に、「午後はまったく空いています」と後者を間接的に選んでいる。選択疑問文に Yes で答えるのは不適切で、レストランは lunch からの連想。

questions.question: The printer on the third floor is out of paper again.
choices: There's a box in the supply closet.
I printed it twice.
On the third floor, please.
questions.explanation: 「3階のプリンターがまた紙切れです」という平叙文に、「備品棚に1箱ありますよ」と解決策を示している。printed・third floor の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: You've reviewed the contract, haven't you?
choices: I'm still on the last section.
No, it was a review of the film.
Contact the legal team at noon.
questions.explanation: 「契約書は確認しましたよね」という付加疑問文に、「まだ最後の部分を読んでいるところです」と、終わっていないことを伝えている。review(確認する/批評)の音のひっかけと、contract に似た音の contact はひっかけ。

questions.question: Why has the product launch been postponed?
choices: The packaging design isn't finished.
At the downtown hotel.
Yes, we launched it last year.
questions.explanation: 「製品の発売はなぜ延期されたのですか」に「パッケージのデザインが終わっていないからです」と理由を答えている。場所の応答と、launch を繰り返した Yes の応答は不適切。

questions.question: Should I book a table for six or eight people?
choices: Two people just canceled.
At seven thirty.
The book is on the table.
questions.explanation: 「6人と8人のどちらで予約すべきですか」に、「2人がキャンセルしたところです」と答え、6人でよいことを間接的に伝えている。時刻の応答と、book・table の音のひっかけは不適切。

questions.question: When will the renovation of the lobby be completed?
choices: The lobby on the first floor.
Not until the end of the month.
A local construction firm.
questions.explanation: 「ロビーの改装はいつ終わりますか」に「月末になってからです」と時を答えている。場所や会社名は When の答えにならない。

questions.question: Isn't Ms. Chen leading today's training session?
choices: She called in sick this morning.
The train leaves at noon.
Yes, I'm reading it now.
questions.explanation: 「今日の研修はチェンさんが担当ではないのですか」に「今朝病欠の連絡がありました」と、担当できない事情を伝えている。training に似た train、leading に似た reading はひっかけ。

questions.question: I can't find the spreadsheet you sent me.
choices: I'll forward it to you again.
It's spread across three floors.
About fifty rows.
questions.explanation: 「送ってくれた表計算ファイルが見つかりません」に「もう一度転送します」と対応を申し出ている。spreadsheet に似た spread はひっかけ。

questions.question: How often does the shuttle bus run to the airport?
choices: About thirty dollars.
It runs very smoothly.
Every twenty minutes during the day.
questions.explanation: 「空港へのシャトルバスはどのくらいの頻度で運行していますか」に「日中は20分ごとです」と頻度を答えている。料金の応答と、run を別の意味で使った応答は不適切。

questions.question: Could you take a look at my presentation slides before tomorrow?
choices: I took the earlier flight.
Sure, send them over when they're ready.
Yes, the slide show was great.
questions.explanation: 「明日までにプレゼンのスライドを見てもらえますか」という依頼に「いいですよ、準備ができたら送ってください」と引き受けている。took・slide の音のひっかけは不適切。

questions.question: Where are we holding the client dinner on Friday?
choices: On Friday evening.
They ordered the fish.
Mr. Ahmed is making the arrangements.
questions.explanation: 「金曜の顧客との夕食会はどこで開きますか」に「アーメッドさんが手配しています」と、自分は知らず担当者を示す間接的な応答。日時の応答と、dinner からの連想(魚)は不適切。

questions.question: Don't you think we should hire more staff for the holiday season?
choices: I'm taking a holiday next week.
Let's look at last year's sales figures first.
No, the staff room is upstairs.
questions.explanation: 「繁忙期に向けてもっと人を雇うべきだと思いませんか」に「まず昨年の売上の数字を見てみましょう」と、判断の前に検討を提案している。holiday・staff の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: The quarterly report is due at the end of the week.
choices: Four times a year.
I'll have my section done by Wednesday.
The reporter called earlier.
questions.explanation: 「四半期報告書は週末が締め切りです」に「私の担当部分は水曜までに終わらせます」と応じている。quarterly からの連想(年4回)と、report に似た reporter はひっかけ。

questions.question: Which supplier offered the lowest price?
choices: The price includes delivery.
We haven't received all the quotes yet.
It's lower on the left.
questions.explanation: 「どの業者が最安値を提示しましたか」に「まだすべての見積もりが届いていません」と、まだ分からないことを伝えている。price・low の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Are you going to the trade show in Chicago, or is Dan going?
choices: Yes, it was a great show.
From Chicago to Boston.
We're both attending this year.
questions.explanation: 「シカゴの見本市にはあなたが行くのですか、それともダンですか」に「今年は2人とも行きます」と答えている。選択疑問文への Yes と、Chicago の繰り返しは不適切。

questions.question: What time does the maintenance work start tomorrow?
choices: For about two hours.
The maintenance department.
It's been moved to Thursday.
questions.explanation: 「明日の保守作業は何時に始まりますか」に「木曜日に変更になりました」と、明日はないことを伝える間接的な応答。所要時間や部署名は開始時刻の答えにならない。

questions.question: Why don't we ask the marketing team for their opinion?
choices: Because the market is closed.
I asked for a window seat.
That's a good idea—they know the customers best.
questions.explanation: 「マーケティングチームに意見を聞いてみませんか」という提案に「いい考えです。彼らが顧客を一番よく知っていますから」と賛成している。Why don't we は提案なので Because で理由を答えるのは不適切。

questions.question: This parking area is reserved for visitors.
choices: Oh, I didn't see the sign.
I reserved a room for two nights.
They visited last month.
questions.explanation: 「この駐車場は来客用です」と注意されたのに対し、「あ、標識に気づきませんでした」と応じている。reserved・visitors の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Has anyone told the clients about the new delivery schedule?
choices: Maria sent them an e-mail yesterday.
Twice a week, starting Monday.
No, I've never been there.
questions.explanation: 「新しい配送スケジュールを誰か顧客に伝えましたか」に「マリアが昨日メールを送りました」と答えている。スケジュールの内容の応答は質問に答えておらず、最後は無関係。

questions.question: How did you hear about the job opening?
choices: It opens at nine.
A former colleague told me about it.
I'd like to work in sales.
questions.explanation: 「求人のことはどうやって知りましたか」に「以前の同僚が教えてくれました」と手段を答えている。opening に似た opens はひっかけ。

questions.question: Wasn't the meeting supposed to start at ten?
choices: It's a ten-minute walk.
The director's flight was delayed.
Yes, I'm supposed to.
questions.explanation: 「会議は10時開始のはずではなかったのですか」に「部長の飛行機が遅れたんです」と、始まっていない理由を伝えている。ten・supposed の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Do you want me to print the agenda, or will you share it on screen?
choices: Paper copies would be helpful.
Yes, I agree with the agenda.
The screen is too bright.
questions.explanation: 「議題を印刷しましょうか、それとも画面で共有しますか」に「紙のほうが助かります」と前者を選んでいる。選択疑問文への Yes と、screen の繰り返しは不適切。

questions.question: I'm afraid the conference room is double-booked this afternoon.
choices: We can use my office instead.
No, I booked a double room.
It was a great conference.
questions.explanation: 「あいにく今日の午後、会議室が二重予約になっています」に「代わりに私のオフィスを使えますよ」と解決策を示している。double・booked・conference の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: Whose turn is it to clean the break room?
choices: Let me check the schedule.
I'll take a short break.
Turn left at the corner.
questions.explanation: 「休憩室を掃除するのは誰の番ですか」に「当番表を確認します」と、すぐには答えず確認を申し出ている。break・turn の音のひっかけは不適切。

questions.question: Can you finish the design by Friday?
choices: Yes, it's a fine design.
Only if I get the client's comments today.
On Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「金曜までにデザインを仕上げられますか」に「今日顧客の意見をもらえれば」と条件付きで答えている。Yes の後の内容が質問に合わず、日時だけの応答も不適切。

questions.question: Why is the elevator out of service?
choices: On the fifth floor.
The service was excellent.
A technician is on the way.
questions.explanation: 「エレベーターはなぜ止まっているのですか」に「技術者が向かっています」と、故障中であることを前提に状況を伝えている。場所の応答と、service の繰り返しは不適切。

questions.question: You're coming to the retirement party for Mr. Ito, aren't you?
choices: He retired from teaching.
The party room is on the left.
I wouldn't miss it.
questions.explanation: 「イトウさんの退職パーティーに来ますよね」に「絶対に行きます(見逃すわけがない)」と答えている。retire・party の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: The new software will be installed over the weekend.
choices: Will we need any training?
It was installed in the lobby.
I'm working this weekend, too.
questions.explanation: 「新しいソフトウェアは週末にインストールされます」に「研修は必要になりますか」と関連する質問で応じている。installed・weekend の繰り返しはひっかけ。

questions.question: What did studies find about the lower speed limits?
choices: They had little effect on average travel times.
They caused serious traffic jams in Paris.
They increased noise in many neighborhoods.
They led to more traffic lights being installed.
questions.explanation: 渋滞を招くという批判に対し、研究では平均の移動時間はほとんど変わらなかったとある。騒音はむしろ下がった。

questions.question: What do experts say is necessary?
choices: Putting up more speed limit signs.
Raising fines for parking illegally.
Banning cars from city centers.
Making changes to the roads themselves.
questions.explanation: 標識だけでは不十分で、運転手が速度を出し続けた都市では道路を狭くし減速帯を設ける必要があったと述べている。

questions.question: What happened in some cities after transportation became free?
choices: Most drivers stopped using their cars.
Many new passengers had previously walked or cycled.
Low-income residents began to drive more.
The number of passengers went down.
questions.explanation: 乗客数は急増したが、新しい利用者の多くは車をやめた人ではなく、以前は歩いたり自転車に乗ったりしていた人だったとある。

questions.question: What do researchers suggest?
choices: All countries should follow Luxembourg's example.
Parking should be free in city centers.
Better service is more important than free fares.
Bicycles should be banned from busy streets.
questions.explanation: 無料にすることは、本数が多く信頼できるものにすることほど重要ではないと指摘し、サービス改善と駐車料金を勧めている。

questions.question: How is the Seabed 2030 project collecting data more quickly?
choices: By sending satellites to Mars.
By using equipment on ordinary boats.
By hiring more research scientists.
By laying new undersea cables.
questions.explanation: 調査船だけでなく、特別な機器を積むことに同意した漁船や個人のヨットからもデータを集めていると述べている。

questions.question: What concern do some environmental groups have?
choices: Maps may encourage deep-sea mining.
Fishing boats may damage the seafloor.
The project will not be finished on time.
Tsunamis may become harder to predict.
questions.explanation: 最後に、より良い地図によって企業が深海で採掘しやすくなるのではないかと懸念していると述べている。

questions.question: How do buy-now-pay-later services mainly make money?
choices: By charging stores a fee for each sale.
By charging customers high interest.
By selling customer data to banks.
By opening their own online stores.
questions.explanation: 主に売り上げ1件ごとに店から手数料を取ることで利益を得ているとある。利息はかからないことが多い。

questions.question: What are some governments doing?
choices: Banning online shopping for young people.
Forcing stores to stop offering discounts.
Requiring checks on whether customers can repay.
Limiting the number of items people can buy.
questions.explanation: 購入を承認する前に、客が返済できるかを確認するよう企業に義務づける規則を導入していると述べている。

questions.question: What did the experiment show?
choices: Reading a passage four times was the best method.
Students forgot most of the passage within a day.
Students in both groups remembered the same amount.
Students who tried to recall the passage remembered more.
questions.explanation: 1回読んで残りの時間を思い出すことに使ったグループのほうが、1週間後にはるかに多く覚えていたとある。

questions.question: What is surprising about the students who reread the passage?
choices: They spent less time studying.
They enjoyed the experiment more.
They were more confident about their performance.
They used flashcards to prepare.
questions.explanation: 成績は低かったのに、読み返したグループのほうが良い成績を取れると自信を持っていたと述べている(Interestingly 以下)。

questions.question: What is social jet lag?
choices: Tiredness caused by flying across time zones.
A sleep problem that affects only travelers.
The habit of taking naps in the afternoon.
A difference between weekday and weekend sleep schedules.
questions.explanation: 平日と週末の生活時間の差を社会的時差ぼけと呼ぶと説明している。旅行者の時差ぼけはたとえとして出てくるだけ。

questions.question: What do experts suggest people do on weekends?
choices: Go to bed later than on weekdays.
Take a short nap instead of sleeping late.
Stay in bed until they feel rested.
Travel to a different time zone.
questions.explanation: 週末に休息が必要なら、遅くまで寝るのではなく、午後に短い昼寝をするよう提案している。

questions.question: What are the speakers planning?
choices: A business trip
A product demonstration
A holiday party
A charity auction
questions.explanation: 12月の休日パーティーの会場を決めている。

questions.question: Why will the rooftop restaurant not work?
choices: It is too far from the office.
It cannot seat all the guests.
It does not have a stage.
It is closed in December.
questions.explanation: 屋上のレストランは約60人しか座れないが、招待客は85人いる。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Then let's call them today"?
choices: He wants to ask for a different date.
He will tell the guests about the change.
He wants to reserve the ballroom quickly.
He doubts the hotel will answer the phone.
questions.explanation: 今週中に予約するとデザートビュッフェが無料になるので、今日すぐ電話して押さえようという意味。

questions.question: Why does the woman want to change the plans?
choices: The food supplier has gone out of business.
The park is closed for repairs.
Some staff members have quit.
The weather forecast predicts rain on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 土曜日の雨の確率が70%に上がったため、ピクニックが危なくなった。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Most of the food is already bought, though"?
choices: He wants to order more food for Sunday.
He thinks the caterer should be replaced.
He is worried about the money already spent on food.
He is pleased that the weather will be good.
questions.explanation: 食材はもう買ってあり、無駄になるお金を気にしている。

questions.question: Why will the picnic not be moved to Sunday?
choices: Many employees cannot come that day.
The pavilion is already booked.
The food has gone bad.
The weather forecast for Sunday is worse.
questions.explanation: 屋内施設は日曜日に空いているが、社員の大半がその日は研修のため来られない。

questions.question: Where do the speakers need to be by six thirty?
choices: At Central Station
At Hall C
At the head office
At a hotel near the fair
questions.explanation: セントラル駅で本社チームと6時30分までに合流する必要がある。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which shuttle will the speakers take?
choices: Bus S3, departing at 6:00 pm
Bus S2, departing at 5:30 pm
Bus S4, departing at 6:30 pm
Bus S1, departing at 5:00 pm
questions.explanation: 6時30分までに着く必要があり、S2は座席が2つしかなく3人には足りない。S3は6時20分着で9席空いている。S4は6時50分着で間に合わない。S1は満席。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "there are three of us"?
choices: They should invite a third colleague to the meeting.
They need a larger shuttle for their luggage.
They will have to share a taxi with another group.
The bus must have enough seats for all of them.
questions.explanation: 残り2席では3人分が足りないと言っており、全員が座れる便が必要だという意味。

questions.question: What is the man calling about?
choices: A late delivery of boxes
A change in packaging prices
A duplicate charge on an invoice
A missing signature on a contract
questions.explanation: 同じダンボール箱の出荷に対して2回請求されている。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd like to, but the credit note has to go through our finance department"?
choices: She is unwilling to help the man.
She has already sent the credit note.
She wants the man to call the finance department.
She cannot cancel the charge herself.
questions.explanation: 請求を取り消したいが、貸方票は社内の経理部を通す必要があるので、自分では取り消せないという意味。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do today?
choices: Send the man a new invoice
Email the finance department
Visit the customer's office
Cancel the shipment of boxes
questions.explanation: 今日中に経理部にメールすると言っている。

title: Graphic: Electricity use by building
graphic:
Electricity Use by Building — March
---------------------------------------
 Building   Usage (kWh)   Change from Feb
 North      5,000         +12%
 South      3,100         -4%

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "Overall usage went up, which surprised me"?
choices: She was pleased that electricity costs had dropped.
She had expected electricity use to decrease in March.
She wants the building managers to reduce their staff.
She thinks the heat wave lasted longer than usual.
questions.explanation: 全体の使用量が増えたことに驚いたと言っている。3月は減ると予想していたという意味。

questions.question: Why will the North building not be inspected?
choices: Its electricity use decreased in March.
The building is closed for renovation.
Its air conditioners were already checked last week.
The maintenance crew is on vacation.
questions.explanation: 整備チームが先週、北棟の空調機器を点検済みだと言っている。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which building will be inspected?
choices: South
East
West
North
questions.explanation: 北棟は増加率12%で最大だが点検済み。次に増加率が大きい東棟(11%)を点検することになる。

questions.question: What concern does the woman raise about the new contract?
choices: It could renew automatically before the company notices.
Its prices are higher than those in the current contract.
It excludes two of the company's warehouses.
It requires payment in advance for the full year.
questions.explanation: 90日前の通知がないと自動更新され、気づかないうちにさらに1年縛られる恐れがあると懸念している。

questions.question: Why does the second man believe the company has some leverage?
choices: The vendor has already agreed to waive the penalty.
The legal team has rejected the clause.
Its order volume has grown since the contract was first negotiated.
The current contract expires next week.
questions.explanation: 契約を交渉してから取引量が増えており、交渉の余地があると言っている。

questions.question: What does the first man imply when he says, "That's standard, isn't it?"
choices: He wants the penalty to be increased.
He assumed the clause was ordinary.
He is ready to cancel the contract.
He thinks the legal team should rewrite the draft.
questions.explanation: 現行契約と同じ取り決めだと思い込んでいたが、後で違うと分かった。

title: Graphic: Marketing budget, third quarter
graphic:
Marketing Budget — Third Quarter (in $ thousands)
----------------------------------------------
 Category       Budget   Spent   Left
 Advertising    120      134     -14
 Events          60       41      19
 Research        45       45       0
 Trade shows     80       72       8

questions.question: What problem does the man report?
choices: Advertising spending went over its budget.
An online campaign was canceled.
The research budget was cut too much.
Trade show costs were higher than expected.
questions.explanation: 広告費が予算を約1万4千ドル超えた。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather not touch trade shows"?
choices: The trade show budget has already been spent.
The trade show budget should be moved to advertising.
Trade shows are the easiest way to cover the overspend.
Trade shows are the main source of the company's sales leads, so their budget should be kept.
questions.explanation: 展示会は営業のリードの大半を生んでいるため、その予算は残したいという意味。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which category will cover the advertising overspend?
choices: Events
Trade shows
Research
Advertising
questions.explanation: 広告の超過は約1万4千ドルで、残りが1万9千ドルあるイベントから移す。展示会は残りが8千ドルで足りず、研究費は予算ぴったりで余りがない。

questions.question: What is the main problem the group is facing?
choices: The engineers have not finished the drawings.
The attorney who must approve the filing is unavailable until after the deadline.
The board has rejected the patent idea.
The government has raised the filing fee.
questions.explanation: 締め切りの火曜日までに最終承認できる弁護士が、水曜日まで不在である。

questions.question: What does the second man suggest?
choices: Hiring an outside law firm to sign the application
Asking the board to extend the deadline
Reviewing the drawings again with the engineers
Filing a provisional application to secure the date
questions.explanation: 仮出願をすれば日付を確保でき、詳細な請求項は1年以内に追加できると提案している。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "That's an option"?
choices: She wants to reject the proposal.
She is sure the board will agree.
She thinks the cost is not important.
She will consider the proposal but needs approval first.
questions.explanation: 提案は選択肢として検討できるが、追加費用を払う前に取締役会の承認が必要だと言っている。
