questions.question: Which elevator will be out of service?
choices: Elevator 1 in the east tower
Elevator 3 in the west tower
Elevator 2 in the east tower
All of the elevators in the building
questions.explanation: 東棟の2号機が木曜と金曜に停止する。1号機と3号機は通常どおり稼働する。

questions.question: What should people on the upper floors do if they cannot use the stairs?
choices: Use Elevator 2 with a manager's key
Call extension 4410
Wait until Monday for the repairs to finish
Send an email to building management
questions.explanation: 階上で階段が使えない人は、内線4410に電話すると述べている。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "please allow extra time"?
choices: The repairs will be finished earlier than planned.
Employees can leave work early on Friday.
Travel to work may take longer than usual.
The lunch break will be extended.
questions.explanation: 朝のラッシュ時は混雑するかもしれないので、余裕を持って来てほしいという意味。

questions.question: Why is the speaker calling?
choices: To cancel an upcoming appointment
To ask for payment for a missed delivery
To change the pharmacy's opening hours
To say that a prescription refill is ready
questions.explanation: 処方薬の補充分の準備ができたことを知らせるための電話。他の選択肢は話に出てこない。

questions.question: Why should the listener not leave the pickup too late?
choices: The medicine's price will rise on Monday.
The doctor will need to write a new prescription.
The pharmacy will be closed on Sunday for a stock check.
The medicine can only be picked up before noon on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 日曜日は在庫確認のため休業するので、土曜日の午後6時までに受け取る必要がある。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "you'll need to call us by noon tomorrow"?
choices: The listener must arrange home delivery by a deadline.
The pharmacy will open late tomorrow.
The medicine will arrive at the listener's home at noon.
The listener has already paid for the medicine.
questions.explanation: 自宅への配達を希望するなら、明日の正午までに連絡して手配する必要があるという意味。

title: New penguin exhibit at the zoo

questions.question: What will open next Monday?
choices: A new penguin exhibit
A restaurant near the entrance
A children's playground
A boat tour along the coast
questions.explanation: 来週の月曜日に開園するのは、新しいペンギンの展示「南極の海岸」。他の選択肢は話に出てこない。

questions.question: Why is the number of visitors at the viewing area limited?
choices: The penguins are still adjusting to their new home.
The glass of the viewing area is being repaired.
Weekend visitors are not allowed to enter.
All tickets for the exhibit have been sold.
questions.explanation: ペンギンがまだ新しい環境に慣れていないため、観察エリアは一度に30人までに制限される。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "they fill up quickly on weekends"?
choices: The zoo will add more sessions on weekends.
Weekend visitors will receive free tickets.
The viewing area will be closed on weekends.
Visitors should reserve a feeding session in advance.
questions.explanation: ガイド付きの給餌体験は週末にすぐ満席になるので、早めの予約を勧めているという意味。

questions.question: Which area will lose water service?
choices: The downtown shopping district
The north side of the river
Maple Street and Cedar Avenue
The school district
questions.explanation: メープル通りとシーダー通り一帯の水道が止まると述べている。他の地域は話に出てこない。

questions.question: What should residents do when water service is restored?
choices: Boil all water for at least one hour
Report the color of the water to the city
Use only bottled water for a week
Run the taps for several minutes before use
questions.explanation: 復旧後の数時間は水が濁ることがあるため、調理や飲用の前に数分間水を流すよう勧めている。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "only a limited number of emergency water tanks can be delivered to those sites"?
choices: The city has run out of water for all residents.
Businesses should request a tank early because supply is limited.
Residents should share one tank with their neighbors.
The shutdown will last longer than planned.
questions.explanation: 緊急用の給水タンクは数が限られているので、事業者は早めに金曜日までに連絡すべきという含み。

questions.question: What is the board recommending?
choices: A higher dividend than last year
A dividend of 40 cents per share
A stock split for all shareholders
A new member for the board
questions.explanation: 取締役会は1株あたり40セントの配当を勧めている。昨年よりはわずかに低い。

questions.question: How can shareholders vote?
choices: By phone only, during the presentation
In person at the board office on Friday
Online, or by returning the card they received by mail
Only by email to the company secretary
questions.explanation: オンラインか、郵送されたカードを返送する方法で投票できる。カードは金曜日までに届く必要がある。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "However, rising shipping costs reduced our profit margin"?
choices: The company plans to stop selling products in Asia.
Sales growth did not fully lead to higher profit.
Shipping costs fell compared with last year.
Shareholders should vote against the dividend.
questions.explanation: 売上は伸びたが、輸送費の増加で利益率が下がったという逆接の意図。

questions.question: What caused the outage?
choices: A faulty cooling unit caused several servers to overheat and shut down
A software update accidentally deleted the email accounts
A power cut affected the entire city
A hacking attack shut down the network
questions.explanation: 2次データセンターの故障した冷却装置が過熱し、サーバーが自動停止したことが原因。

questions.question: Why were staff unable to use email until mid-afternoon?
choices: The email server was moved to a different building.
Employees had not been given new passwords.
The backup systems had not been set up to take over the email service.
The cooling unit was still being installed.
questions.explanation: バックアップ系統がメールを引き継ぐよう設定されていなかったため、午後の半ばまで利用できなかった。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "we are not out of the woods yet"?
choices: The team has moved all servers outside the building.
The problem may not be completely resolved yet.
The outage was caused by a storm in a forest.
Employees may take the afternoon off.
questions.explanation: 「まだ安心はできない」という意味の表現。メールは復旧したが、ファイルの破損確認が続いている。

questions.question: What will happen to shipments during the audit?
choices: Only urgent orders will be sent out.
All shipments will be delayed until Friday.
Shipments will be sent from a different warehouse.
Dispatch will be closed to all staff.
questions.explanation: 監査期間中は、営業部が緊急と指定した注文だけが出荷される。

questions.question: What should staff do with damaged goods they find?
choices: Move them to the loading dock at once
Return them to suppliers before Monday
Sell them to employees at a discount
Leave them in place and tag them in red
questions.explanation: 破損品はそのままの場所に置き、赤いタグを付けるよう指示している。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "even if it seems helpful"?
choices: Staff should not rearrange items, even if it looks like an improvement.
Staff should count the stock more than once.
Staff can rearrange items if it saves time.
Staff should ask the auditors to help with the shelves.
questions.explanation: 棚の整理が良いことに見えても、監査開始時点の在庫状態を崩さないよう在庫を動かすなという意味。

questions.question: What are several engineering firms hoping to do?
choices: Sell software to the university
Fill entry-level positions
Close their offices in the region
Find senior managers from other countries
questions.explanation: エンジニアリング会社数社は、エントリーレベルの職を埋めたいと考えている。

questions.question: What should students bring to the fair?
choices: Samples of their past research projects
A letter of recommendation from a professor
Their university ID and a laptop
At least ten printed copies of their résumés
questions.explanation: 履歴書を少なくとも10部印刷して持参するよう指示している。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "those slots are limited"?
choices: Only students with high grades can attend the fair.
The fair will end before 4 p.m. on Wednesday.
The engineering firms will not interview anyone.
Students should register early for the early session.
questions.explanation: 早い時間帯の枠は少ないので、月曜日より前に早めに登録するよう勧める意図。

title: Praise for children: effort versus talent

questions.question: Why did some children choose easy puzzles in the experiment?
choices: They had never been given difficult puzzles before.
They wanted to avoid looking foolish if they failed.
They were told to finish the task as quickly as possible.
They did not enjoy solving puzzles at all.
questions.explanation: 簡単なパズルを選んだのは、知能をほめられた子どもだった。失敗して愚かに見られるのを恐れたためだと説明されている。他の理由は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest adults should say to children?
choices: You are the cleverest child in the class.
You worked hard on that, and it shows.
Talent is the only thing that really matters.
Try to finish before your classmates do.
questions.explanation: 「頭がいい」とほめる代わりに、努力したことをほめる言い方を勧めている。能力をほめる言い方や、速さを競う言い方は勧められていない。

questions.question: Why do supporters think compulsory voting is useful?
choices: It lowers the cost of running national elections.
It allows people to vote from home over the internet.
It makes politicians consider the views of a wider range of voters.
It guarantees that the same party always wins.
questions.explanation: 全員が投票すると、政治家は支持層だけでなく幅広い有権者に訴える必要が出る、というのが支持派の主張である。費用や投票方法の話は出てこない。

questions.question: What is one criticism of compulsory voting?
choices: It has made elections take place much less often.
It has caused most citizens to stop reading the news.
It allows only the richest citizens to become candidates.
Some people may vote randomly just to avoid a fine.
questions.explanation: 批判派は、候補者をよく知らない人が罰金を避けるためだけに適当に投票すると主張している。選挙の回数や候補者の資格については触れられていない。

questions.question: What benefit of geothermal heating is mentioned in the talk?
choices: Sidewalks can be kept free of snow without paying for snow removal.
It produces more electricity than wind power does.
It removes all harmful gases from the air.
It allows buildings to be built without foundations.
questions.explanation: レイキャビクでは温水で歩道の雪が溶け、雪かきの費用が省かれている。風力との比較や大気の浄化は本文にない。

questions.question: What is the risk of drilling deeper wells?
choices: It may cause the hot water to freeze.
It may trigger small earthquakes.
It may cause volcanoes to stop erupting.
It may make the energy supply too cheap to be profitable.
questions.explanation: 深く掘りすぎると小さな地震を誘発する危険がある、と述べられている。他の影響は本文に出てこない。

questions.question: What does the speaker say about quantum computers and everyday tasks?
choices: They are not faster than ordinary computers at everyday tasks.
They cannot connect to the internet at all.
They can only store numbers, not words.
They are too large to be moved into an office.
questions.explanation: 日常の作業では、量子コンピューターは普通のコンピューターより速いわけではないと説明されている。接続や保存の種類については触れられていない。

questions.question: Why must many quantum machines be kept at extremely low temperatures?
choices: Cold air makes their processors run faster than heat does.
Small changes in temperature or vibration can cause their qubits to make errors.
Low temperatures allow them to store more bits of information.
Cold conditions make the machines cheaper to manufacture.
questions.explanation: 量子ビットは非常にこわれやすく、温度や振動のわずかな変化で誤りが起きるため、極低温に保つ必要があると述べている。製造費や処理速度の話は出てこない。

questions.question: What is one theory about why hearing loss may be linked to dementia?
choices: The brain works so hard to decode sounds that less is left for memory.
Hearing loss directly damages the memory cells in the ears.
People with hearing loss always sleep less at night.
Hearing aids were found to speed up the decline in thinking ability.
questions.explanation: 脳が弱い音を聞き分けるのに多くの資源を使い、記憶に回す分が減るという説が紹介されている。耳の細胞が直接記憶を損なうという説明は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the large study of hearing aids?
choices: It proved that hearing aids cure dementia completely.
It found that hearing aids make hearing problems worse.
It cannot prove that hearing aids prevent dementia.
It showed that only wealthy people benefit from hearing aids.
questions.explanation: 補聴器を使う人は他の点でも違いがあるかもしれず、認知症を防ぐことは証明できないと述べている。治療効果や富裕層との関係は話題になっていない。

questions.question: Why do many well-known brands use pop-up shops?
choices: They are required by law to open a store for each new product.
They can charge much higher prices than in permanent stores.
They allow the company to avoid paying taxes altogether.
They can test products and create excitement at a low cost.
questions.explanation: ポップアップショップは、低い費用で新製品を試したり、発売を盛り上げたりするために使われると説明されている。法律上の義務や税金の話は出てこない。

questions.question: What is a risk of pop-up shops for small businesses?
choices: They must stay open for many years under the contract.
They are not allowed to sell products to shoppers.
They may not earn enough in a few weeks to cover their costs.
They have to hire more workers than they can afford.
questions.explanation: 小さな事業者は、数週間で費用を賄えるほどの利益を上げられないかもしれないと述べられている。契約期間や販売の禁止については触れられていない。

questions.question: Why do some people enjoy board games more than online games?
choices: They are cheaper than any other form of entertainment.
They require players to memorize long rulebooks before the first game.
They let players interact face to face in the same room.
They can be played only by young children.
questions.explanation: ボードゲームでは、同じ部屋で相手の表情を読み、話して笑い合えることが魅力だとされている。費用や対象年齢については触れられていない。

questions.question: What change has made modern board games easier to enjoy?
choices: They now have longer and more complicated rules.
They are sold only in video game stores.
They are played only in cafes and never at home.
They are shorter and easier to learn.
questions.explanation: デザイナーが現代のゲームを短く覚えやすくしたので、初心者が長い説明を聞かずに始められると説明されている。ルールが複雑になったという話はない。

questions.question: What did researchers find when they tested the learning styles theory carefully?
choices: Students did not learn better when lessons matched their supposed style.
Students learned best when they were taught only through pictures.
Students who used their preferred style scored much higher on tests.
Students forgot everything taught through physical activities.
questions.explanation: 慎重に検証すると、好みのスタイルに合わせた授業で生徒の成績が上がることはなかった。写真だけの授業や、好みのスタイルでの高得点は本文で示されていない。

questions.question: What does the speaker recommend educators focus on?
choices: Sorting students into groups based on their learning style.
Using more pictures and videos in every single lesson.
Giving students longer breaks between their classes.
Strategies such as quizzing oneself and spacing out study sessions.
questions.explanation: 教材の復習、自己テスト、学習の間隔をあけることなど、ほぼ全員に効果がある方法に集中すべきだと述べている。学習スタイルで生徒を分類することは勧められていない。

title: Real-Life: Swimming lesson cancellation
situation: Your seven-year-old son has a swimming lesson at Riverside Sports Center on Saturday morning. You call the center and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do if you want your son to make up the missed lesson?
choices: Ask for a refund at the front desk on the first floor.
Take your son to the main pool on Saturday afternoon.
Bring your son and your membership card to the small pool on Sunday morning.
Wait until next Saturday and attend the regular lesson.
questions.explanation: 土曜のレッスンは中止で、振替は日曜午前10時に小プールで行われる。振替には会員カードが必要。返金は振替を希望しない場合の手続きである。メインプールは土曜に閉鎖されているので、土曜午後に連れて行ってもレッスンは受けられない。来週土曜の通常レッスンは欠席分の振替にはならない。

title: Real-Life: Residence certificate deadline
situation: You need an English residence certificate for a visa application. The application must be submitted by Friday. Today is Tuesday, and you work until 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call Westbridge City Hall and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What is the best way to get the certificate in time?
choices: Request it online and wait for it to be mailed.
Visit the counter on Saturday morning.
Visit the counter on Wednesday evening after work.
Visit the counter on Tuesday evening after work.
questions.explanation: 査証の申請は金曜日までに必要。火曜日の窓口は午後5時に閉まるので、仕事が終わる6時では間に合わない。水曜日は7時まで開いているので、仕事帰りに行ける。郵送は約5営業日かかり、金曜に間に合わない。土曜の窓口は金曜の締め切りより後になる。

title: Real-Life: Campsite reservation change
situation: You booked a two-night stay at Pine Hollow Campground for this weekend. Your family is arriving on Friday at 3 p.m. It is now Thursday at 4 p.m., and you have just received the following message. Your family still wants to camp at Pine Hollow, but they can come only next weekend.

questions.question: What should you do to keep the campsite without paying a fee?
choices: Change the dates to next weekend before six p.m. today.
Cancel the booking and receive a full refund.
Change the dates to next weekend after six p.m. today.
Keep this weekend's booking and switch to a cabin.
questions.explanation: 家族は来週末しか来られず、この週末は使えない。日程変更は本日18時までなら無料(空きがある場合)で、現在は木曜16時なので間に合う。18時以降は20%の手数料がかかる。全額返金のキャンセルは到着の48時間前までで、金曜15時到着なので水曜15時が期限だったため、既に過ぎている。この週末のまま小屋に変えても、来られない日程なので意味がない。

title: Real-Life: Dog boarding pick-up
situation: You left your dog at Happy Paws Pet Hotel while you were on a business trip. You are at home now and want the staff to bring your dog home. You call the pet hotel and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do to have your dog delivered to your home?
choices: Bring your receipt to the front desk before 6 p.m.
Pick up your dog at the front desk after 6 p.m.
Ask the staff to bring your dog home today.
Book the delivery service at least one day in advance.
questions.explanation: 自宅への配達は、少なくとも1日前に予約するのが条件。受付での引き取りは午後6時までで、領収書を持って行くが、これは配達ではない。午後6時以降は受付が閉まっている。当日の依頼は1日前の予約という条件に合わないので頼めない。

title: Real-Life: Lost parking ticket
situation: You drove to Central Plaza and parked in the underground garage. Earlier today you bought a sweater for 4,000 yen at a shop in the plaza. You have the receipt in your bag, but you cannot find your parking ticket. At the exit gate, you hear the following message from the intercom.

questions.question: How much will you have to pay to leave the garage?
questions.explanation: 駐車券をなくすと最大料金の2,000円。本日付で3,000円以上の買い物の領収書があれば1,000円割引される。4,000円のセーターなので条件を満たし、2,000円から1,000円を引いて1,000円を払う。2,000円は割引を使わない場合の料金。

title: Real-Life: Race bib collection
situation: You entered the Lakeside Half Marathon, but you will be on a business trip on Saturday. Your friend Mika has agreed to collect your bib, but she has already agreed to collect bibs for two other runners. You will return home on Sunday at 6 a.m., and the race starts at 8 a.m. You call the event office and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do to get your bib?
choices: Ask Mika to collect the bib on Saturday.
Collect the bib at the start area on race morning before 7 a.m.
Collect the bib at the Expo Hall on Sunday at 9 a.m.
Collect the bib at the start area on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 友人は既に2人分の代理を引き受けているため、もう代理人にはなれない。土曜に受け取れないと、土曜午後5時以降は当日朝にスタート会場で配られる。日曜6時に帰宅しても、スタート会場の受け取りは7時まで間に合う。エキスポ会場は土曜だけで、日曜には開いていない。スタート会場で配るのは当日朝だけなので、土曜午後に受け取ることはできない。

title: Real-Life: Sofa delivery
situation: You ordered a sofa that will be delivered on Thursday between 8 a.m. and noon. You work from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Thursday, so you will be away from home all day. You live in an apartment building with a concierge desk. You call Oakwood Furniture and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do so that the sofa is delivered without any fee?
choices: Give the building concierge written permission in advance.
Call the company on Thursday morning to change the delivery.
Call the company the day before to change the date.
Wait at home until the driver calls thirty minutes before.
questions.explanation: 木曜は一日中不在なので、在宅しなくても受け取れる方法が必要。管理人に預けるには事前の書面での許可が必要で、手数料もかからない。配達当日の変更は3,000円かかる。前日の変更は無料の条件(2日前まで)を満たさない。在宅で待つのは不在の日には不可能。

questions.question: Why was the budget meeting moved?
choices: A senior manager will be away on Monday.
The conference room was double-booked.
A client asked for a later date.
The financial report was not ready.
questions.explanation: 月曜日にオルティス氏が出張するため、日程を水曜に変えた。

questions.question: What will the woman do before the meeting?
choices: Book a different room.
Review the financial results.
Travel to Mr. Ortiz's office.
Email the director.
questions.explanation: 財務の結果を先に確認しておくと言っている。

questions.question: What has changed about the meeting, other than the day?
choices: The room.
The attendees.
The start time.
The topic.
questions.explanation: 会議室は同じで、開始が1時間早い9時になった。

questions.question: What does the man say about the order?
choices: It was delivered last week.
It is still waiting for payment.
It has already been dispatched.
It has been canceled.
questions.explanation: 今朝倉庫を出たと言っている。

questions.question: Why does the woman want toner included?
choices: Their printer is new.
They need it for a client presentation.
They have run out of it.
The supplier forgot it last time.
questions.explanation: 先週切らしてしまったと言っている。

questions.question: Where should the delivery be left on Thursday?
choices: At the back door.
At the loading dock.
At the reception area.
At the office manager's home.
questions.explanation: 木曜日は管理者が外出するため、受付に届けるよう頼んでいる。

questions.question: What is the problem with the fourth-floor printer?
choices: It needs new paper.
It has broken down several times recently.
It is too slow for marketing's work.
It was moved to the second floor.
questions.explanation: 今月3回目の紙詰まりで、部品の取り寄せが必要になっている。

questions.question: Why will the marketing team not use the second-floor printer right away?
choices: It has run out of ink.
It is being repaired.
It is located too far away.
Its service contract has expired.
questions.explanation: 2階のプリンターはトナーが切れている。

questions.question: What is most likely to happen by Thursday?
choices: The fourth-floor printer will be repaired.
A new printer will be installed.
The marketing team will move to another floor.
The second-floor printer will be ready to use.
questions.explanation: 木曜日にトナーが届くので、2階のプリンターが使えるようになる。

questions.question: What is the problem with the lakeside venue?
choices: It is too far from the office.
Its price is now higher.
It has no projector.
It is not available on the planned date.
questions.explanation: 湖の部屋に追加料金がかかり、会場の値段が約2割上がった。

questions.question: Why can the garden room not be used as it is?
choices: It lacks a kitchen.
It costs more than the lake room.
It is closed that week.
It is too small for the group.
questions.explanation: 庭の部屋は40人までで、45人が参加するため。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest the presenters do?
choices: Send their slides ahead for the smaller room's screen.
Give their talks in the lake room.
Bring their own projectors.
Cancel their presentations.
questions.explanation: 事前にスライドを送り、小さい部屋のスクリーンで映せるようにすることを提案している。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest may have happened to the four cartons?
choices: They were damaged during the drive.
They were placed somewhere the receiving team did not look.
They were loaded onto a different truck.
The driver removed them on the way.
questions.explanation: 受け入れの担当者が見ていない場所に積まれていた可能性を述べている。

questions.question: What does the man ask the driver to do?
choices: Take a photo of the storage area.
Sign a new delivery note.
Check the truck's seal again.
Return to the warehouse.
questions.explanation: 保管場所(bay)の写真を撮ってもらうよう頼んでいる。

questions.question: What will happen if the photo confirms that the cartons are there?
choices: The company will pay for the full order.
Another shipment will be arranged.
The invoice will be canceled.
The truck seal will be replaced.
questions.explanation: 会社は受け取った分しか支払わない。写真で箱があると確認できれば、追加の配送を手配する。

questions.question: Why is Tuesday afternoon better for the first candidate?
choices: She cannot attend on Thursdays because of her studies.
Mr. Reid is free only on Tuesday.
The conference room is booked on Thursdays.
Ms. Hayashi is traveling on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 一人目の候補者は木曜日に授業があるため、火曜の午後が都合がよい。

questions.question: Where will the interview on Tuesday afternoon most likely be held?
choices: The conference room.
The small room on the fourth floor.
The lobby area on the first floor.
Mr. Reid's office.
questions.explanation: 会議室は2時以降が予約済み、4階はエレベーターが止まっているため、1階のロビーになる。

questions.question: Why does the man mention the fourth-floor elevator?
choices: It is the reason the interview was rescheduled.
It is a problem with Mr. Reid's schedule.
It is a reason to cancel the interviews.
It explains why the small room cannot be used.
questions.explanation: 4階の小さい部屋を使えない理由として、エレベーターの故障を挙げている。

questions.question: What does the man imply about the facilities team?
choices: It has already finished setting up the desks.
It has agreed to pay the storage fees.
Its promise to finish on time may not be kept.
It will test the network this afternoon.
questions.explanation: though で金曜の約束に疑いを示している。女性も、前週に同じことを言っていたと指摘している。

questions.question: Why does the woman prefer her suggestion to Mr. Chen's plan?
choices: It avoids storage fees entirely.
The sales team does not need desks until Friday.
The marketing team has already moved.
Lost sales would outweigh the extra fees.
questions.explanation: 女性は、営業が止まる損失のほうが保管料より大きいと考えている。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do next?
choices: Talk to Mr. Chen about the plan.
Test the cables on the third floor.
Ask facilities to finish earlier.
Start unpacking the sales team's boxes.
questions.explanation: 今日の午後にチェン氏と話すと言っている。

questions.question: Why is the east wing closed?
choices: It is being repainted for a new exhibition.
It has been sold to a private company.
It is being checked for safety.
Its entrance is under construction.
questions.explanation: 構造検査のため閉鎖している。構造検査は安全の点検にあたる。

questions.question: What must members do before the end of this month?
choices: Pay a fee to keep their east-wing tickets.
Move their reservations from the east wing to the west wing.
Visit the café to receive a refund.
Register at the parking garage on Pine Street.
questions.explanation: 東翼の予約を西翼に変更する必要がある。期限は今月末。

questions.question: What is the main inconvenience for visitors to the west wing?
choices: They must enter at a different location than usual.
They cannot buy food on site.
The special exhibition has ended.
They have to pay extra for parking.
questions.explanation: 西翼の特別展は開催中だが、入口が駐車場ビルに移った。

questions.question: Why has the cost of the dinner increased?
choices: The dessert course has become more expensive.
The dinner has been moved to a hotel ballroom.
More sponsors have been invited to the dinner.
The caterer now charges separately for drinks.
questions.explanation: 女性が「They've started charging for drinks separately」と言い、後でも「It's only the drinks」と念を押している。デザートは「dessert isn't where the cost went up」と否定されている。ホテルの宴会場は過去の話で、招待客は増えていない(120席はもともとの約束)。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'm afraid not"?
choices: The number of guests cannot be reduced.
She does not know how many guests are coming.
The sponsors have not replied to the invitation.
She thinks the budget limit is too strict.
questions.explanation: 「Could we just cut the guest list?」への返事で、直後に「部長がもうスポンサーに120席を約束している」と理由を続けている。つまり招待客は減らせないという意味。人数が分からない、返事がない、予算が厳しすぎるとは言っていない。

questions.question: Why does the woman think the March price might still apply?
choices: The hotel next door has offered free drinks again.
The contract was signed before the caterer changed its prices.
The director has promised seats to the sponsors.
The caterer offered the company a discount in June.
questions.explanation: 女性は「since we signed our contract before they changed their pricing」と理由をはっきり述べている。ホテルの特典は「That offer ended in June」で終わっており、June はこの特典の話でケータリング会社の割引ではない。スポンサーへの約束は、招待客を減らせない理由。

questions.question: What information in last week's report was incorrect?
choices: That the new loading equipment had already arrived.
That Fenwick Foods had decided to cancel its order.
That shipments would be delayed by two weeks.
That the warehouse upgrade would be completed on time.
questions.explanation: 話し手は先週の報告を訂正すると言い、「I told you the warehouse upgrade would finish on schedule」と誤っていた内容を挙げている。2週間の遅れは今回の新しい情報で、先週の報告の内容ではない。設備が届いた、Fenwick Foods が注文を取り消したとは言っていない。

questions.question: Why does the speaker mention Fenwick Foods?
choices: To introduce a new client that the company has just signed.
To explain how a client will avoid running out of products.
To explain why the new loading equipment will be late.
To announce that a client has moved to another supplier.
questions.explanation: 「has agreed to accept a smaller first delivery ..., so their stores won't run out of stock」と、取引先が在庫切れを避けられることを伝えている。Fenwick Foods は「our largest client」で新しい取引先ではない。設備が遅れる理由(施工業者の連絡)とは関係がない。

questions.question: Why should listeners contact Haruka before noon?
choices: The contractor will visit the warehouse at that time.
Fenwick Foods needs an answer from the company by then.
The old warehouse will close for the day at that time.
She will send the new routes to the drivers at that time.
questions.explanation: 「Haruka ... will send the revised delivery routes to our drivers at noon today. So, ... please tell her before then」と、正午に経路を運転手へ送るから、その前に伝えるよう求めている。施工業者の訪問、Fenwick Foods の期限、旧倉庫の閉鎖は話に出てこない。

questions.question: Where is the staff lounge?
choices: Yes, I had lunch there today.
Down the hall on the left.
It's a pleasant place to relax.
questions.explanation: 「休憩室はどこですか」。Where に対し「廊下を進んで左です」と場所で答えている。Yes で始まる応答は場所を尋ねた質問に合わず、くつろげる場所だという感想は場所の答えになっていない。

questions.question: Would you like some coffee?
choices: The coffee shop closes at six.
Yes, please. Black, with no sugar.
The cafeteria is on the third floor.
questions.explanation: 「コーヒーはいかがですか」という申し出に「はい、ブラックで砂糖なしでお願いします」と受けている。コーヒー店の閉店時刻や食堂の階は話題がずれている。

questions.question: The copier on the second floor is out of order.
choices: I'll tell the maintenance team.
The order was delivered on time.
The meeting room is booked until noon.
questions.explanation: 「2階のコピー機が故障している」に「保守の担当に伝えます」と対応を答えている。order(注文)や会議室の予約は話題が違う。

questions.question: When does the meeting start?
choices: It's in the main conference room.
At two thirty this afternoon.
Yes, I'll be there on time.
questions.explanation: 「会議はいつ始まりますか」。When に対し「今日の午後2時半です」と時刻で答えている。場所を答えた応答や、Yes で始まる応答は合わない。

questions.question: Didn't you finish the report yesterday?
choices: The report is on your desk.
No, I'll finish it this afternoon.
The financial results were very good.
questions.explanation: 「昨日報告書を終えなかったのですか」に「いいえ、今日の午後に終えます」と否定して答えている。報告書の場所や業績の話は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Should we take the train or drive to the client's office?
choices: We should have left earlier.
The client's office is very large.
Let's take the train. Parking there is very expensive.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「電車で行くか車で行くか」。電車を選び、駐車場が高いと理由を添えている。「もっと早く出ればよかった」は選択に答えず、office の繰り返しも答えになっていない。

questions.question: The bank still hasn't approved your loan.
choices: Not yet. They said it could take another week.
The loan officer was very friendly.
I'll apply for a new credit card tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 銀行がまだローンを承認していないという知らせに「まだです。あと1週間かかると言われました」と応じている。loan から連想した担当者の話や、apply の繰り返しは、知らせへの応答になっていない。

questions.question: Our new software is much slower than the old one.
choices: The IT team moved to the fourth floor.
The old software is in the storage room.
We should ask the IT team to look into it.
questions.explanation: 「新しいソフトは古いものより遅い」という指摘に「情報システム部に調べてもらおう」と対応を提案している。IT team の語を使っても、場所や保管場所の話は指摘への応答になっていない。

questions.question: Why is the warehouse so noisy this morning?
choices: The warehouse is on Elm Street.
Yes, it's always noisy in the morning.
They're installing new shelves.
questions.explanation: 「今朝の倉庫がうるさいのはなぜですか」。理由として「新しい棚を取り付けている」と答えている。倉庫の場所や Yes で始まる応答は Why の質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Where can I find a spare pen?
choices: The pen is a little expensive.
There's one in my bag.
I'd like to borrow that book.
questions.explanation: 「予備のペンはどこで見つかるか」。かばんの中にあると場所で答えている。ペンの値段や、本を借りたいという話は、場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's in charge of the new hiring process?
choices: Ms. Park in human resources.
They're hiring five new staff members.
The process took about two weeks.
questions.explanation: 「新しい採用の手続きの担当は誰か」。人名と部署で答えている。hiring(採用)を繰り返す応答は人数の話で、process の応答は期間で答えていないため不適切。

questions.question: I've been told the Osaka trip is off.
choices: Off the coast, the water is very cold.
I'd love to go to Osaka someday.
Right, the client canceled it this morning.
questions.explanation: 「大阪出張は中止になったと聞いた」。「そうです、取引先が今朝キャンセルしました」と cancel で言い換えて確認している。off(中止)の同音の別の意味(沖)や、大阪に行きたいという連想は確認の応答になっていない。

questions.question: Haven't you heard from the supplier yet?
choices: The supplier sells office chairs.
The supplier's office is right here in town.
Not since Monday. I'm still waiting for their call.
questions.explanation: 「取引先からまだ連絡はないか」に「月曜から連絡がなく、電話を待っている」と答えている。here は hear と同じ発音のひっかけ。椅子の販売の話題は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you let me know when the printer is fixed?
choices: Of course. I'll message you as soon as it's done.
The fixed price is printed on the box.
I let the printer out of the box this morning.
questions.explanation: 「プリンターが直ったら教えてもらえるか」という依頼に「もちろん、終わったらすぐ連絡する」と引き受けている。fixed(固定された・定価)や box の連想の応答は依頼に答えていない。

questions.question: How many applicants did we get for the position?
choices: We received more than forty applications.
The position is in our Osaka branch.
We applied the same rules to everyone.
questions.explanation: 「応募者は何人来たか」。applicants を applications と言い換え、40人以上と答えている。position の場所の応答や、applied(適用した)を使った別の文は人数に答えていない。

questions.question: Who should I ask about the expense reports?
choices: The expense report is due on Friday.
Jorge just took over that job, so he'd know.
Expense reports can be filed online.
questions.explanation: 「経費精算は誰に聞けばよいか」。名前は出さず、Jorge が担当を引き継いだばかりなので詳しいはずだと推測させている。締め切りや提出方法の応答は、誰に聞くかに答えていない。

questions.question: Are you going to attend the training on Thursday?
choices: The training room is on the fourth floor.
Thursday is the day we get paid.
I'm already booked for a client visit that day.
questions.explanation: 「木曜の研修に出るか」。No とは言わず、その日は取引先訪問の先約があると伝えて欠席を示している。研修室の場所や給料日の話は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: The bakery downstairs has run out of sandwiches again.
choices: The bakery sells delicious cakes.
I ran out of time to finish the report.
Then we should order lunch from the cafeteria instead.
questions.explanation: 「階下のパン屋はまたサンドイッチが売り切れだ」に「それなら食堂に頼もう」と代わりの案で応じている。パン屋や run out の語を使っても、状況への応答になっていない。

questions.question: Would you rather present now or after the lunch break?
choices: The lunch break is from twelve to one.
After lunch works better. I'm still finishing the slides.
I'd rather have a sandwich, thanks.
questions.explanation: 「今発表するか昼休み後にするか」。昼休み後を選び、スライドがまだ終わっていないと理由を述べている。昼休みの時間や、sandwich の応答は選択に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you check whether the room is free at three?
choices: Three o'clock is a good time for tea.
I just passed it, and someone's already in there.
The room was painted last month.
questions.explanation: 「3時に部屋が空いているか確認してもらえるか」。直接の答えは言わず、さっき前を通ったら誰かが入っていたと伝え、空いていないことを示している。3時や room の語を使う応答は確認の結果になっていない。

questions.question: Is the Friday meeting still on the calendar?
choices: It was, until Mr. Kim moved it to Monday.
The calendar was updated on Friday.
Friday is the only day the client is free.
questions.explanation: 「金曜の会議はまだ予定に入っているか」。金曜の予定は、キム氏が月曜に移したので今は残っていない。calendar や client の語を使う応答は、予定が残っているかに答えていない。

questions.question: Shouldn't the new hires have received their badges by now?
choices: The new hires are meeting the director at ten.
They were ready on Friday, but security is holding them until the photos are checked.
The badge reader on the second floor is broken.
questions.explanation: 「新入社員はもうIDバッジを受け取っているはずではないか」。バッジは金曜には用意できていたが、写真の確認まで警備が保管しているので、まだ渡っていない。new hires や badge の語を使う応答は受け取り状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the shipment from Taipei coming on Thursday or next Monday?
choices: Thursday is the day we close early.
The Taipei office sent us a new catalog.
Next Monday. The supplier pushed it back from Thursday.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「台北からの荷物は木曜か来週月曜か」。来週月曜を選び、取引先が木曜から延ばしたと理由を述べている。店を早く閉める日や、カタログの話は、どちらの日かに答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the director approve the budget for the new software?
choices: The software budget was discussed last week.
The director's office is on the top floor.
He did, but the finance team has asked him to reduce it.
questions.explanation: 「部長は新しいソフトの予算を承認しなかったか」。承認はしたが、財務チームから減額を求められている。budget の話題を出すだけの応答は、承認したかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: I hear the main hall is still free for the award ceremony.
choices: The award ceremony starts at seven.
The hall was used for training last week.
Not anymore. The building manager booked it for renovations on Monday.
questions.explanation: 「表彰式に大ホールはまだ空いていると聞いた」という知らせに、ビル管理者が月曜に改修で予約したため、もう空いていないと答えている。時刻や過去の利用は、空いているかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you give me a hand with these boxes?
choices: The hand cream is in the drawer.
The boxes were delivered to the lobby.
Sure, I'd be glad to.
questions.explanation: 「この箱を運ぶのを手伝ってもらえるか」という依頼に「もちろん、喜んで」と応じている。hand(手)や boxes(箱)の語を使う応答は依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Who's presenting first at the conference?
choices: The presentation was very good.
The conference is in Boston.
Dr. Miller, I think.
questions.explanation: 「会議で最初に発表するのは誰か」。人名で答えている。presentation は発表の感想、Boston は場所の答えで、誰が発表するかに答えていない。

questions.question: What time is the store open on Sundays?
choices: The store sells sports equipment.
The manager's name is Ben.
From ten to four.
questions.explanation: 「その店は日曜の何時に開き、何時に閉まるか」。10時から4時と時間帯で答えている。商品の種類や店長の名前は、営業時間に答えていない。

questions.question: Let's go to the new Italian restaurant for lunch.
choices: I'll bring the Italian dictionary.
Sounds good to me.
The lunch menu changes every week.
questions.explanation: 「新しいイタリアンに昼食に行こう」という誘いに「いいですね」と賛成している。辞書の話や、メニューが変わるという事実は誘いへの返事になっていない。

questions.question: How long has the Tokyo branch been open?
choices: About five years.
It's on Shibuya Street.
I visited it last year.
questions.explanation: 「東京支店は開設から何年になるか」。期間(約5年)で答えている。Shibuya Street は場所、「去年訪れた」は個人の経験で、期間に答えていない。

questions.question: Which printer should I use for the color handouts?
choices: I'll print two copies of the handout.
The one next to the reception desk. It prints in color.
Yes, I printed them this morning.
questions.explanation: 「カラーの配布資料にはどのプリンターを使えばよいか」。受付の横のプリンターを選び、カラーに対応していると述べている。print の繰り返しや、Yes で始まる応答は、どれを使うかに答えていない。

questions.question: Has the client approved the design yet?
choices: The sign on the door is very clear.
Not yet. She asked for a few small changes first.
The designer approved the coffee order.
questions.explanation: 「取引先はもうデザインを承認したか」に「まだです。小さな修正を先に求められた」と答えている。design と sign の音の似たひっかけや、designer の語を使う応答は、承認の有無に答えていない。

questions.question: What time does the bakery open on weekends?
choices: It's on the corner of Main Street.
Around seven, I think.
Yes, the bakery is open every day.
questions.explanation: 「パン屋は週末何時に開くか」。時刻で答えている。Main Street は場所、Yes で始まる応答は What time の質問に合わない。

questions.question: Why don't we move the team lunch to Thursday?
choices: Good idea. Thursday works better for everyone.
We had the team photo last Thursday.
The cafeteria serves lunch until two.
questions.explanation: 「チームのランチを木曜に移そう」という提案に「いい考えです。木曜のほうが皆に合う」と賛成している。Thursday を繰り返す応答や、食堂の営業時間は提案への返事になっていない。

questions.question: The software update will take about an hour.
choices: The update was released last week.
The software manual is on the shelf.
I'll save my files before it starts.
questions.explanation: 「ソフトの更新に約1時間かかる」という知らせに「始まる前にファイルを保存します」と対応している。update の語を使う応答や、マニュアルの場所は知らせへの応答になっていない。

questions.question: Where can I pick up my dry cleaning?
choices: Pick it up tomorrow at noon.
The laundry on the corner will have it ready.
I can't clean the room right now.
questions.explanation: 「クリーニングの受け取りはどこでできるか」。角の店が用意していると場所を言い換えて答えている。pick up を使った「明日の正午に取りに」は時間の答えで、clean の連想は場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't you get a chance to look at the proposal?
choices: Yes, it's a chance to win the contract.
I've gone through the first few pages, and I like it so far.
The proposal is due at the end of the month.
questions.explanation: 「提案書に目を通す時間はなかったのか」という確認に、最初の数ページを見て、今のところ気に入っていると答えている(look at を gone through で言い換え)。chance を繰り返す応答や、提出期限は質問に答えていない。

questions.question: How long will the elevator repair take?
choices: The technicians say it'll be ready by Wednesday.
It's the elevator to the top floor.
It's a long way to the top floor.
questions.explanation: 「エレベーターの修理にどのくらいかかるか」。技術者は水曜までに直ると言っている、と期間を答えている。top floor の場所の話や、long から連想した距離の話は期間に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's taking the client to dinner tonight?
choices: The dinner was taken off the menu.
Tonight's client is from Mumbai.
Mr. Shah offered to, since he knows the restaurant well.
questions.explanation: 「今夜、取引先を夕食に連れて行くのは誰か」。シャー氏が名乗り出たと、人名で答えている(店をよく知っているという理由付き)。menu や client の語を使う応答は、誰が連れて行くかに答えていない。

questions.question: I can't make the workshop on Friday after all.
choices: The workshop starts at five on Friday.
That's too bad. I'll send you the notes afterward.
I can't make a decision on Friday after all.
questions.explanation: 「金曜の研修に出られなくなった」という知らせに「それは残念。後で資料を送る」と応じている。make の別の意味(決める)を使う応答や、開始時刻は知らせへの応答になっていない。

questions.question: Who has seen the presentation files from this morning?
choices: Our presentation was well received by the board.
The morning session was canceled.
Ask Alex. He was the last one in the projector room.
questions.explanation: 「今朝の発表資料を見たのは誰か」。直接は言わず、最後にプロジェクター室にいたのはアレックスだと伝え、彼に聞けば分かると推測させている。発表の評価や朝のセッションの話は、誰が見たかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you cover the front desk during my lunch?
choices: I'm already covering the phones until one, sorry.
The lunch special is chicken today.
The front door is locked on weekends.
questions.explanation: 「昼休みの間、受付を代わってもらえるか」。電話の対応で1時まで手一杯だと、断りを間接的に伝えている。日替わりメニューや玄関の施錠は、依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: When is the new sales manager starting?
choices: Sales figures went up this month.
The manager's office is on the fourth floor.
Her first day was pushed back, so it's now next month.
questions.explanation: 「新しい営業部長はいつから来るか」。初出勤が延期になったので来月だと言い換えて答えている。sales figures や office は話題の語で、時期には答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't you say the printer on the third floor was fixed?
choices: The printer on the third floor is blue.
The third floor is closed for repairs.
I did, but it broke down again before lunch.
questions.explanation: 「3階のプリンターは直ったと言わなかったか」。言ったが、昼前にまた壊れたと答えている。色の話や、階の修理の話はプリンターの状態に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you mind sending me the updated contract by noon?
choices: Noon is the best time for lunch.
I'd love to, but the legal team still hasn't signed off.
I'd like a copy of the old contract.
questions.explanation: 「正午までに更新版の契約書を送ってもらえるか」。送りたいが、法務チームがまだ承認していないと、間接的に難しいと伝えている。noon や contract の語を使う応答は、依頼の可否に答えていない。

questions.question: I heard the new coffee machine was delivered to the break room.
choices: The break room was repainted last week.
Coffee is served in the lobby after nine.
It was, but the supplier took it back for a faulty part.
questions.explanation: 「新しいコーヒーマシンは休憩室に届いたと聞いた」という知らせに、届いたが不良部品があって業者が引き取ったと答えている。休憩室の塗装や、ロビーのコーヒーの話は、その後の経緯に答えていない。

questions.question: Has the board approved the relocation plan, or are they still reviewing it?
choices: They're still reviewing it after the Osaka office raised objections.
The relocation was planned for the spring.
The plan was discussed at the board's annual dinner.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「承認されたか、まだ検討中か」。まだ検討中で、大阪事業所の異議を受けて検討し直していると答えている。spring や dinner の語を使う応答は、どちらの状態かに答えていない。

questions.question: Has the warehouse started packing the orders for Tuesday?
choices: The packing list is in the second drawer.
They started, but they're waiting for the new labels to arrive.
Orders on Tuesday are usually small.
questions.explanation: 「火曜の注文の梱包は始まったか」。始めたが、新しいラベルの到着待ちで止まっていると伝えている。packing list や orders の語を使う応答は、梱包の進み具合に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the cafeteria closed for renovations this month?
choices: It was until last Friday, but it's reopened with a smaller menu.
The cafeteria closes at three on Mondays.
The renovations are scheduled for next year.
questions.explanation: 「食堂は今月改修で閉まっているのではないか」。先週金曜まで閉まっていたが、メニューを減らして再開したと答えている。閉店時刻や来年の予定は、今月の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Can you still attend the vendor meeting on Thursday?
choices: The vendor meeting starts at nine on Thursday.
I was, until my manager asked me to cover the client visit.
Thursday is a good day for the vendor's visit.
questions.explanation: 「木曜の業者との会議に、まだ出られるか」。出る予定だったが、上司に取引先訪問を代わるよう頼まれたので、今は出られないと答えている。時刻や曜日の話は、出られるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: How many people are coming to the picnic?
choices: The picnic is at the riverside park.
Yes, I'm coming to the picnic.
About forty, I think.
questions.explanation: 「ピクニックには何人来るか」。人数を約40人と答えている。場所の応答と、Yes で始まる応答は人数に答えていない。

questions.question: Where did you park your car?
choices: In the lot behind the building.
I parked it for two hours.
Yes, I drove to work today.
questions.explanation: 「車はどこに停めたか」。ビルの裏の駐車場と場所で答えている。2時間停めたという話は時間の話、Yes で始まる応答は場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you turn off the lights when you leave?
choices: Of course. I'll do that right now.
The lights in the lobby are very bright.
I'd like to leave at five today.
questions.explanation: 「出るときに電気を消してもらえるか」という依頼に「もちろん、今すぐやります」と応じている。ロビーの明るさや退社時刻は依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: What's the date of the next board meeting?
choices: The fifteenth of May.
The board members are very experienced.
The board room is on the top floor.
questions.explanation: 「次の取締役会は何日か」。5月15日と日付で答えている。取締役の経歴や会議室の場所は日付に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the mail arrive this morning?
choices: The mail room is on the first floor.
No, it's coming this afternoon.
Our mailing list has been updated.
questions.explanation: 「今朝郵便は届かなかったのか」に「いいえ、今日の午後に届く」と否定して答えている。郵便室の場所や、宛名リストの更新は届いたかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: What's the best way to get to the stadium?
choices: The best seats are in the north stand.
The way to the stadium is closed for repairs.
Take the subway to Central Station, then walk five minutes.
questions.explanation: 「スタジアムへの最適な行き方」。地下鉄でセントラル駅まで行き、5分歩くと経路で答えている。best の語を使う座席の話や、way を繰り返す道路封鎖の話は行き方に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the cafeteria serving breakfast today?
choices: No, only lunch and dinner. Breakfast starts again on Monday.
The breakfast menu is on the website.
The cafeteria staff are very friendly.
questions.explanation: 「食堂は今日朝食を出しているか」。出していないと答え、再開は月曜だと補足している。メニューや店員の話は、朝食の有無に答えていない。

questions.question: Why did the printer stop working?
choices: The paper jammed, and nobody fixed it.
The printer is on the second floor.
The printer works on both sides of the paper.
questions.explanation: 「プリンターが止まった理由は何か」。紙詰まりを放置したと理由で答えている。場所や両面印刷の話は、止まった理由に答えていない。

questions.question: Should we hold the workshop indoors or outdoors?
choices: The workshop starts at nine.
The outdoor café is closed on Mondays.
Indoors, since the forecast says rain.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「研修を屋内でやるか屋外でやるか」。屋内を選び、予報では雨だと理由を述べている。開始時刻や、カフェの定休日は、どちらでやるかに答えていない。

questions.question: I'm not sure whether the new desks have been ordered yet.
choices: Not yet. The budget approval is still pending.
The desks are on the third floor.
The desk clerk is very helpful.
questions.explanation: 「新しい机をもう注文したか分からない」という発言に、まだで予算の承認が保留中だと答えている。机の場所や、受付係の話は、注文の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: How often does the manager review the monthly figures?
choices: At the end of each month, before the board convenes.
The figures were checked by the new accountant.
The review will be held in the main room.
questions.explanation: 「部長は毎月の数字をどのくらいの頻度で確認するか」。毎月末、取締役会の前だと、頻度を言い換えて答えている。担当者や会議室の話は頻度に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's driving the client back to the airport?
choices: Kevin offered. He has a car.
The train leaves from platform three.
Yes, the client is leaving tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「取引先を空港まで送るのは誰か」。ケビンが名乗り出て、車があると理由を述べている。電車のホームや、帰る日の話は、送る人に答えていない。

questions.question: How soon can we get the report done?
choices: The deadline is on the third floor.
The report was printed in color last week.
We'll need two more days, so it's tight.
questions.explanation: 「報告書はどのくらいで終えられるか」。あと2日必要で、ぎりぎりだと間接的に伝えている。deadline の場所や、カラー印刷の話は、かかる時間に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the lobby renovation going to close the entrance?
choices: The lobby renovation was expensive.
Only the west door, so the main entrance stays open.
The entrance fee for the museum is high.
questions.explanation: 「ロビーの改修で入口は閉まるのではないか」という確認に、閉まるのは西側のドアだけで、正面入口は使えると答えている。費用の話や、美術館の入場料は、入口が閉まるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: I'm having trouble finding the training materials.
choices: The trouble started on Monday, I think.
Training begins next Wednesday.
They're in the blue folder by the window.
questions.explanation: 「研修資料が見つからない」に「窓際の青いファイルにある」と場所を答えている。trouble の始まりや研修の開始日は、資料の場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Who'll be presenting the quarterly results?
choices: Ask the finance team. Their director has been preparing the slides all week.
The quarterly report was distributed on Monday.
Results are usually presented in the big hall.
questions.explanation: 「四半期の結果を発表するのは誰か」。名前は出さず、財務チームの部長が1週間スライドを準備していると伝え、発表者を推測させている。報告書の配布日や発表の場所は、誰が発表するかに答えていない。

questions.question: Would you like to join us for dinner after the conference?
choices: The conference dinner is in the hotel ballroom.
I'd love to, but I promised my daughter I'd be home early.
The chicken is better than the fish.
questions.explanation: 「会議のあと夕食に来ないか」という誘いに、娘と早く帰る約束があると、間接的に断っている。夕食の会場や料理の好みは、誘いへの返事になっていない。

questions.question: Didn't the consultants finish their review yesterday?
choices: The consultants' office is near the station.
They're still going over the numbers, so they'll take another day.
The review of the old contract was finished last year.
questions.explanation: 「コンサルタントは昨日検討を終えていないのか」という確認に、まだ数字を確認中で、もう1日かかると答えている。事務所の場所や、昔の契約の検討の話は、昨日の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you find a more affordable venue for the party?
choices: The party is on the seventh floor.
I've already looked into three places, and they're all out of our range.
The party planner sent us a new invoice.
questions.explanation: 「もっと安い会場を探せるか」。3か所当たったが、どこも予算を超えていたと伝え、見つからなかったことを示している。party や planner の語を使う応答は、会場探しの結果に答えていない。

questions.question: When are the new interns starting?
choices: The orientation was moved to Wednesday, so they'll start then.
The training room is on the second floor.
The interns are from several universities.
questions.explanation: 「新しいインターン生はいつから来るか」。オリエンテーションが水曜に延びたので、その日から始まると答えている。研修室の場所や大学の話は、開始日に答えていない。

questions.question: I heard the lab is still testing the new sensor.
choices: The sensor is on the top shelf.
The lab coats were sent to the cleaners.
They finished last week, but the results were rejected, so they're starting over.
questions.explanation: 「研究室は新しいセンサーをまだ試験していると聞いた」に、先週いったん終えたが結果が却下されたため、やり直していると答えている。shelf や lab coats の語を使う応答は、試験の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Haven't the bonuses been paid out yet?
choices: The bonus program was announced in May.
The payroll office moved to the second floor.
They went out Friday, but some went to wrong accounts.
questions.explanation: 「ボーナスはまだ支払われていないのか」。金曜に支払ったが、数人分は別の口座に振り込まれてしまったと答えている。制度の発表時期や事務所の移転は、支払いの状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the Berlin trip still happening next week?
choices: It was, until the client canceled the meeting there.
Next week's schedule is posted on the wall.
Berlin is a lovely city in the spring.
questions.explanation: 「来週のベルリン出張はまだ行われるのではないか」に、取引先がそこでの会議を取り消したので、もう行われないと答えている。予定表やベルリンの印象は、出張の有無に答えていない。

questions.question: Did the auditors approve the new accounting system?
choices: They did, but only with a six-month trial.
The accounting system was installed last spring.
The auditors' office is on the north side.
questions.explanation: 「監査人は新しい会計システムを承認したか」。承認したが、6か月の試用期間が条件だったと答えている。導入の時期や監査人の事務所の場所は、承認の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Can we still use the old conference room for the workshop?
choices: Not unless we move the storage boxes out first.
The workshop starts at nine in the morning.
The conference room has a new projector.
questions.explanation: 「研修に旧会議室をまだ使えるか」。先に保管箱を出さなければ使えないと、条件付きで答えている。開始時刻や設備の話は、使えるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: What time is the flight to Seoul?
choices: Seoul is a beautiful city.
It leaves at seven in the morning.
I've never flown on that airline before.
questions.explanation: 「ソウル行きの便は何時か」。午前7時発と時刻で答えている。都市の感想や航空会社の経験は、時刻に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you know where the spare keys are?
choices: The key to the storage room is missing.
I'd like to know where you're going.
Yes, they're in the top drawer of my desk.
questions.explanation: 「予備の鍵がどこにあるか知っているか」。Yes と、机の一番上の引き出しという場所で答えている。保管室の鍵の話や行き先を聞く応答は、鍵の場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's the new office manager?
choices: The office is on the sixth floor.
Her name is Yuki Sato.
The manager's meeting is on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 「新しい事務所の責任者は誰か」。佐藤ユキという名前で答えている。階数や会議の日は人物に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you like to try the new sandwich shop?
choices: Sure, I've heard it's really good.
The sandwich shop is on Main Street.
Try the new printer on the second floor.
questions.explanation: 「新しいサンドイッチ店に行ってみないか」という誘いに「いいですね。評判がいいと聞いた」と応じている。店の場所やプリンターの話は、誘いへの返事になっていない。

questions.question: The air conditioner is too cold in here.
choices: The air conditioner was installed in May.
I'll adjust it right away.
It's too cold outside, so bring a coat.
questions.explanation: 「ここは冷房が効きすぎている」という苦情に「すぐ調整します」と対応している。設置時期や外の寒さの話は、苦情への対応になっていない。

questions.question: Where's the nearest post office?
choices: The post office is open until five.
Yes, I mailed the package this morning.
There's one across from the library.
questions.explanation: 「いちばん近い郵便局はどこか」。図書館の向かいにあると場所で答えている。営業時間や、Yes で始まる応答は場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't you send the invitations to all the guests?
choices: The invitations were printed in gold.
Not all of them. I still need to find two addresses.
The guests will arrive at six, I think.
questions.explanation: 「招待状は全員に送っていないのか」という確認に、全員ではない、住所が2件分からないと答えている。招待状の印刷や到着時刻は、送ったかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you review my cover letter before I send it?
choices: The letter from the bank came yesterday.
Sure. Send it over, and I'll look at it this afternoon.
The cover of the brochure looks great.
questions.explanation: 「送る前に添え状を見てもらえるか」という依頼に「いいですよ。今日の午後に見ます」と応じている。銀行からの手紙や、パンフレットの表紙は依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: How much did the new laptops cost?
choices: Around eight hundred dollars each.
The laptops are on the second floor.
The laptop bag is in the closet.
questions.explanation: 「新しいノートパソコンはいくらだったか」。1台約800ドルと金額で答えている。置き場所やかばんの話は、値段に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the meeting supposed to start at ten?
choices: The meeting room is on the tenth floor.
It was, but the director asked to move it to eleven.
The start of the new project is next week.
questions.explanation: 「会議は10時に始まる予定ではないか」。予定はそうだったが、部長の依頼で11時に変わったと答えている。会議室の階や新しいプロジェクトの話は、開始時刻に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's taking over Ana's accounts next month?
choices: The leave form is in the drawer.
Her team will divide them up between themselves.
Ana's been working here for ten years.
questions.explanation: 「来月アナの取引先を引き継ぐのは誰か」。チームで分担すると言い換えて答えている。leave form(休暇届)や勤続年数は、誰が引き継ぐかに答えていない。

questions.question: I assume we're still on for the lunch meeting.
choices: Let's keep it, but we'll meet in the café instead.
The lunch menu has changed again.
The meeting room is booked until two.
questions.explanation: 「昼の打ち合わせは予定どおりだと思う」に、予定は残すが会う場所はカフェに変えると答えている。メニューの変更や会議室の予約は、予定の有無に答えていない。

questions.question: Has the marketing team signed off on the poster or the slogan?
choices: Only the poster design. They're still reviewing the slogan.
The poster is on the bulletin board.
The marketing budget was approved last year.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「ポスターとキャッチコピーのどちらを承認したか」。デザインだけ承認し、キャッチコピーはまだ検討中と答えている。掲示板の場所や予算の承認は、どちらの承認かに答えていない。

questions.question: How will the new hires get their laptops?
choices: They'll pick them up at the IT desk on Monday morning.
New hires are welcome to join the team lunch.
The hires were approved by the committee.
questions.explanation: 「新入社員はどうやってノートパソコンを受け取るか」。月曜の午前に情報システムの窓口で受け取ると答えている。昼食会や採用の承認は、受け取り方に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you mind if I took the afternoon off?
choices: Not at all, as long as you finish the report first.
The afternoon session starts at two.
The off-site office is only a short walk.
questions.explanation: 「午後休みを取ってもかまわないか」に「かまいません。報告書を先に終えてくれれば」と許可している。午後の研修の開始時刻や事務所の場所は、許可を求められたことへの返事になっていない。

questions.question: Is anyone available to help set up the booth tomorrow?
choices: The booth is in the east hall.
Priya's on the schedule, but she's leaving early for her flight.
The setup instructions are in the manual.
questions.explanation: 「明日ブースの準備を手伝える人はいるか」。プリヤは予定に入っているが、飛行機のため早く抜けると伝え、手伝える時間が限られることを示している。ブースの場所や説明書の話は、手伝える人に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you like me to pick up the lunch order?
choices: The lunch menu is on the wall.
The lunch hour is from twelve to one.
That's kind of you, but the catering company is already delivering.
questions.explanation: 「昼食を受け取りに行こうか」という申し出に「ご親切に。でも仕出し店がもう届けてくれる」と、間接的に断っている。メニューや昼休みの時間は申し出への返事になっていない。

questions.question: How soon can you have the revised budget ready?
choices: I'll have it on your desk before the director's meeting ends.
The budget was revised in February.
I can't ready the room until noon.
questions.explanation: 「修正した予算はどのくらいで用意できるか」。部長の会議が終わるまでに机に置くと、時期で答えている。改定の時期や、部屋の準備の話は、用意できる時期に答えていない。

questions.question: The printer on the fourth floor is making a loud noise again.
choices: I'll ask the vendor to come take a look on Friday.
The noise from the street is terrible today.
The fourth floor is being painted this week.
questions.explanation: 「4階のプリンターがまた大きな音を立てている」という知らせに「金曜に業者に見てもらうよう頼む」と対応している。通りの騒音や塗装の話は、プリンターの対応になっていない。

questions.question: Wasn't the project canceled?
choices: The project team is very skilled.
It was put on hold, not canceled, and might restart.
Cancel the order for the new chairs.
questions.explanation: 「プロジェクトは中止になったのではないか」に、中止ではなく保留で、再開するかもしれないと訂正している。チームの能力や注文の取り消しは、中止かどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Are we still getting a discount, or has the supplier changed its policy?
choices: It ended last month, and their policy has since changed.
The supplier's discount is printed on the invoice.
Last month's invoice was over budget.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「割引はまだ受けられるか、それとも方針が変わったか」。割引は先月で終わり、方針もその後変わったと答えている。請求書の割引表示や先月の請求額は、どちらかに答えていない。

questions.question: Haven't we already sent the revised proposal?
choices: The proposal was written by the new intern.
The client's office is across the river.
We sent a version on Monday, but the client wants the figures changed.
questions.explanation: 「修正版の提案書はもう送ったのではないか」。月曜に一版を送ったが、取引先が数字の変更を求めているため、まだ最終版ではないと答えている。書いた人や取引先の場所は、送付の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the board going to approve the merger this quarter?
choices: The merger announcement is on the front page.
The board members are flying in from London.
They were planning to, but the legal team found a problem with the contract.
questions.explanation: 「取締役会は今期中に合併を承認するか」。承認するつもりだったが、法務チームが契約に問題を見つけたため、今期中は難しいと伝えている。新聞の記事や取締役の移動は、承認の見通しに答えていない。

questions.question: Did the team finish the training manuals?
choices: The training room was booked all week.
They finished the English version, but translations are delayed.
The manuals are kept in the supply room.
questions.explanation: 「チームは研修マニュアルを完成させたか」。英語版は終わったが、翻訳が遅れていると答えている。研修室の予約や、保管場所は完成したかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Can I still book the seminar room for Tuesday?
choices: I'm afraid not. The seminar moved to the main hall yesterday.
The seminar room has a new projector.
Tuesday is the day of the seminar, right?
questions.explanation: 「火曜のセミナー室をまだ予約できるか」。昨日セミナーがメインホールに移ったので、もう予約できないと答えている。プロジェクターの話や、火曜のセミナーの確認は、予約できるかに答えていない。

questions.question: Who took the last cup of coffee?
choices: The coffee cups are in the cabinet.
The coffee shop was crowded at lunch.
I don't know, but there's a new pot in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 「最後のコーヒーを飲んだのは誰か」。誰かは分からないが、台所に新しいポットがあると答えている。カップの場所や、喫茶店の混雑は、誰が飲んだかに答えていない。

questions.question: Aren't you ready for the interview?
choices: The interview room is on the seventh floor.
The interviewer is very friendly, I hear.
Almost. I need about five more minutes.
questions.explanation: 「面接の準備はできていないのか」という確認に、ほぼできていて、あと5分ほど必要だと答えている。面接室の階や面接官の評判は、準備の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: How much is a ticket to the concert?
choices: The concert hall is near the river.
Forty dollars for general admission.
The tickets were sold out last week.
questions.explanation: 「コンサートのチケットはいくらか」。一般席は40ドルと金額で答えている。会場の場所や、売り切れた時期は値段に答えていない。

questions.question: Let's grab some lunch before the workshop.
choices: The workshop is on the second floor.
The lunch special is chicken today.
Good idea. I'm starving.
questions.explanation: 「研修の前に昼食をとろう」という提案に「いいですね。お腹がすいた」と賛成している。研修の場所や日替わりメニューは、提案への返事になっていない。

questions.question: You're the new accountant, aren't you?
choices: The accounts are in the cabinet.
The new account is very large.
Yes, I started on Monday.
questions.explanation: 「あなたは新しい経理担当ですよね」という確認に、Yes と月曜に着任したと答えている。書類の保管場所や、大口の口座の話は、確認に答えていない。

questions.question: I assume you brought the spare keys.
choices: The key ring is in the drawer.
I brought my laptop and a spare battery.
I didn't. They're still in the office.
questions.explanation: 「予備の鍵は持ってきたと思う」という発言に、持ってこなかった、まだ事務所にあると答えている。鍵束の場所や、持ってきた物の話は、鍵を持ってきたかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Should we send the invoice today or wait for the approval?
choices: The invoice is printed on white paper.
We should have sent the approval earlier.
Let's wait. The manager wants to check the amounts first.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。待つほうを選び、部長が金額を先に確認したいと理由を述べている。用紙の色や、承認を先に送るべきだった話は、どちらを選ぶかに答えていない。

questions.question: Who's going to lead the workshop this afternoon?
choices: The workshop is in room twelve.
The afternoon train was delayed.
Maria offered to, since she's done it before.
questions.explanation: 「今日の午後の研修の講師は誰か」。マリアが名乗り出て、前にもやったことがあると答えている。部屋番号や電車の遅れは、講師に答えていない。

questions.question: The projector isn't turning on again.
choices: The projector was bought last year.
Try unplugging it and plugging it back in.
The turning point of the presentation is on slide ten.
questions.explanation: 「プロジェクターがまた点かない」に「いったん電源を抜いて差し直してみて」と対処法を答えている。購入時期や発表の転換点の話は、対応になっていない。

questions.question: I heard the airport bus left late this morning.
choices: That's right. It left twenty minutes late because of traffic.
The airport bus stop is across the road.
The bus driver was very friendly.
questions.explanation: 「空港行きのバスは今朝遅れて出たと聞いた」に、そのとおりで、渋滞で20分遅れたと答えている。停留所の場所や運転手の態度は、遅れたことへの応答になっていない。

questions.question: What's the cause of the delay on line four?
choices: Line four is the one by the window.
A worn belt on the conveyor needs replacing.
There's a delay in the schedule for line six.
questions.explanation: 「4号ラインの遅れの原因は何か」。コンベヤーのベルトが摩耗していて交換が必要だと、原因を言い換えて答えている。ラインの場所や別ラインの遅れは、原因に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the head office going to move?
choices: The movie starts at seven, I think.
The head office has a nice garden.
The lease is up in June, so they're looking for space.
questions.explanation: 「本社は移転するのか」。賃貸契約が6月に切れるので、場所を探していると、間接的に移転の可能性を伝えている。movie は move の同音のひっかけ。本社の庭の話は、移転するかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Will the new policy affect our vacation days?
choices: The policy was printed in blue ink.
Vacations are very popular this time of year.
Only for people who joined after April, so most of us are fine.
questions.explanation: 「新しい規則は有給休暇に影響するか」。4月以降に入った人だけが対象なので、たいていの人には影響しないと答えている。印刷の色や休暇の人気は、影響の有無に答えていない。

questions.question: Can you give me a ride to the hotel?
choices: The hotel's ride to the airport is free.
I'd like to, but my car is in the shop today.
The hotel has a new restaurant.
questions.explanation: 「ホテルまで乗せてもらえるか」。乗せたいが、今日は車が修理工場にあると、間接的に断っている。空港までの送迎の話や、ホテルのレストランは、乗せられるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Shall we present the findings to the board or to the division heads?
choices: The division heads first, then the board in a few weeks.
The findings were surprising, I think.
The division's budget was approved in May.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。事業部長に先に、取締役会には数週間後にと、両方の順番を答えている。結果の印象や予算の承認は、どちらに発表するかに答えていない。

questions.question: Who's going to lead the Friday training?
choices: Mr. Hashimoto is out sick, so the training manager is stepping in.
The training materials were updated last year.
Friday is the busiest day of the week.
questions.explanation: 「金曜の研修を担当するのは誰か」。橋本さんが病欠のため、研修責任者が代わりに入ると、人名を出さずに伝えている。教材の更新や曜日の忙しさは、担当者に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you think we can finish the report by Thursday?
choices: If the sales data comes in by noon, we might.
The report's cover page is still blank.
The sales team went on a trip last Thursday.
questions.explanation: 「木曜までに報告書を仕上げられると思うか」。売上データが正午までに届けば可能かもしれないと、条件付きで答えている。表紙の空白や営業チームの旅行は、仕上げられるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Have you heard whether the new branch will open in March?
choices: The new branch manager is from Kobe.
The contractors have pushed it back, so probably not.
The branch office is near the station.
questions.explanation: 「新しい支店は3月に開店するか聞いているか」。工事業者が延期したので、たぶん3月ではないと答えている。支店長の出身地や支店の場所は、開店時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you look over this contract before I sign it?
choices: Sign here, and the contract is complete.
I'm about to leave, but I'll have a quick look tomorrow.
The contract's terms are in the appendix.
questions.explanation: 「署名する前に契約書を見てもらえるか」。今は出かけるが、明日すぐ見ると答えている。sign の語を使う応答や、付録の話は、今見てもらえるかに答えていない。

questions.question: Did the complaint about the shipping delays get resolved?
choices: The shipping department moved to a new building.
The customer's been calling every day, so I doubt it.
Delays are common during the holiday season.
questions.explanation: 「配送の遅れの苦情は解決したか」。客が毎日電話してくるので、解決していないと思うと答えている。部署の移転や、休暇期間の遅れの話は、解決したかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Is the Monday trip to the factory still on?
choices: Not on Monday. The factory asked us to postpone it to next month.
The factory is three hours from here.
The factory has a new production line.
questions.explanation: 「月曜の工場見学はまだ予定どおりか」。月曜には行わず、工場側の求めで来月に延期すると答えている。工場までの距離や生産ラインの話は、予定どおりかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the chef say the menu would change?
choices: He did, but he changed his mind after the supplier's price increase.
The menu is printed on heavy paper.
The chef's apron is in the laundry room.
questions.explanation: 「シェフはメニューを変えると言わなかったか」。言ったが、仕入れ値の上昇を受けて考えを変えたと答えている。用紙やエプロンの場所は、メニューが変わるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: I assume we still need a permit to hold the fair.
choices: The fair is held every spring in the park.
Not anymore. The city dropped that requirement last month.
The permit office closes at four on Fridays.
questions.explanation: 「催事を開くのに許可はまだ必要だと思う」に、もう必要ない、市が先月その要件をなくしたと訂正している。開催時期や事務所の閉まる時刻は、許可の要否に答えていない。

questions.question: Have the interview candidates arrived yet?
choices: The candidates' resumes are in the folder.
The interview room has a new table.
Two have. The third one called to say she was stuck in traffic.
questions.explanation: 「面接の候補者は到着したか」。2人は来たが、3人目は渋滞で遅れると連絡があったと答えている。履歴書の保管場所や部屋の机は、到着の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Can we still use the rooftop garden for the event?
choices: The event garden is open from April.
We could, until the city told us the roof is being inspected.
The rooftop bar serves great coffee.
questions.explanation: 「イベントに屋上の庭をまだ使えるか」。使えたが、市から屋根の点検が入ると連絡があったと答えている。庭の開放時期やバーのコーヒーは、使えるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: What's the best day to visit the museum?
choices: The museum opens at nine.
Wednesday, because it's quieter then.
I visited the museum last summer.
questions.explanation: 「美術館を訪れるのに最適な曜日はいつか」。水曜は空いているので、と曜日で答えている。開館時刻や過去の訪問の話は、曜日に答えていない。

questions.question: Are you going to the conference next month?
choices: The conference center is downtown.
The next month's budget is ready.
Yes, I've already booked my flight.
questions.explanation: 「来月の会議に行くのか」に Yes と、飛行機を予約済みだと答えている。会場の場所や予算の話は、行くかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you tell me how to use the scanner?
choices: The scanner is on the second floor.
The report explains the findings in detail.
Sure, press the green button and select the folder.
questions.explanation: 「スキャナーの使い方を教えてもらえるか」に「もちろん、緑のボタンを押してフォルダーを選ぶ」と手順を答えている。設置場所や報告書の内容は、使い方に答えていない。

questions.question: Shall we order sushi or pizza for the team?
choices: Let's get sushi. Half the team said they're tired of pizza.
The team has a meeting on Thursday.
The team's pizza party was last month.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。寿司を選び、半分の人がピザに飽きたと言っていたと理由を述べている。会議の日や過去のパーティーは、どちらを頼むかに答えていない。

questions.question: Your presentation was really informative.
choices: Thank you. I spent a lot of time on the charts.
The presentation starts at two.
The informal dinner was on Friday.
questions.explanation: 「発表はとても参考になった」という感想に「ありがとうございます。グラフに時間をかけました」と応じている。開始時刻や食事会の話は、感想への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Where did you put the new brochures?
choices: In the storage closet by the copier.
The new brochures look great.
I put the brochures on the old list.
questions.explanation: 「新しいパンフレットをどこに置いたか」。コピー機の横の保管室と場所で答えている。できばえの感想や、リストの話は場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Haven't you seen the updated price list?
choices: Yes, it came out this morning.
The price of the lunch was reasonable.
The updated version of the software is out.
questions.explanation: 「更新された価格表はまだ見ていないのか」という確認に、Yes と今朝出たと答えている。昼食の値段やソフトの新版の話は、価格表を見たかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the manager ask for a new laptop?
choices: The laptop battery lasts about six hours.
She did, but the budget was approved for a new printer instead.
The manager's office is on the eighth floor.
questions.explanation: 「部長は新しいノートパソコンを求めていなかったか」。求めたが、予算は代わりにプリンターに承認されたと答えている。バッテリーの持ち時間や部長室の場所は、求めたかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: What's the schedule for the training next week?
choices: It runs Monday to Wednesday, from nine to noon.
The training room has new chairs.
Next week's sales report is due Friday.
questions.explanation: 「来週の研修の日程は」。月曜から水曜の午前9時から正午までと答えている。研修室の椅子や、売上報告の締め切りは日程に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you like a copy of the report?
choices: The report has twenty pages.
I'll copy the file onto my laptop.
Yes, please. Could you send it to my e-mail?
questions.explanation: 「報告書のコピーはいるか」に「はい、メールで送ってください」と依頼を添えて答えている。ページ数や、ファイルを自分のパソコンに入れる話は、答えになっていない。

questions.question: How often do the city inspectors visit the site?
choices: The inspectors' vehicle is parked outside.
They come by about once a quarter, usually unannounced.
The site visit will take about four hours.
questions.explanation: 「市の検査官は現場をどのくらいの頻度で訪れるか」。四半期に1回程度で、たいてい予告なしだと答えている。車の停め場所や視察にかかる時間は、頻度に答えていない。

questions.question: Would you mind rescheduling the call?
choices: Not at all. Tuesday morning is better for me.
The call was scheduled for Tuesday.
Yes, I'll reschedule the coffee machine.
questions.explanation: 「電話の予定を変えてもらえるか」に「かまいません。火曜の午前のほうが都合がいい」と応じている。Tuesday の語を使う応答や、coffee machine を使った応答は、変更を承諾していない。

questions.question: Do you know if the lobby is being repainted this week?
choices: The lobby's new plants arrived yesterday.
I think the lobby is on the first floor.
The painters are waiting for their paint order, so it's delayed.
questions.explanation: 「今週ロビーの塗り替えは行われるか」。塗料の注文を待っていて遅れていると答えている。植物の搬入や、ロビーの階の話は、塗り替えの予定に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's the best person to talk to about the lease?
choices: Ask the property manager. She handles all the contracts.
The lease for the warehouse expires in June.
The best time to talk is after lunch.
questions.explanation: 「賃貸契約について誰に話すのがよいか」。不動産管理者に聞くよう言い、すべての契約を担当していると理由を述べている。倉庫の契約期限や話をする時間は、相手に答えていない。

questions.question: Why did we switch to the new delivery company?
choices: The new delivery vans are painted white.
The company's new logo was designed in-house.
The old one kept missing the deadlines.
questions.explanation: 「なぜ新しい配送会社に変えたのか」。前の会社が納期を何度も守れなかったからと理由で答えている。車の色やロゴの話は、変えた理由に答えていない。

questions.question: When will the new chairs be delivered?
choices: The truck broke down, so I wouldn't count on it today.
The chairs are very comfortable, I think.
The loading dock is on the north side.
questions.explanation: 「新しい椅子はいつ届くか」。トラックが高速道路で故障したので、今日の午後は当てにしないほうがいいと、間接的に伝えている。椅子の座り心地や搬入口の場所は、届く時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you want to present first or second?
choices: The first presentation is at nine.
I'd rather go second, after I've seen the other team's data.
The presentation slides were updated last night.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。2番目を選び、他のチームのデータを見てからにしたいと理由を述べている。発表の開始時刻やスライドの更新は、どちらを選ぶかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you proofread this article before it goes to print?
choices: I'm in a meeting until three, but I'll be done by four.
The article was printed in the newspaper.
I printed my ticket at the airport.
questions.explanation: 「印刷の前にこの記事を校正してもらえるか」。3時まで会議だが、4時までには終えると、遅れて引き受けている。新聞に載った記事や空港で印刷した切符は、校正の依頼に答えていない。

questions.question: I think the new hire hasn't gotten her badge yet.
choices: She's still waiting for security to approve her photo.
The hire was announced in the newsletter.
Her badge is a bright shade of blue.
questions.explanation: 「新入社員はまだバッジを受け取っていないと思う」に、警備が写真を承認するのをまだ待っていると答えている。社報の発表やバッジの色は、受け取りの状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Has the team picked a new name for the project yet?
choices: The project is due next year.
The team's picnic is in the park.
They've shortlisted three names, and the vote is next week.
questions.explanation: 「チームはプロジェクトの新しい名前をもう決めたか」。候補を3つに絞り、投票は来週と答えている。締め切りや、ピクニックの話は、名前が決まったかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Are the lab results ready for the board?
choices: The lab is on the third floor.
The board's dinner was canceled.
They were, but errors in the second batch mean a rerun.
questions.explanation: 「研究結果は取締役会に出せる状態か」。いったんは準備できていたが、2回目の試料で誤りが見つかり再試験になったと答えている。研究室の階や夕食会の中止は、準備状況に答えていない。

questions.question: I thought the ferry was canceled for today.
choices: The ferry terminal has a new café.
It was, but the operator restored the service this morning.
Today's weather is perfect for sailing.
questions.explanation: 「今日のフェリーは欠航だと思っていた」。欠航だったが、運航会社が今朝運航を再開したと答えている。ターミナルのカフェや天気の話は、運航の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Did the city approve the new bus route?
choices: The bus route map is on the website.
Bus drivers are being trained next month.
Not yet. They asked for changes to the stops near the school.
questions.explanation: 「市は新しいバス路線を承認したか」に「まだです。学校の近くの停留所の変更を求められた」と答えている。地図の掲載や運転手の研修は、承認の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the expense report due today?
choices: Expense forms are kept in the blue binder.
The accountant's office is on the fifth floor.
It was, but the accounting team extended the deadline to Friday.
questions.explanation: 「経費精算は今日が締め切りではないか」。締め切りは今日だったが、経理チームが金曜まで延ばしたと答えている。用紙の保管場所や事務所の階は、締め切りに答えていない。

questions.question: Can we still use the cafeteria's private dining room on Friday, or is it booked?
choices: Not Friday. The caterer booked it for a retirement party.
The dining room has eight tables and a view.
The Friday special is curry.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「金曜に個室を使えるか、それとも予約済みか」。金曜は使えず、仕出し業者が退職パーティーに予約したと答えている。テーブルの数や金曜の特別メニューは、どちらかに答えていない。

questions.question: What's the phone number for the hotel?
choices: The hotel's lobby is very modern.
Yes, the phone line is working now.
It's on the back of the brochure.
questions.explanation: 「ホテルの電話番号は」。パンフレットの裏に書いてあると、場所で答えている。ロビーの雰囲気や、Yes で始まる応答は番号に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the elevator working today?
choices: The elevator is on the left side.
The stairs are on the right.
Yes, it was fixed this morning.
questions.explanation: 「エレベーターは今日動いているか」に Yes と、今朝修理されたと答えている。位置や階段の場所は、動いているかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Who's the speaker at the seminar?
choices: Professor Kato from the university.
The seminar starts at one thirty.
The speakers' lounge is upstairs.
questions.explanation: 「セミナーの講師は誰か」。大学の加藤教授と人名で答えている。開始時刻や控室の場所は、講師に答えていない。

questions.question: Let's start the meeting at nine.
choices: The meeting was held on Monday.
The start button is on the left.
That works for me. See you then.
questions.explanation: 「会議は9時に始めよう」という提案に「大丈夫です。では後ほど」と応じている。過去の会議の日や、スタートボタンの位置は、提案への返事になっていない。

questions.question: What's the weather going to be like tomorrow?
choices: The weather report is on the radio.
Tomorrow is the first day of the sale.
Cloudy, with a chance of rain in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「明日の天気はどうか」。曇りで午後は雨の可能性があると答えている。天気予報をどこで聞くかや、セールの初日は、天気の内容に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you send me the agenda for the workshop?
choices: The workshop agenda is on the third floor.
I'll forward it as soon as the coordinator sends it.
Yes, the workshop was great.
questions.explanation: 「研修の議題を送ってもらえるか」に「調整役から届き次第、転送します」と応じている。agenda の語を使った場所の話や、研修の感想は依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Did you find a place to park?
choices: The place is very crowded at noon.
Yes, in the garage next to the office.
The park across the street is nice.
questions.explanation: 「停める場所は見つかったか」に Yes と、事務所の隣の車庫だと答えている。place や park の繰り返しを含む応答は、場所が見つかったかに答えていない。

questions.question: Why are the windows open?
choices: The air conditioning is broken again.
The windows face the courtyard.
Open the door, please.
questions.explanation: 「なぜ窓が開いているのか」。冷房がまた壊れていると理由を答えている。窓の向きや、ドアを開けてほしいという依頼は、窓が開いている理由に答えていない。

questions.question: How did the interview go?
choices: The interview room has a view of the bay.
Go straight, then turn right at the bridge.
I think it went well. They asked me about my overseas experience.
questions.explanation: 「面接はどうだったか」に「うまくいったと思う。海外経験について聞かれた」と答えている。部屋からの眺めや道順は、面接の様子に答えていない。

questions.question: Have you seen my jacket?
choices: The jacket is on sale this week.
It's on the back of your chair.
The jacket size chart is in the store.
questions.explanation: 「私の上着を見なかったか」に「あなたの椅子の背にかかっている」と場所で答えている。セール品の話やサイズ表は、上着の場所に答えていない。

questions.question: How soon can the contractor start the repairs?
choices: The repairs cost more than we expected.
The contractor's name is on the sign.
He's free after the holiday, so early next month.
questions.explanation: 「業者はいつ修理を始められるか」。休み明けなので来月初めになると答えている。修理の費用や業者の名前は、開始時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you think the client will accept our terms?
choices: The terms were printed in very small type.
The client's office is on the twentieth floor.
They've been reasonable so far, so I'm optimistic.
questions.explanation: 「取引先は我々の条件を受け入れると思うか」。今までは妥当な対応なので楽観していると、見通しを述べている。文字の大きさや取引先の階は、受け入れの見込みに答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't you say the flight was at six?
choices: The flight attendant was very friendly.
It was, but the airline moved it up to four o'clock.
I said the wrong thing at the meeting.
questions.explanation: 「便は6時だと言わなかったか」。6時だったが、航空会社が4時に早めたと答えている。客室乗務員の態度や会議での発言は、便の時刻に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you recommend a hotel near the convention center?
choices: The convention was recommended by the mayor.
The one across the street from the entrance is quite popular.
The center of the city is very crowded.
questions.explanation: 「会議場の近くのホテルを勧めてもらえるか」に、入口の向かいのホテルが人気だと答えている。市長が勧めた会議や、市の中心部の混雑は、ホテルの推薦に答えていない。

questions.question: Shall we stay late tonight or head home at six?
choices: I'd rather not. My train leaves at six.
The late train was canceled.
The stay at the hotel was pleasant.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「今夜残るか、6時に帰るか」。6時に帰りたいと、電車の時刻を理由に答えている。遅い電車の運休や、ホテルでの滞在は、どちらにするかに答えていない。

questions.question: I heard the auditors found some errors in the report.
choices: They found a few, but nothing that changes the totals.
The auditors' office is downtown.
The report was published in the spring issue.
questions.explanation: 「監査人は報告書にいくつか誤りを見つけたと聞いた」に、いくつか見つかったが合計額を変えるものはないと答えている。監査人の事務所の場所や掲載号の話は、誤りの内容に答えていない。

questions.question: Should I send the updated figures to the whole team or just the managers?
choices: The team meeting is at three.
The figures for the summer are high.
Just the managers. The rest of them only need the summary.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「全員に送るか管理職だけか」。管理職だけでよく、残りの人は要約だけで足りると答えている。会議の時刻や夏の数字は、どちらに送るかに答えていない。

questions.question: Do you know whether the board accepted the proposal?
choices: They're meeting again on the twentieth, so nothing's settled yet.
The proposal was forty pages long.
The board room has a new projector.
