questions.explanation: 「取締役会は提案を受け入れたか」。20日にもう一度会議があり、まだ何も決まっていないと答えている。提案書の長さや会議室の設備は、受け入れの有無に答えていない。

questions.question: How many people have signed up for the retreat?
choices: The retreat is at a lake resort.
The registration page crashed, so the count is unclear.
We signed the contract with the resort yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「合宿に何人申し込んだか」。申込ページが不具合で止まり、人数がはっきりしないと答えている。場所や契約の話は、申込人数に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you check whether the vendor has sent the invoice?
choices: I already checked this morning, and it's sitting in the inbox.
The vendor's office is on the first floor.
The invoice template was updated in May.
questions.explanation: 「業者は請求書を送ってきたか確認してもらえるか」。今朝確認済みで、受信箱に届いていると答えている。業者の事務所の階や雛形の更新は、送付の確認に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the manager say the reorganization would start in April?
choices: The reorganization chart is on the wall.
She did, but it was pushed to the fall after the union objected.
April is the best month for the sale.
questions.explanation: 「部長は再編を4月に始めると言わなかったか」。言ったが、組合の反対で秋に延びたと答えている。組織図の掲示や、セールの時期は、開始時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the retreat still at the mountain lodge?
choices: The lodge serves dinner until eight.
Not anymore. A storm damaged the lodge's roof last week.
The mountain bike trails are closed.
questions.explanation: 「合宿はまだ山の宿泊施設で行うか」。先週の嵐で屋根が壊れたので、もう使えないと答えている。夕食の時間やサイクリングコースの話は、場所の変更に答えていない。

questions.question: I heard the team has finished the audit.
choices: The auditors' report is in the drawer.
They've finished the first phase, but the second one was postponed.
The team went out for lunch together.
questions.explanation: 「チームは監査を終えたと聞いた」に、第1段階は終えたが第2段階は延期されたと訂正している。報告書の保管場所やランチの話は、監査の進み具合に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the mayor approve the new parking plan?
choices: She approved the first draft, but she asked for a few changes.
The parking garage is on Oak Street.
The plan is printed in bright colors.
questions.explanation: 「市長は新しい駐車場の計画を承認しなかったか」。最初の案は承認したが、いくつか修正を求めたと答えている。車庫の場所や計画書の色は、承認の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the storage room still open for staff use?
choices: The storage shelves were moved last week.
The staff room has a new coffee maker.
Only until Wednesday. The facilities team is locking it for the inventory.
questions.explanation: 「保管室はまだ職員が使えるか」。水曜までで、施設管理チームが棚卸しのために閉鎖すると答えている。棚の移動や休憩室の設備は、使えるかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: How was your flight?
choices: Smooth, though the food was terrible.
The flight attendants are on the third floor.
I usually take the early train.
questions.explanation: 「飛行機はどうだったか」。快適だったが、機内食はひどかったと感想で答えている。客室乗務員の階や、いつもの電車の話は、感想に答えていない。

questions.question: Where's the nearest subway station?
choices: The station is very busy at rush hour.
Two blocks east, past the bank.
Yes, I took the subway this morning.
questions.explanation: 「いちばん近い地下鉄の駅はどこか」。銀行を過ぎて2ブロック東と場所で答えている。混雑の話や、Yes で始まる応答は場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Did you call the caterer?
choices: The caterer's van is parked outside.
The call was about twenty minutes long.
Yes, they confirmed the order this morning.
questions.explanation: 「仕出し業者に電話したか」に Yes と、今朝注文を確認してくれたと答えている。車が停まっている話や通話の長さは、電話をしたかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you lock the door on your way out?
choices: The door to the lobby is made of glass.
Sure. I'll do it right now.
The way out is through the cafeteria.
questions.explanation: 「出るときにドアの鍵をかけてもらえるか」に「もちろん、今すぐやります」と応じている。ロビーのドアの素材や出口の経路は、依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Which room is free for the interview?
choices: The interview is at two o'clock.
Room 3B is open all afternoon.
The free trial starts tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「面接にどの部屋が空いているか」。部屋番号を挙げて、その部屋が午後ずっと空いていると答えている。面接の時刻や無料試用の話は、部屋に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't anyone pick up the dry-cleaning this morning?
choices: The dry-cleaner is open until seven.
The morning shift started at eight.
No, I'm going over there at lunch.
questions.explanation: 「今朝、誰もクリーニングを取りに行っていないのか」という確認に、いいえ、昼に自分が行くと答えている。店の営業時間や朝番の開始時刻は、取りに行ったかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Have you given the presentation to the board yet?
choices: The board members are very patient.
Not yet. It's scheduled for next Tuesday.
The presentation room has a big screen.
questions.explanation: 「取締役会で発表はもうしたか」に「まだです。来週の火曜の予定」と答えている。役員の性格や会議室の画面は、発表の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you check the inventory before the end of the day?
choices: The inventory was checked last month.
The end of the day is at five.
I'll count the shelves first, then update the list.
questions.explanation: 「終業前に在庫を確認してもらえるか」に「まず棚を数えて、リストを更新します」と応じている。先月の在庫確認や終業時刻は、依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Why is the office so quiet today?
choices: Half the staff is at the training session downtown.
The office is on the quiet side of the building.
Today's quiz is about office procedures.
questions.explanation: 「今日は事務所がなぜこんなに静かか」。職員の半分が市内で研修を受けていると理由で答えている。建物の静かな側や、クイズの話は、静かな理由に答えていない。

questions.question: Do you have time to meet after lunch?
choices: I'm free from two, if that works.
Lunch is served from eleven to two.
Time flies when you're having fun.
questions.explanation: 「昼食のあと打ち合わせの時間はあるか」に「2時からなら空いている」と答えている。食事の提供時間や「時間が経つのは早い」という感想は、空き時間に答えていない。

questions.question: What's the cause of the leak in the kitchen?
choices: The kitchen was remodeled in the spring.
The leak hasn't been reported to the landlord yet.
The pipe under the sink was cracked by the freeze last night.
questions.explanation: 「台所の水漏れの原因は何か」。夜の冷え込みで、流し台の下の配管にひびが入ったと答えている。改装の時期や、大家への連絡の話は、原因に答えていない。

questions.question: Is the agent available to take my call?
choices: She's out until Thursday, but her colleague can help.
The agent's name was on the envelope.
The call center opens at eight.
questions.explanation: 「担当者は私の電話に出られるか」。木曜まで不在だが、同僚が対応できると答えている。封筒の名前や、コールセンターの開始時刻は、担当者が出られるかに答えていない。

questions.question: Do you think we'll need extra staff for the launch?
choices: We'll probably need to hire two temps, based on last year.
The launch party was a great success.
The staff picnic is next Friday.
questions.explanation: 「発売に人員を追加する必要があるか」。去年の実績から、派遣社員を2人雇うことになりそうだと答えている。発売パーティーの成功や社員ピクニックの話は、人員の必要性に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you tell the client the shipment is late?
choices: I already emailed them this morning, so they know.
The shipment was loaded onto the truck.
The client's late fee is printed on page six.
questions.explanation: 「取引先に出荷の遅れを伝えてもらえるか」。今朝メールで伝えてあると答えている。トラックへの積み込みや延滞料の記載は、伝達の依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: Did you speak with the landlord about the lease?
choices: The lease is printed on heavy paper.
He's agreed to a lower rent if we renew for two years.
The landlord's dog is very friendly.
questions.explanation: 「大家と賃貸契約について話したか」。2年の更新なら家賃を下げると言われたと、話の内容を答えている。契約書の用紙や大家の飼い犬の話は、話をしたかどうかに答えていない。

questions.question: Could you take the minutes at tomorrow's meeting?
choices: The minutes from last time are in the binder.
I'm presenting at that meeting, so it'd be hard.
Tomorrow's weather forecast is rainy.
questions.explanation: 「明日の会議の議事録を取ってもらえるか」。その会議で発表があるので難しいと、間接的に断っている。前回の議事録の場所や天気予報は、依頼への返事になっていない。

questions.question: I assume the training manual isn't ready for the new staff yet.
choices: The staff room is down the hall.
The training was held in the auditorium.
The writers are still reviewing chapter four.
questions.explanation: 「研修マニュアルは新人向けにまだ準備できていないと思う」に、執筆者が4章をまだ確認中だと答えている。職員室の場所や講堂での研修は、マニュアルの準備状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Why did the client cancel the order?
choices: They got a better offer from one of our competitors.
The order was placed on Tuesday.
The client's order form is in the drawer.
questions.explanation: 「取引先はなぜ注文を取り消したのか」。競合他社からより良い条件の提案を受けたと理由を答えている。注文日や注文書の保管場所は、理由に答えていない。

questions.question: Didn't the trainees complete the online course?
choices: The course was developed by an outside company.
Most of them did, but three still have the final quiz to take.
The trainees' room is on the second floor.
questions.explanation: 「研修生はオンライン講座を修了していないのか」という確認に、大半は修了したが、3人は最終テストが残っていると答えている。講座の開発元や研修生の部屋の場所は、修了の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Shall we hire a consultant for the project, or handle it internally?
choices: The consultants' office is in the next building.
The internal phone list was updated.
Internally, since the consultant's fees are beyond our budget.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文。社内で対応すると選び、コンサルタントの費用が予算を超えるからと理由を述べている。事務所の場所や電話番号表は、どちらにするかに答えていない。

questions.question: Is the warehouse still receiving shipments on Saturdays?
choices: The warehouse has large windows.
Not anymore. They stopped when the lease ended in June.
Saturday shipments are always delayed.
questions.explanation: 「倉庫は今も土曜に荷物を受け取っているか」。賃貸契約が6月に切れてから、受け取りをやめたと答えている。窓の大きさや、土曜の出荷の遅れは、受け取りの有無に答えていない。

questions.question: I hear the client has read the revised quote.
choices: They read it, but they asked for a lower price again.
The quote was printed on blue paper.
The client is a major manufacturer.
questions.explanation: 「取引先は修正後の見積もりを読んだと聞いた」に、読んだが、もう一度値下げを求められたと答えている。用紙の色や取引先の業種は、その後の経緯に答えていない。

questions.question: Can we still change the date of the workshop?
choices: The workshop date is on the calendar.
Only if the venue has a free date. It's fully booked.
The venue manager is very helpful.
questions.explanation: 「研修の日程をまだ変更できるか」。会場に空きがあれば可能だが、今月は予約で埋まっていると答えている。カレンダーの記載や会場の担当者の印象は、変更できるかに答えていない。

questions.question: Did the marketing team finish the brochure?
choices: The brochure is printed on glossy paper.
The marketing budget was reduced last year.
Almost. They're waiting on the final photos from the photographer.
questions.explanation: 「マーケティングチームはパンフレットを仕上げたか」。ほぼ終わったが、カメラマンから最終の写真を待っていると答えている。用紙の種類や予算の削減は、完成の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: Haven't the sales figures for Asia been released?
choices: The Asian market is growing rapidly.
They were released on Monday, but the numbers were corrected yesterday.
The release party is on the rooftop.
questions.explanation: 「アジアの売上データはまだ公表されていないのか」。月曜に公表されたが、昨日数字が訂正されたと答えている。市場の成長や公表記念パーティーの話は、公表の状況に答えていない。

questions.question: How many people will attend the lunch?
choices: Eleven
Nine
Fourteen
Seven
questions.explanation: 男性が「Eleven, including the two new engineers」と人数を伝えている。

questions.question: What will the woman do this afternoon?
choices: Pay the deposit
Call the restaurant
Order new name badges
Book a taxi
questions.explanation: 女性は今日の午後にそのイタリアンに電話すると言っている。

questions.question: What does the woman plan to ask the restaurant to do for Jin?
choices: Reserve a parking space
Serve his drinks first
Prepare a meal without nuts
Seat him near the window
questions.explanation: ジンのナッツアレルギーを伝え、彼の料理を別に用意してもらうよう頼むと言っている。窓際の席は全員のための依頼である。

title: Payroll and system update
graphic:
Accounting system update: schedule
------------------------------------
 Task                Day        Time
 Timesheet deadline  Thursday   5:00 p.m.
 Payroll run         Monday     9:00 a.m.
 System update      Saturday   10:00 p.m. - 2:00 a.m.

questions.question: Why is the man concerned about the update?
choices: Some timesheets may have been lost.
The IT team has not arrived yet.
It could interfere with salary processing.
The schedule was announced too late.
questions.explanation: 男性は給与の処理が更新の時間と重なることを心配している。給与処理は男性の発言の「payroll」にあたる。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. When is the timesheet deadline?
choices: At nine in the morning on Monday
At ten at night on Saturday
At five in the afternoon on Thursday
At noon on Friday
questions.explanation: 女性は勤務表の締め切りを木曜と言い、図表で時刻は午後5時と分かる。図表の給与処理は月曜の午前9時である。

questions.question: What do the speakers decide to do?
choices: Delay the system update until next month.
Hire extra staff for the weekend.
Pay employees ahead of the system change.
Check the system on Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 更新の前に給与を処理し、経理に勤務表を木曜までに出してもらうことにしている。

questions.question: What is the main problem with the new shelf labels?
choices: They were attached to the wrong shelves.
They show outdated item codes.
They were printed in the wrong language.
They fall off the shelves too easily.
questions.explanation: 棚札には去年のリストに基づく古い商品コードが印刷されている。

questions.question: What does the second man admit?
choices: He failed to give the printer the current list.
He ordered too many labels.
He printed the labels in the wrong size.
He forgot to lock aisle C.
questions.explanation: 男性2は、更新したリストを印刷所に送るのを忘れたと認めている。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather reprint them today."?
choices: She is confident the printer will finish early.
She thinks the list should be checked later.

Ask the supplier for a refund.

Late deliveries from the supplier.
Changes to the shipping schedule.

Approve the policy without changes.

The developers have asked to stay remote.
Customers prefer phone support from home.
Office rent will increase next year.

Two office days a week for the support team only.
Ending the pilot for every team.
Moving the support staff to the developers' floor.

questions.question: Where will the sales workshop be held?

In a thirty-minute slot before lunch.

The facilitator has agreed to a shorter session.
The CEO has refused to move the keynote.

questions.explanation: 現状の予定では、営業のワークショップは入る余地がないという意味である。基調講演が動けば入る可能性がある。

questions.question: Why did the woman change the meeting room?
choices: The projector in the first room does not work.
The room is too small for the sales team.
The meeting was moved to tomorrow.
The sales team asked for a larger kitchen.

questions.question: What will the woman send to the sales team?
choices: A list of new engineers.
An updated list of agenda items.
A budget report for next year.
A map of the building.
questions.explanation: 女性は営業チームに議題の修正版を送ると言っている。

questions.question: What will the sales team do at two o'clock?
choices: Visit the second floor.
Have lunch in the kitchen.
Hold a gathering in Room 4.
Test a new projector.

questions.question: What is the problem with the copier?

It is making a loud noise.
It has run out of paper.
It is on the wrong floor.
questions.explanation: 女性は4階のコピー機の紙がまた切れていると言っている。

choices: It was sent to the wrong address.
The box was too heavy to move.
The supplier said it was late.
The order was canceled by mistake.

Finish his report.
Phone the supplier.
Repair the copier.
questions.explanation: 男性は今すぐ業者に電話すると言っている。

questions.explanation: 他行への振込は最長で営業日2日かかると言っている。当行内の振込は即時。

title: Sales manager: New incentive and quarterly target

questions.question: What is the new incentive?
choices: A bonus that replaces commission for all sales.
A reward for gaining three new accounts within a single quarter.
A higher base salary for every employee.
An extra vacation day each quarter.
questions.explanation: 1四半期で新規の顧客を3件獲得した人に出すボーナスで、歩合に代わるもの。

questions.question: What does the manager mean when she says, "Please don't worry about the change"?
choices: Current clients will not be taken away from the staff.
Staff can keep their old commission structure.
Staff should expect a smaller bonus.
The change will take effect after Wednesday's training.
questions.explanation: 「Your current clients will stay with you」と言っており、今の顧客は担当者のもとに残ると伝えている。

questions.question: When will the training session take place?
choices: On Monday morning.
Midweek, in the afternoon.
Next Friday.
On the last day of the quarter.
questions.explanation: 水曜日の午後に研修を行うと言っている。

title: Registrar notice: Fall term registration
graphic:
Fall Term Registration - Key Dates
----------------------------------
 Stage                 Date
 Early registration    March 3-14
 Late registration     March 17-21
 Add/drop period       March 24-28
 Final withdrawal      April 10

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which deadline no longer applies to students who could not register?
choices: The early registration deadline.
The late registration period.
The add/drop period.
The final withdrawal date.
questions.explanation: 図表の前期登録(3月3〜14日)の締切は、登録できなかった学生には適用されない。台本では、手数料なしで後期の登録期間に登録できると言っている。

questions.question: Why was the early registration period not extended?
choices: Most students had already registered early.
The registrar's staff were on leave.
It would have put too much strain on the online system again.
The system team had already approved an extension.
questions.explanation: システム担当が、延長すればサーバーにまた負荷がかかると言ったため。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "so think carefully"?
choices: Students can withdraw after the final date without any record.
The add/drop period will be extended for careful students.
Students must decide before the early registration deadline.
Dropping a course late will leave a mark on the transcript.
questions.explanation: 最終締切後の取り消しは成績証明書にWと記録されるので、慎重に考えるよう求めている。

title: Community board: Wind farm site changed

questions.question: Where will the turbines be built?
choices: On the eastern hills, near the hawk nests.
In the southern valley near the power lines.
On the western hillside, with a dozen units.
On the eastern hills, with fewer turbines.
questions.explanation: 最終決定は西側の尾根に12基。東の丘は営巣地のため除外され、南の谷は地主が売却を断ったため除外。縮小案はまだ検討中。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Please do not share the eastern hills map"?
choices: The newsletter should be sent to landowners.
The map shows the hawk nests in detail.
The project will be reviewed publicly next Thursday.
The layout on that map no longer reflects the plan.
questions.explanation: 1月の地図は今の計画を反映していない(「no longer valid」)ので、共有しないよう言っている。

questions.question: Why was the southern valley not selected?
choices: The owners of that land declined to part with it.
It is too far from the power lines.
It contains an endangered species.
The engineers rejected it for cost reasons.
questions.explanation: その土地の所有者が売却を断った(「refused to sell」)ため。電線には近いと言われている。

questions.question: Who can get a flu vaccine?
choices: Only children under five.
Only people over sixty-five.
Patients who are half a year old or older.
Only the clinic's own staff.
questions.explanation: 生後6か月以上の患者が接種できると言っている。

questions.question: How can patients get vaccinated without a booking?
choices: By calling on Sunday mornings.
Simply by coming in during weekday mornings.
By visiting on weekends only.
By sending an email in advance.
questions.explanation: 予約なしでも、平日の9時から正午までに来院すれば接種できると言っている。

questions.question: What should patients bring?
choices: Their health coverage card.
Their passport.
A doctor's referral.
A list of medications.
questions.explanation: 保険証を持参するよう言っている。

questions.question: Why was the reservation changed?
choices: The customer's license had expired.
The price of the compact car has gone up.
The downtown office is closed.
The original car needs servicing.
questions.explanation: 予約していたコンパクトカーが整備中のため、代わりのセダンを手配したと言っている。

questions.question: What is the advantage of the new car?
choices: It offers more room for bags.
It uses less fuel.
It is cheaper.
It is available at the airport.
questions.explanation: セダンは荷物を入れるスペースが広いと言っている。料金は変わらない。

questions.question: What must the customer do if they want a compact car?
choices: Pick it up at the airport on Thursday.
Tell the company before the midweek evening.
Pay an extra fee at the counter.
Bring the car back by Wednesday.
questions.explanation: コンパクトカーを希望する場合は、水曜日の夜までに知らせるよう言っている。

questions.question: Why have the Pavilion C booths been moved?
choices: The roof leaked during the rain.
The organizers wanted more space for food stalls.
Exhibitors requested the north corridor.
The power supply in that area cannot cope with demand.
questions.explanation: 展示館の配線が過負荷で、電力会社がその区域を止めたため、ブースを移すことになった。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "until the inspector has signed off on your booth"?
choices: Inspectors will leave the booths before Saturday.
Exhibitors must wait for approval before using power.
Booths will be checked after the show opens.
Exhibitors can use power while the inspection is ongoing.
questions.explanation: 検査官の確認が済むまで電源を入れないよう言っており、出展者は承認を待つ必要があるという意味。

questions.question: What will the committee do for exhibitors?
choices: Provide free equipment for the new booths.
Extend the show by one day.
Offer a discount on next year's booth.
Reimburse the cost of the space they lost.
questions.explanation: 失ったスペースの料金を返金すると言っている。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do next?
choices: Book a new flight for tomorrow morning.
Pay for a replacement passport.
Take a taxi to the airport.
Phone the front desk to keep the passport.
questions.explanation: 女性は最後に「I'll call the front desk and ask them to hold it for you」と言っている。パスポートはすでに見つかっているので、フロントに電話して預かってもらう。新しい航空券、再発行、空港までのタクシーは話に出てこない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do tonight?
choices: Take the form to the school tomorrow morning.
Sign the document and put the cash in an envelope.
Take Emma to the aquarium next Wednesday.
Call the teacher about the late deadline.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll sign it as soon as I get home and put the money in an envelope」と言っている。許可証(permission slip)へのサインと、お金を封筒に入れることが今夜の作業。明日学校に持っていくのは女性の役目。水族館の日程や先生への連絡は話に出てくるが、男性が今夜することではない。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest?
choices: Having the movers come a day earlier.
Asking the design team to present on Monday.
Booking the moving company for the twentieth.
Hiring technicians to repair the printers.
questions.explanation: 女性は「the movers should come on Friday evening instead」と言い、金曜の夜に来てもらえば週末に技術者がモニターをつなげると考えている。20日の予約は男性がすでに進めていること。プリンターの修理は話に出てくるが、女性は提案していない。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do this afternoon?
choices: Request permission to leave the van on the street.
Book the cheapest bus company again.
Hire two taxis from the train station.
Park the van in the hotel parking lot.
questions.explanation: 女性は最後に「I'll contact the hotel about the permit this afternoon」と言っている。ホテルの駐車場には大きなバンが入らないので、通りに停めるための許可を求める。古いバス会社は遅れるため却下され、タクシーは保証金の問題で却下されている。ホテルの駐車場は、入れないという理由で退けられている。

questions.question: What will the man probably do next?
choices: Email the office to confirm the fee.
Phone the office to check the fee rule.
Stop selling cookies at the booth.
Submit the form by this Friday.
questions.explanation: 女性は市役所にメールで確認するよう頼むが、男性は「I'd rather call」と答えている。締め切りは金曜ではなく月曜に訂正され、クッキーをやめる案は寄付の条件が分かったことで覆された。よって男性が次にするのは、料金の条件を電話で確認すること。

questions.question: What change has been made to the yoga class?
choices: It has been moved to a different day.
It has been canceled for the summer.
It will meet outdoors in the park.
It now starts an hour earlier.
questions.explanation: 男性は「the class has been moved to Thursday」と言っている。火曜の夜から木曜へ移ったので、別の曜日に変わったといえる。夏の中止、屋外開催、開始時間の変更は話に出てこない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do now?
choices: Ask for a refund on the weekend tour.
Keep the helmet until the new bike arrives.
Return the bike with the faulty wheel to the store.
Ride along the river with the tour group today.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll ride it back now」と言い、女性は「bring this one back」と頼んでいる。料金の返金は男性が希望していない。ヘルメットは女性に預けると言っているので、手元に残す選択肢は誤り。週末のツアーは、借りられない理由として出ている。

questions.question: Why does the woman prefer a quiet restaurant?
choices: Mom's cousins would not be able to attend the dinner.
The set menu includes a dessert that Mom likes.
Her grandfather would struggle to follow conversations there.
The river restaurant has a view that Mom dislikes.
questions.explanation: 女性は「Grandpa can't hear well in noisy places」と言っている。祖父は騒がしい場所では会話についていけないので、静かな店を望んでいる。いとこの参加、デザート、川沿いの眺めは話に出てくるが、静かな店を選ぶ理由ではない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do next?
choices: Book the rooftop venue for the workshop.
Pay separately for catering at the rooftop.
Ask the manager for a larger budget.
Have facilities check that the cooling system works.
questions.explanation: 男性は「Let's ask facilities to confirm the air conditioner is working before we book the room」と言っている。空調が直ったかどうかを確認してから予約する。屋上の予約、別料金のケータリング、予算の増額は、いずれも男性か女性が検討して退けた案。

questions.question: Where and when has the group decided to hold the picnic?
choices: Hold the picnic at the lake house.
Hold the picnic in the park on Sunday.
Reserve the indoor pavilion for Saturday.
Hold the picnic in the park on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 女性は「we're back to Sunday」と言い、公園で早く来た人から木陰を使う計画に決まっている。湖畔の別荘は特別な許可が必要なので却下され、東屋は結婚式で埋まっている。土曜の公園は、天気予報の雨で日曜に移された案。

questions.question: What does the woman need to do?
choices: Renew the book for another month.
Borrow two more books from the library.
Check out a new book by the same author.
Give back the history book and pay the late fee.
questions.explanation: 女性は歴史の本を返却し、延滞料金を払う必要がある。男性は「You can pay it at the front desk」と言い、料金は1日50セント。延長、追加の貸し出し、同じ作者の本は話に出てこない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do next?
choices: Call the building manager about the motor.
Ask the neighbors to assist with his mother's luggage.
Order the part from a company in another city.
Put a note on the door for everyone.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll ask the neighbors if anyone can help carry her bags up the stairs」と言っている。近所の人に母の荷物を運んでもらうよう頼むのが次の行動。部品の注文と貼り紙は女性が行うと話しており、管理人への連絡は女性がすでにしている。

questions.question: Why does the woman prefer Michael?
choices: He could start working productively without much training.
His presentation skills were stronger than Emily's.
His statistics grades were impressive.
The internship would last longer than ten weeks.
questions.explanation: 女性は「Michael said he already knows the reporting software from his part-time job」と言い、男性も教育に時間がかからないことを重視している。すぐに成果を出せるという推測が理由になる。プレゼンや統計の成績は比べられた点だが、マイケルを選ぶ理由ではない。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do next?
choices: Request that seats on Saturday's flight be reserved.
Accept the Sunday morning flight the airline offered.
Take the direct train to the wedding hall.
Cancel the trip to get a refund.
questions.explanation: 女性は「I'll call now and ask them to hold the seats」と言っている。男性の「Then we'll pay it」を受けて、土曜便の座席を確保するよう航空会社に頼む。日曜の便は結婚式に間に合わず、直行の電車は高い上に払い戻しもできないので却下された。

questions.question: What has the team decided about the logo?
choices: Adopt the green version the CEO rejected.
Keep the blue color and change the font.
Remove the tagline from the logo.
Keep the original font without any changes.
questions.explanation: 男性は、CEOが「the blue is fine, but the font looks outdated and should be updated」と言ったと伝えている。緑の案は2回却下され、キャッチコピーは残すことになった。フォントの候補は明日のサンプルで決めるが、変えること自体は決まっている。

questions.question: Who is NOT allowed on the ward at all?
choices: Children under twelve years old.
Visitors who come on Sunday mornings.
Three visitors at once.
Visitors who bring food to the ward.
questions.explanation: 男性は「Children younger than twelve are not allowed on the ward at all」と言っている。12歳未満の子どもは病棟に入れない。面会時間や同時に2人までという決まりはあるが、病棟への立ち入りを一切禁じられているのは子どもだけ。

questions.question: Where will the grandmother sit?
choices: Near the dance floor, where the music is loud.
At the children's table by the kitchen door.
At a quiet table with a view of the room.
Beside her son's table near the front.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll put her at the table by the window」と言っている。静かで会場全体が見える席。ダンスフロアに近い席は、女性が祖母の苦手な大きな音楽を理由に退けている。子どもの席は台所のドアの近くに決まっている。

questions.question: What does the woman imply about Professor Lee?
choices: He has moved the deadline to tomorrow.
He requires a doctor's note for every extension.
He has forgiven delays caused by problems outside students' control.
He will not accept any late work this semester.
questions.explanation: 女性は「He's been lenient with students who had technical problems before」と言い、前学期にフライトの欠航で2日延ばした例も挙げている。前にも事情のある遅れを認めてきたので、事情を説明すれば今回も認めると考えている。締め切りを明日に動かしたとは言っていない。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest they do?
choices: Accept the full increase on a two-year contract.
Switch to a different packaging supplier right away.
Pass the packaging cost on to the customers.
Discuss the terms face to face with the supplier's director.
questions.explanation: 女性は最後に「a face-to-face talk might get us a better offer」と言い、仕入れ先の営業部長と直接話すことを提案している。全額の値上げを受け入れる案は、2年契約の危険から女性が否定している。業者の切り替えは数か月かかり、客への転嫁は利益が薄いことから無理だと話している。

questions.question: How has the group decided to water the garden?
choices: Dig a well in the garden.
Draw water from the community center after six.
Collect rain in a tank on the shed roof.
Use the hose from the school next door.
questions.explanation: 男性が「only after six in the evening」と言い、女性も「we'll water after six」と決めている。公民館の屋外の蛇口を夕方6時以降に使うのが最終案。井戸は許可に1年かかるため、雨水タンクは屋根が小さいため、学校のホースは校長が考えを変えたため却下された。

questions.question: What will the man do now?
choices: Move the client visit to next month.
Repair the machine himself this morning.
Order a coffee maker from an online shop.
Phone the facilities staff about a replacement.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll call them now」と言い、女性の頼みで新しい機械の交換も依頼する。総務に電話して交換を頼むのが次の行動。客の訪問を延ばす話や、自分で修理する話は出てこない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do tonight?
choices: Take the hearing aid to the shop this weekend.
Look for spare batteries and test the hearing aid.
Borrow a loud speaker from the community center.
Take Grandpa to church early tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll look for the packet and try it tonight」と言っている。予備の電池を探して補聴器を試す。店には週末に持っていけないと女性が言っており、拡声器と教会への同行は話に出てくるが、男性が今夜することではない。

questions.question: What does the woman imply about the caterer?
choices: They can easily change the date of their service.
They cannot change the date because they are booked.
The volunteers refused to work on Sunday.
They have already delivered food to the museum.
questions.explanation: 女性は「The caterer is flexible about the date」と言っている。日程を変えられるので、開幕が日曜に移っても対応できるという意味。男性が心配した予約の件は、女性の発言で解決している。ボランティアの勤務変更は話に出るが、ケータリングの話ではない。

questions.question: What will the man probably do this afternoon?
choices: Apply for a membership that allows him to use the library's chargers.
Charge the car at home overnight.
Use the fast station near the supermarket.
Install an outdoor outlet at his house.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll apply for a card this afternoon」と言っている。図書館の充電器は利用者カードが必要で、受付で無料で作れると女性が教えた。自宅での充電は屋外のコンセントがないため却下され、スタンドは来週確認すると言っているので今日は使わない。

questions.question: What will the woman probably order?
choices: Vegetable risotto cooked with fish stock.
A fish dish cooked on its own grill.
Seafood soup with shrimp in it.
Shrimp pasta with the tomato sauce.
questions.explanation: 最後に女性は「I'll order the grilled fish with steamed vegetables」と言っている。店員は当初、魚も海老と同じ網で焼くと言ったが、シェフが別の網で焼くと訂正し、書面でも確認された。リゾットは魚のだしが使われていると分かり、海老入りのスープとパスタは最初から除外されている。

questions.question: When does the exchange student's flight land?
choices: The plane lands around three o'clock.
The welcome party starts at seven in the evening.
She will arrive at the airport on Monday.
She will stay at a hotel near the school.
questions.explanation: 男性は「the flight lands at three」と言っている。飛行機は3時ごろに着く。歓迎会は5時から、ホームステイ先は学校の近く。月曜の到着やホテルの話は出てこない。

questions.question: What have the couple decided to do?
choices: Wait an hour in the lobby for the room.
Ask for a room facing the parking lot.
Accept the upgraded room and have lunch out.
Pay extra for a breakfast buffet.
questions.explanation: 男性が「Then let's take it」と言い、荷物を受付に預けて昼食に出かけると決めた。スイートは同じ料金で、朝食とバスタブが付いている。部屋の準備を1時間待つ案は、掃除が終わる前に出かけるので退けられた。朝食は既に含まれているので、追加料金の話は誤り。

questions.question: What does the man imply about the solar company's quote?
choices: It is based on a site visit the company made last week.
The panels would work well on the north-facing roof.
It left out information that would reduce the expected savings.
The oak tree was removed from the garage roof last year.
questions.explanation: 男性は「The quote didn't mention shading at all」と言い、見積もりに日陰の話がないことを疑っている。日陰があると発電量が減り、見込みの節約額も下がるので、不利な情報を省いているかもしれないと推測している。現地調査は女性が望んでいることで、北向きの屋根の話やカシの木の伐採は、いずれも見積もりの正しさを示すものではない。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do before Friday?
choices: Enter the full marathon despite her knee pain.
Ask the sponsor to pay the full donation.
Skip the charity run altogether this year.
Consult a physician about the hill before picking a route.
questions.explanation: 女性は「I'll ask my doctor first」と言っている。膝の痛みが心配なので、コースを決める前に医師に坂について聞く。フルマラソンは膝の痛みがあるため退けられ、寄付金は距離ではなく完走した人数で決まると分かった。

questions.question: Where and when will the class be held next?
choices: At the community college for a fee.
Resume at the pottery studio on Tuesday.
At a friend's garage this weekend.
At the adult education center next week.
questions.explanation: 最後の女性の発言で、工房の修理が終わり、火曜に授業が再開すると分かった。大学の窯は1点ごとに料金がかかり、友人の車庫の窯は小さすぎ、成人教育センターは自分たちの授業の作品だけになった。いずれも却下されている。

questions.question: When is the woman's new appointment?
choices: Thursday at nine in the morning.
Monday afternoon after work.
Next Friday at ten in the morning.
Next Monday at nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: 男性は「We have a free slot on Monday at nine」と言い、女性も「that's perfect」と同意している。新しい予約は来週の月曜9時。木曜は体調がすぐれない日で、午後は女性の予定が詰まっていると話している。

questions.question: How will the group most likely get to Osaka?
choices: On the express bus that leaves at seven tonight.
On the first flight out in the morning.
By driving the rental van on the highway.
By train, since the strike has already ended.
questions.explanation: 男性は「we'll take the early morning flight instead」と言い、女性もその飛行機の安さに同意している。6時発の便で大阪へ行く。高速バスは最終便が今夜7時で時間がぎりぎり、レンタルのバンは特別な免許が必要なので退けられた。電車はストライキが明日から始まるので使えない。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest the man do?
choices: Join the newer group now and aim for the main choir later.
Ask the director to move the concert to Saturday.
Switch to weekday day shifts at the hospital.
Stay with the main choir for the December concert.
questions.explanation: 女性は「you should join the newer group now」と提案し、男性は平日夜の練習には出られないと答えている。土曜の午前の練習なら夜勤に合うので、今は新しいグループに入り、本選は来年目指す。12月の演奏会に出る案は、男性が希望しているものの平日夜の練習が必要なので退けられる。

questions.question: What does the woman plan to do tonight?
choices: Test whether the export tool can preserve the shift records.
Ask the vendor to export the data for a fee.
Request a delay until the budget is released.
Stop using the old system before the migration.
questions.explanation: 女性は「I'll check the export tool tonight」と言い、ツールがうまくいけば費用をかけずに保存できると続けている。ベンダーの有料の書き出しは予算が凍結されているため退けられ、延期の依頼はIT責任者が同意しないと男性が言っている。古いシステムを先に使わなくする案は、今も問題なく使えるので退けられる。

questions.question: What will the man send to the insurance company?
choices: The video recorded on the first morning.
A corrected plumber's invoice and photos of the wall.
A rider that covers the basement damage.
A repair estimate dated before the flood.
questions.explanation: 最後の男性の発言で、請求番号を直して出し直した配管工の請求書と、壁の写真を送ると決めている。女性は動画を送らないよう言っている。地下室の補償は特約がないので認められない。見積もりは、洪水より前の日付では意味がなく、請求書は洪水の後の日付になっている。

questions.question: What will the man do before lunch?
choices: Submit an electronic version of his course receipt.
Print the receipt and bring it to the office.
Ask the training office for a new receipt.
Pay the course fee again in March.
questions.explanation: 男性は「I'll do that before lunch」と言い、女性が勧めた「upload the scanned copy to the portal」を指している。受講の領収書を電子版で提出する。印刷して持っていく案は女性が不要だと言い、再発行や再払いの話は出てこない。

questions.question: How will the group most likely get to the island?
choices: On tomorrow morning's ferry, which is non-refundable.
By waiting for the wind to drop after three.
By a small boat departing from the harbor later today.
On a boat that carries more than ten people.
questions.explanation: 女性は「a small speedboat leaves from the harbor at four this afternoon」と言い、男性も4人なら大丈夫だと同意している。今日の午後、港から小型の高速船で島へ向かう。翌朝のフェリーは払い戻しできない切符なので、念のための予備としては使わない。定員10人を超える船は話に出てこない。

questions.question: What does the woman imply about the missing boxes?
choices: The shipment that left Tuesday contained sixty boxes.
The warehouse team counted the boxes only once.
Some were likely used as samples and were not logged in the system.
The system was double-counting a Monday shipment.
questions.explanation: 女性は「The sales team may have taken some for samples」と言い、サンプル記録を確認しようとしている。火曜の出荷は伝票上40箱なので、残りの20箱は伝票なしで持ち出され、サンプルとして使われて記録に残っていないのかもしれないと示唆している。

questions.question: What does the man plan to ask the teacher?
choices: If the twins can join the art class on Tuesdays.
If Grandma can pick up the twins every Tuesday.
If the swim center can keep its lessons open until six.
If Emma can move her art class to another day.
questions.explanation: 男性は「Let's ask the teacher if Emma can take Thursday」と言っている。エマの美術を別の曜日に移せるかを先生に聞く。双子を美術の授業に入れる案は、女性が対象外だと言っている。祖母の迎えは10月に北海道へ行くため無理。水泳センターの延長は、5時に閉まるので無理だと分かっている。

questions.question: Which shift will the woman probably take on Saturday?
choices: Work the ticket booth on Saturday morning.
Check tickets for the guest speaker's session.
Run the projector room all weekend.
Volunteer at the children's workshop on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 女性は「I'll check tickets for the speaker」と言っている。土曜の午前は9時からワークショップのボランティアがあるため、売り場には入れない。午後の講演会なら、始まる前に終えられる。映写室は男性の担当のまま。日曜のワークショップの話は出てこない。

questions.question: How were the members of the assembly selected?
choices: By random selection among local residents
Through a national election
By applying for seats on the council
By choosing volunteers from political parties
questions.explanation: 「chosen by lottery」より、住民の中から無作為の抽選で選ばれた。選挙、応募、政党からの選出は本文にない。

questions.question: What will the town council do with the report?
choices: Build the new homes immediately
Ask the national government to cancel the plan
Hire the members as full-time staff
Read it carefully before making a decision
questions.explanation: 「read the report carefully before it makes a final decision」より、決定の前に報告書を注意深く読む。すぐに建設する、計画を取り消す、委員を職員として雇う、は本文にない。

questions.question: What did teachers notice after the recess was brought back?
choices: Students finished their homework faster.
Students asked for longer school days.
Teachers stopped giving any homework.
Children were calmer and more focused.
questions.explanation: 「the children were calmer and more focused」より、休み時間の復活後に子どもたちが落ち着いて集中するようになった。宿題が早く終わる、授業時間を延ばす、宿題をなくす、は本文にない。

questions.question: Who decided to bring back the recess?
choices: The parents of the students
The local government
The head teacher of the school
The school board
questions.explanation: 「the head teacher decided to bring back a fifteen-minute recess」より、休み時間を復活させたのは校長先生。保護者、地方自治体、教育委員会の決定は本文にない。

questions.question: What is the main purpose of rent control?
choices: To encourage landlords to build more apartments
To protect renters from sudden increases
To lower the cost of constructing new buildings
To reduce the number of families in large cities
questions.explanation: 家賃の値上げを制限して、借家人を守る制度だと説明されている。大家に建設を促す、建設費を下げる、大都市の家族を減らす、は本文にない。

questions.question: What do many economists suggest?
choices: Ending all limits on rent increases in cities
Encouraging families to move to rural towns
Building affordable housing while protecting long-term tenants
Banning the construction of new apartments
questions.explanation: 「a middle path」として、手頃な住宅を建てつつ長期の借家人を守ることを提案している。家賃規制の全廃、地方への移住、新しいアパートの建設禁止は本文にない。

questions.question: What do some companies now do instead of requiring degrees?
choices: They hire only graduates from famous universities
They evaluate what applicants can actually do
They offer degrees to their own employees
They stop interviewing candidates altogether
questions.explanation: 学位の代わりに、応募者が実際にできることを評価すると説明されている。名門大学の卒業生に限る、社員に学位を与える、面接をやめる、は本文にない。

questions.question: Why do the managers think the new approach is helpful?
choices: It saves money on job advertisements.
It makes interviews much shorter.
It reveals talented people they might have missed.
It lets applicants avoid taking any tests.
questions.explanation: 人事担当者は、従来なら見落とされた優秀な人を見つけられると話している。広告費、面接時間、テストの免除は本文にない。

questions.question: What did drivers complain about?
choices: The cameras were placed too far from the schools.
The fines were too small to change behavior.
The limits were set unfairly low in certain areas.
The map of the camera locations was never published.
questions.explanation: ドライバーは、制限速度が不必要に低く設定されていると不満を述べた。学校からの距離、罰金の額は不満として本文にない。地図は後に公開されている。

questions.question: Why does the spokesperson say that openness is necessary?
choices: Drivers always break rules unless they are fined.
Transparency helps people accept rules they believe are fair.
Fines are the only reliable way to improve safety.
The council should remove all cameras from the roads.
questions.explanation: 「a rule is only respected when people believe it was made fairly」より、公正だと信じられてこそ規則が守られるので、情報公開が必要だという理屈。ドライバーは罰金がないと規則を破る、罰金だけが方法、カメラを撤去すべき、は本文にない。

questions.question: How did the hospital monitor hand cleaning?
choices: By asking nurses to fill in weekly paper forms
By using devices that tracked sanitizer usage
By hiring extra staff to wash hands for others
By putting up new posters in every room
questions.explanation: 消毒液の使用を記録するセンサーを使った。ポスターは使わなかったと述べられている。週ごとの紙の記録、代わりに手を洗う人員の配置は本文にない。

questions.question: Why did the nurses find the monthly results helpful?
choices: The data showed that the sensors were working perfectly.
The data proved that other hospitals had failed.
The data reminded them of a habit they tended to neglect when busy.
The data let them compare their salaries with other staff.
questions.explanation: 「a routine that is easy to neglect under pressure」が根拠。忙しいときに忘れがちな習慣を思い出させたのが、結果の情報だと説明されている。センサーの完全な動作、他病院の失敗、給与の比較は本文にない。

questions.question: Why do the program's designers recommend testing the idea in cities?
choices: The payment did not meet the high living costs in urban areas.
Participants in the rural region had all stopped working.
Critics had proven that people always quit their jobs.
The national government had already approved the policy.
questions.explanation: 「not large enough to cover housing costs in the cities」より、都市の住居費に対して支給額が足りず、農村の結果が都市にも当てはまるか分からないため。働くのをやめた、批判者が証明した、政府がすでに承認した、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply about the results so far?
choices: They show that the policy should be introduced nationwide.
They are promising but do not yet prove the idea works.
They confirm that people stopped working once they received the payment.
They prove that rural families spend most of their money on housing.
questions.explanation: 「encouraging, though far from conclusive」より、結果は有望だが決定的ではないと考えている。全国導入、支給後の離職、農村の家族の住居費への支出は本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why are some bathhouses still able to attract visitors?
choices: They still serve as meeting places for local residents.
They have become cheaper than private bathrooms in new homes.
They have banned children from visiting the premises.
They offer more hot springs than any other spa in Japan.
questions.explanation: 「kept their original role as a meeting place」より、地域の人が集まる場としての役割を保った施設が成功していると説明されている。安さ、子どもの入場禁止、温泉の多さは本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about young visitors?
choices: They are attracted to a sense of peace that modern spas lack.
They are mainly interested in the low prices of old bathhouses.
They want to replace bathhouses with private bathrooms.
They hope to find jobs in the bathhouse business.
questions.explanation: 若い人は古い銭湯で、現代の温泉施設にはない落ち着きを感じると話している。安さへの関心、家庭の浴室への置き換え、就職の話は本文にない。

title: A downtown car ban that changed twice

questions.question: What is the city's current plan for downtown traffic?
choices: Ban private cars from downtown on weekdays.
Allow cars downtown only on weekends.
Keep the downtown area open to all traffic without changes.
Limit trucks to early hours and designate areas for unloading.
questions.explanation: 最終的に決まったのは、配送トラックを早朝に限り、荷下ろし用の区域を設けることだ。平日の車両禁止と週末だけの禁止は、いずれも途中で取り下げられた案。全面的な変更なしは本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why did officials drop the weekend-only plan?
choices: A study found that trucks, not cars, were responsible for the congestion.
Shop owners asked for a full ban on delivery trucks.
Residents asked for a full ban on cars all week long.
The city lacked the funds needed to install new signs.
questions.explanation: 交通調査で、渋滞の主な原因は自家用車ではなく配送トラックだと分かり、週末だけの案が取り下げられた。店主の要求、住民が全日の車両禁止を求めた、財源不足は本文にない。

title: A battery claim that was withdrawn

questions.question: What is the team's current view of its battery material?
choices: It can charge electric cars in just a few minutes.
It is ready for mass production in cars.
Independent laboratories have confirmed its performance.
It could be practical only for tiny gadgets, not vehicles.
questions.explanation: 「useful, but only for small devices such as sensors」より、小型の機器に限って役立つ可能性がある。急速充電の主張は撤回され、車への量産は本文で見通せていない。独立機関による確認はなかった。

questions.question: Why did the team withdraw its original claim?
choices: Investors demanded that the team stop its research.
The government banned all research on battery materials.
Companies complained that the plan was too expensive.
A mistake in its measurements had made the data look more promising.
questions.explanation: 測定の誤りによって元のデータが実際より良く見えていたと、チームが認めたことが理由。投資家の要求、政府の禁止、企業の不満は本文にない。

title: A local currency in a seaside town

questions.question: Where can the local currency be spent?
choices: Only at businesses located in the town
At any large chain across the country
Only at online stores in other cities
At government offices in the capital
questions.explanation: 地元の店でしか使えないと説明されている。大手チェーン店や他都市の店では使えない。全国の店、ネット店舗、首都の役所は本文にない。

questions.question: Who issues the currency?
choices: The national government
A large bank in another city
The shop owners' association
A small nonprofit organization
questions.explanation: 小さな非営利団体が発行していると述べられている。国、他都市の大手銀行、商店の組合は本文にない。

questions.question: When will construction begin?
choices: Immediately after the next election
Two years from now
Right after the public meeting
Sometime in the coming spring
questions.explanation: 工事は今度の春に始まる予定だと述べられている。次の選挙の直後、2年後、住民説明会の直後は本文にない。

questions.question: What is the main concern of some drivers?
choices: That the bike lane will be too narrow
That cyclists will refuse to use the lane
That parking spaces will be lost
That the river will become polluted
questions.explanation: 一部のドライバーは駐車スペースが減ることを心配している。ただし市は減るのはわずかだと説明している。車線の幅、自転車の利用、川の汚染は本文にない。

questions.question: What do some studies show about children who start early?
choices: They always outperform older learners in grammar.
They tend to speak with better pronunciation.
They quit learning the language by their teens.
They learn to read the language before speaking it.
questions.explanation: 早く始めた子どもは発音のレベルが高くなる傾向があると述べられている。文法で常に上回るという主張は、文法では優位が続かないとの記述と合わない。

questions.question: What do teachers suggest schools should focus on?
choices: Starting language lessons at a younger age
Testing children's grammar every single week
Giving students regular chances to practice
Hiring more teachers from abroad
questions.explanation: 早く始めることよりも、定期的に練習する機会を与えることに集中すべきだと教師は提案している。早期開始は勧められていない。毎週の文法テスト、外国人教師の採用は本文にない。

title: Disaster drills in a coastal city

questions.question: What has the city added to this year's drill?
choices: Free meals for all elderly residents
Each household writing a personal evacuation route
Higher prizes for the best volunteers
A drill held in the middle of the night
questions.explanation: 今年から、各家庭が自宅の避難経路を書き出して家族と話し合うことが加わった。無料の食事、ボランティアへの賞、夜間の訓練は本文にない。

questions.question: What is the mayor's main point?
choices: The drills should be cancelled because they are too costly.
Volunteers should be paid for their work.
Preparing at home is just as important as community efforts.
Public shelters are no longer needed in the city.
questions.explanation: 家庭での備えは、地域の取り組みと同じくらい大切だと市長は考えている。訓練の中止、ボランティアへの報酬、避難所が不要になるという話は本文にない。

questions.question: What advantage do subscriptions give to companies?
choices: They allow customers to buy programs in boxes again.
They reduce the need to improve their products.
They provide predictable revenue that supports long-term planning.
They let customers pay once for a permanent license.
questions.explanation: 定期的な収入が入るので、先の計画を立てやすく、製品の改良にも役立つ。箱入りでの販売や一度払いの買い切りは以前の方式として出てくるだけで、利点ではない。製品の改良が不要になるという話もない。

questions.question: Why do consumer advocates recommend reviewing subscriptions regularly?
choices: Because cancelling a subscription always leads to large fines.
Because people may keep paying for services they seldom need.
Because most companies stop offering subscriptions after a year.
Because subscriptions are cheaper than buying programs in boxes.
questions.explanation: 使わないサービスに料金を払い続けてしまうおそれがあるため、定期的な見直しを勧めている。解約の罰金、1年で終わる定額制、箱入りより安い、は本文にない。

questions.question: How did many residents in the recent survey feel about the groups?
choices: They believed the groups had eliminated all burglaries.
They felt more uneasy than secure.
They wanted the groups to report suspicious people to the police.
They thought the groups should meet only during the summer.
questions.explanation: 調査では、多くの住民が見守りグループによって安心よりも不安を感じたと答えた。空き巣がなくなった、警察への通報を求めた、夏だけ活動すべきだという話は、住民の感想として本文にない。

questions.question: What do the organizers imply about close relationships between neighbors?
choices: They make watching the streets unnecessary in every case.
They mean that residents should stop reporting anything to the police.
They make people more willing to ask others for assistance.
They make it easier to judge people by their background.
questions.explanation: 近所の人を知っている人ほど、困ったときに助けを求めやすいと主催者は述べている。見張りが不要になる、警察への通報をやめる、背景で判断する、は本文の内容と逆か、本文にない。

questions.question: Why have some hospitals stopped their therapy-dog programs?
choices: Some incidents raised doubts about the safety of the visits.
Patients were too frightened of the animals to continue.
The dogs refused to visit patients recovering from surgery.
Because the dogs had stopped reducing patients' stress.
questions.explanation: 感染のリスクへの懸念と、いくつかの事故を受けて、一部の病院がプログラムを中止したと説明されている。患者の恐怖、犬の拒否、ストレスを減らさなくなったことは本文にない(本文では減らすと言われている)。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the value of therapy dogs?
choices: They are more effective than any medicine for treating infections.
Their comfort may be genuine, though hospitals must weigh it against dangers.
They should be banned from all hospitals because of their risks.
They work best when they are kept away from patients.
questions.explanation: 犬がもたらす安らぎは本物かもしれないが、病院は危険と比べて判断しなければならないと述べている。感染症の治療薬より効果がある、全面的に禁止すべき、患者から離すほうがよい、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: According to psychologists, why do students often delay their tasks?
choices: They try to escape uncomfortable emotions linked to the task.
They are not clever enough to finish their assignments early.
They prefer deadlines that are very close together.
They perform better when they feel rushed at the last minute.
questions.explanation: 心理学者によると、課題に対する退屈さや不安といった不快な感情を避けようとするのが先延ばしの原因。頭の良さ、締め切りの近さを好むこと、直前に急ぐと力が出ることは、本文では否定されているか述べられていない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest teachers should do?
choices: Ask students to create specific, concrete plans for their work.
Remind students about deadlines more often than before.
Give students longer deadlines so that they feel less pressure.
Reward students who finish their work at the last moment.
questions.explanation: 締め切りの通知だけでなく、具体的な計画を立てさせると生徒の成果が上がると述べている。締め切りを頻繁に知らせる、期限を延ばす、直前に終えた生徒を褒める、は勧められていない。

questions.question: What will visitors see in the main hall this autumn?
choices: The original scrolls displayed for longer hours
A small room with controlled lighting
The exhibition with extended opening hours
Accurate reproductions rather than the original scrolls
questions.explanation: 館内の主会場では、原本ではなく高品質の複製が展示される。原本は光を管理した小さな部屋に限って展示される。展示時間の延長は当初の計画で、取り下げられた案。

questions.question: Why was the exhibition of the original scrolls postponed?
choices: They were judged too delicate to be transported.
The autumn weather was too damp for displays.
Critics demanded a higher admission price.
Visitors had asked for copies rather than originals.
questions.explanation: 保存担当者が、巻物は移動に耐えられないほど傷みやすいと判断し、展示が延期された。天候、入場料、来館者の要望は本文にない。

title: A sports center that got smaller

questions.question: What option has the council now chosen?
choices: A new center on the riverside, as first planned
A new site on the former factory land
A new arena built on the hills
Upgrading the gymnasium at the local school
questions.explanation: 議会が選んだのは、学校の既存の体育館を改修し、小さな増築を加える案。川沿いの計画、工場跡地の計画は取り下げられた。丘の上の新しい競技場は本文にない。

questions.question: Why was the factory site dropped?
choices: Residents preferred a location on the riverside.
The council wanted a much larger sports arena instead.
Sports fans demanded a different kind of sport.
Its soil was found to be polluted and too costly to clean.
questions.explanation: 工場跡地は汚染されていることが分かり、浄化の費用が予算に対して高すぎたため。川沿いを望む住民の声は、むしろ川沿いの計画への反対だった。大きな競技場、別の競技を求めるファンは本文にない。

questions.question: What do stories help children learn?
choices: New vocabulary and how sentences are built
How to write their own picture books
How to play musical instruments
How to count money quickly
questions.explanation: 物語は新しい語彙と文のつくりを学ぶ助けになると述べられている。自分で絵本を書く、楽器の演奏、お金の数え方は本文にない。

questions.question: What kind of reading is most helpful?
choices: Reading silently by themselves every night
Reading only textbooks during school lessons
Reading only before the children go to bed
Reading that feels calm and fun
questions.explanation: くつろいで楽しめる読み聞かせが、もっとも効果的だと述べられている。黙読、教科書の読解、寝る前だけの読み聞かせは本文にない。

questions.question: What is the sensor designed to measure?
choices: The temperature of the air
The brightness of sunlight
The speed of the wind
How wet the soil is
questions.explanation: 土の中の水分を測るセンサーだと説明されている。空気の温度、日光の明るさ、風速は本文にない。

questions.question: When will the device be available?
choices: Starting this month
Only after the crops are harvested
Sometime in the coming year
It has been cancelled
questions.explanation: 今後1年以内に発売される予定だと述べられている。今月からの発売、収穫後の販売、中止は本文にない。

questions.question: What have the young council members proposed?
choices: Higher taxes on all public events
Additional bike parking by stations and a skating area
Free tickets for all elderly residents
The removal of every public park
questions.explanation: 若い委員は、駅の近くの自転車駐車場の増設と、空き地のスケートエリアを提案した。公共イベントへの増税、高齢者への無料券、公園の撤去は本文にない。

questions.question: What do supporters say the councils help young people do?
choices: Gain real authority over adult politicians
Earn money from city budgets
Understand how the government operates
Avoid taking part in public events
questions.explanation: 支持者は、この経験で若者が政府の仕組みを学べると述べている。本当の権限を得る、予算から収入を得る、イベントに参加しない、は本文にない。権限がないという指摘は批判する側の主張である。

questions.question: What did the markets originally sell?
choices: Imported spices for restaurants in the capital
Fresh seafood and produce for local homes
Cooked meals for tourists
Handmade pottery for travelers
questions.explanation: もとは近くの家庭向けに魚や野菜を売っていたと述べられている。首都の飲食店向けの香辛料、観光客向けの調理済みの食事(後に始まったもの)、旅人向けの陶器は本文にない。

questions.question: What are the markets known for today?
choices: Expensive restaurants with quiet dining rooms
Factories that produce fish for export
Small stalls where food is cooked in front of buyers
Large supermarkets with long opening hours
questions.explanation: 客の目の前で料理を焼く小さな屋台で知られていると述べられている。高級な食堂、輸出用の工場、大型スーパーは本文にない。

questions.question: What do researchers say the brain actually does when a person multitasks?
choices: It performs both demanding tasks at the same time.
It focuses only on phone notifications.
It alternates rapidly between demanding activities.
It stops working until the music ends.
questions.explanation: 研究者によると、脳は二つの作業を同時にこなすのではなく、その間を行ったり来たりしている。同時に処理する、通知だけに集中する、音楽が終わるまで止まる、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean by saying that 'the idea is not to punish students'?
choices: Students should never be allowed to use phones during class.
Teachers want to help students focus rather than discipline them.
Students who use phones should lose their class points.
Teachers should take away students' phones permanently.
questions.explanation: 「The idea is not to punish students」の後で、集中する機会を与えるのが狙いだと続けている。いつも使用禁止にすること、点数を減らすこと、スマホを永久に取り上げることは、本文の趣旨と違う。

questions.question: What do supporters say the wage increase will allow workers to do?
choices: Take on more hours at small restaurants
Pay for basic needs without relying on government help
Start their own restaurants more easily
Retire earlier than they had planned
questions.explanation: 支持者は、低賃金の労働者が公的な支援に頼らずに基本的な生活費をまかなえるようになると主張している。小さな飲食店での労働時間の増加、飲食店の開業のしやすさ、早期退職は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply about the effect of the wage rise in different regions?
choices: It will affect all regions in exactly the same way.
It will matter most in areas where wages are already high.
It will depend heavily on the economic situation of each area.
It will be cancelled after the first year everywhere.
questions.explanation: 経済の状況は地域によって違い、その影響も地域ごとに違うと述べている。どの地域も同じ影響、賃金が高い地域で最も大きい、全国で一年後に廃止、はいずれも本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why do many couriers feel that the flexibility does not give them real freedom?
choices: They must work long hours just to earn enough money.
Their hours are assigned by the cities where they live.
Their pay is guaranteed for every delivery they make.
They prefer short shifts that fit around studies and parenting.
questions.explanation: 多くの配達員は、望む時間を選べず、目標の収入に届くまで長時間働いている。そのため柔軟性は本当の自由ではないと感じている。市による時間の割り当て、支払いの保証、短時間勤務の好みは、本文と合わない、または企業側の主張である。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the platform owners' objection to new rules?
choices: They believe couriers should be paid directly by customers.
They prioritize lower costs over couriers' security.
They think the rules will increase the number of jobs.
They have already agreed to pay a guaranteed minimum for each delivery.
questions.explanation: プラットフォーム側は、ルールが導入されると客の料金が上がり、仕事の数が減ると恐れている。つまり、配達員の保障より費用を抑えることを重視していると読める。客による直接の支払い、仕事の増加、既に最低保証を約束したことは本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why might research on edited crops be slowed down?
choices: Regulations classify them the same way as other modified foods.
Farmers refuse to grow any new varieties of crops.
The technique cannot change the genes of plants at all.
Consumers have already banned all research on food.
questions.explanation: 編集された作物を遺伝子組み換え食品と同じ厳しい規制で扱う国があり、そのため研究が遅れると述べられている。農家が栽培を拒む、遺伝子を変えられない、消費者が研究を禁止した、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply about public acceptance of edited crops?
choices: It depends as much on communication as on the technology itself.
It is guaranteed once farmers report higher yields.
It has nothing to do with how the risks are explained.
It is mostly determined by the cost of the technique.
questions.explanation: 科学者は、技術そのものと同じくらい、リスクや利点をどのように伝えるかが大切だと述べている。収穫量が増えれば受け入れられる、説明は無関係、費用で決まる、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What is the council's final decision about the pool?
choices: It will be closed during the summer to save money.
It will be run by a private company.
It will open only on weekends with reduced hours.
It will stay fully open after using a national grant for repairs.
questions.explanation: 最終的に議会は、全国の補助金を使って屋根を修理し、プールを全面的に開け続けることにした。夏の閉鎖、民間企業への委託、週末だけの営業は、いずれも途中で取り下げられた案。

questions.question: Why was the plan to hand the pool to a private company dropped?
choices: The building turned out to need costly repairs.
The company was unwilling to hire any local staff.
The council found the pool was too small to be profitable.
Parents asked for longer summer hours at the pool.
questions.explanation: 民間企業は、建物に高額な修理が必要だと分かった後に申し出を撤回した。現地採用を嫌がった、採算が取れない規模だった、夏の営業時間の延長を親が求めた、は本文にない。

questions.question: What should doctors tell patients about the supplement now?
choices: It has been proven to improve sleep in large trials.
It is safe to recommend because the manufacturer says it works.
It can replace prescribed medicine for sleep problems.
The evidence supporting it is not yet adequate.
questions.explanation: 医師は、このサプリの根拠は現時点では不十分だと患者に伝えるよう勧められている。大規模な試験で効果が証明された、製造元が効くと言うから安全に勧められる、処方薬の代わりになる、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why did officials ask clinics to stop recommending the supplement?
choices: The manufacturer refused to pay for a second trial.
Patients complained that the supplement tasted terrible.
The first study had been published in a famous journal.
A bigger independent study did not find a real benefit.
questions.explanation: より大きな独立した試験で、サプリと偽薬のあいだに意味のある差が見られなかったため、追加の試験が終わるまで勧めないよう求められた。製造元が試験費用を拒んだ、味への苦情、有名な雑誌への掲載は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What were early calendars based on?
choices: The phases of the moon
The seasons of the ocean
The height of mountains
The growth of forests
questions.explanation: 初期の暦は月を基にしていたと述べられている。海の季節、山の高さ、森の成長は本文にない。

questions.question: Why did farmers need a reliable calendar?
choices: To pay taxes to the rulers
To record the births of their children
To celebrate festivals in the capital
To know the right time to plant crops
questions.explanation: 作物をいつ植えるかを知るために、信頼できる暦が必要だったと歴史家は述べている。税金、出生の記録、祭りは本文にない。

questions.question: What do customers receive when they return the containers?
choices: A free loaf of bread every day
A new reusable bag
A cash refund at the register
A small discount on their next purchase
questions.explanation: 容器を返すと、次回の購入で少し値引きされると述べられている。毎日無料のパン、新しい袋、レジでの現金返金は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the owner hope will happen?
choices: The bakery will close the shopping street
Customers will stop buying bread altogether
Other shops will adopt the same idea
The city will ban plastic bags forever
questions.explanation: 店主は、商店街の他の店も同じ取り組みを始めることを望んでいる。店が通りを閉める、客がパンを買わなくなる、市がビニール袋を永久に禁止する、は本文にない。

questions.question: What did the study of older adults find?
choices: Walking long distances was the only useful exercise.
Regular, moderate walking was linked to fewer heart problems.
Only people who could run fast benefited from walking.
Walking caused more heart problems among older adults.
questions.explanation: 高齢者を対象にした研究では、適度な歩行を定期的に行うと心臓の病気のリスクが低いとされた。長距離歩行だけが役立つ、速く走れる人だけが得をする、歩行で心臓病が増えた、は本文にない。

questions.question: What do doctors recommend for people who cannot walk far?
choices: Staying in bed to save their energy
Walking very fast for at least one hour
Getting up often and taking brief walks each day
Standing still for long periods of time
questions.explanation: 遠くまで歩くのが難しい人も、立ち上がって一日を通して短い散歩を重ねれば効果があると医師は述べている。ベッドで休む、一時間以上速く歩く、長時間立ち続けるは本文にない。

questions.question: Why do the struggling students feel more comfortable?
choices: They are paid for attending the lunch sessions.
They find it less intimidating to ask questions in small groups.
They can skip the regular lessons entirely.
They can ask the teacher during every lesson.
questions.explanation: 大きな授業より、質問しやすいと感じている。少人数のグループでは、質問への気後れが少ないという意味。昼食時の報酬、授業の免除、毎回の質問機会は本文にない。

questions.question: What did the tutors discover?
choices: Their classmates usually refuse to listen to them.
Lunch breaks are too short for any lessons.
Teaching an idea helps them understand it more clearly.
Teachers prefer to work alone on lessons.
questions.explanation: ある考えを説明すると、自分自身の理解が明確になると、チューターは気づいた。クラスメートが話を聞かない、昼休みが短すぎる、教師が一人で授業を準備したがる、は本文にない。

questions.question: How do the new AI systems produce their forecasts?
choices: By simulating the physics of every storm
By asking meteorologists to predict each day manually
By learning from records of earlier weather
By measuring winds with satellites only
questions.explanation: 新しいAIシステムは、何十年分もの過去のデータから学習して予報を作る。大気の物理を計算するのは従来の方式で、人が手作業で予測する、衛星だけで風を測る、は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the weakness of AI forecasts?
choices: They are less accurate than traditional forecasts for common weather.
They may overlook uncommon storms because such cases were rarely recorded.
They cannot forecast anything beyond a single day.
They always predict storms more often than necessary.
questions.explanation: AIは、学習データに少ない稀な出来事、たとえば突然の嵐を見逃すことがあると指摘している。よくある天気での精度が低い、一日以上の予報ができない、嵐を多く予測しすぎる、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: Where were early confectionery shops often found?
choices: Beside the markets where sugar-coated snacks were sold
Close to religious sites
In busy harbors where traders gathered
At the top of mountain roads used by travelers
questions.explanation: 菓子店は寺の近くにあり、参拝者に砂糖をまぶした菓子を売っていたと述べられている。市場の隣、港、山道の上は本文にない。

questions.question: Why do customers keep returning to the oldest shops?
choices: The buildings are the most modern in the area.
The prices are lower than at newer stores.
The flavors evoke memories from their early years.
The shops have recently opened branches in every city.
questions.explanation: 客は、味が子どもの頃の思い出を呼び起こすから戻ってくると、店主は話している。建物が新しいから、値段が安いから、支店が増えたから、は本文にない。

questions.question: According to the speaker, what do some people argue about programs open to everyone?
choices: They help children from different backgrounds build bonds over shared meals.
They are cheaper than programs that target low-income families.
They make it unnecessary to fund any school meals at all.
They guarantee healthier meals than lunches brought from home.
questions.explanation: 誰でも利用できる制度には、異なる背景の子どもが一緒に食べて交流できるという社会的効果があると、一部の人は主張している。費用が安い、学校給食が不要になる、家庭の弁当より健康的、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the best policy?
choices: Universal lunches are always fairer than targeted ones.
It depends on how each town chooses to design its program.
Discounted lunches should be abolished in all towns.
Free lunches are cheaper for families than home-cooked meals.
questions.explanation: 研究者の意見は分かれており、結果は各自治体がプログラムをどう設計するかに大きく左右される、と述べている。誰でも利用できる制度が常に公平、割引制度の全廃、家庭の手作り弁当より安い、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: According to the speaker, why do many old family firms get through difficult periods?
choices: Their cautious finances and focused craft, along with staff loyalty, help them endure hard times.
They borrow money whenever markets collapse.
They change their main product every few years.
They hire managers from outside the family only.
questions.explanation: 借金を避け、一つの技や製品に集中し、従業員の忠誠心を保っていることが、困難な時期を乗り越える理由だと研究者は述べている。市場の崩壊時に借金する、製品を数年ごとに変える、家族以外の経営者だけを採用する、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the future of these family-run firms?
choices: They must balance their traditions with openness to change.
They should give up their traditions to compete with newer firms.
They will certainly fail once the founders retire.
They should hire only relatives to protect their loyalty.
questions.explanation: 長期的な価値観を守りつつ、新しい考えを受け入れる姿勢が必要だと専門家は勧めている。伝統を捨てる、創業者の引退後は必ず失敗する、親族だけを採用する、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: What has the school finally decided about its start time?
choices: Start classes at nine every day.
Start at eight thirty on most days.
Start at nine only on Wednesdays.
Keep the eight o'clock start, but let approved students arrive later.
questions.explanation: 最終的に、全員の始業は8時のままとし、医療上の理由で睡眠が必要な生徒は、教師の承認を得て9時に登校してよいことになった。9時の全日始業、8時半の始業、水曜だけ9時の案は、いずれも取り下げられた案。

questions.question: Why was the Wednesday-only plan abandoned?
choices: Transportation companies could not adjust for a single day.
Parents strongly opposed a later start on Wednesdays.
Teachers refused to teach on Wednesdays.
The school lacked enough classrooms for the change.
questions.explanation: 地元のバス会社が、週に1日だけダイヤを変えられないと述べたため、水曜日だけの計画は取り下げられた。保護者の強い反対、教師の授業拒否、教室不足は本文にない。

questions.question: According to the doctors, what is the most reliable option for chronic back pain?
choices: The few-session treatment that the clinic advertises
Results from the clinic's own patient surveys
Treatments offered at the clinic's three branches
An exercise plan with a professional overseeing it
questions.explanation: 医師は、監督付きの運動プログラムが、もっとも裏付けのある選択肢だと述べている。クリニックが宣伝する数回の治療、クリニック独自の患者調査の結果、三つの支店での治療は、いずれも本文の結論ではない。

questions.question: Why did the agency tell the clinic to stop its advertising?
choices: Patients demanded a refund for their treatments.
The treatment cost more than standard exercise programs.
Other clinics complained about the new branches.
Its quick-results claim was not backed by independent findings.
questions.explanation: 独立機関の検討で、少ない回数で効くという主張を裏付けるデータが、クリニック自身の調査に頼っていることが分かったため。返金の要求、治療費の比較、他院の苦情は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Pharmacy pickup
situation: You had a prescription filled at a hospital pharmacy yesterday, but you have not picked it up yet. You call the pharmacy and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How should you get your medicine today?
choices: Ask your insurance company to change the medicine.
Visit the hospital's emergency room for a checkup.
Mail your identification card to the hospital.
Collect your medicine at the first-floor pharmacy window.
questions.explanation: 「Please come to the pharmacy window on the first floor before six p.m. today.」より、今日の午後6時までに1階の薬局の窓口で薬を受け取る。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: School trip form
situation: You are the parent of a second-grade student at Maple Elementary School. You hear the following recorded message from the school.

questions.question: Which step is needed for your child to join the trip?
choices: Tell the teacher at the aquarium on Tuesday morning.
Hand in the signed permission form by Monday afternoon.
Pay the trip fee at the school office on Friday.
Ask the library teacher to watch your child.
questions.explanation: 「Without a signed form, your child cannot join the trip.」「Signed forms must be returned to the school office by Monday afternoon.」より、署名入りの許可書を月曜の午後までに学校の事務室へ出す。ほかの選択肢は、本文に費用の話がない、または時期や場所が合わない。

title: Real-Life: Bus route detour
situation: You live on Oak Street and usually take the number 12 bus to work on weekdays. You call the bus company and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you get to work during the repairs?
choices: Walk two blocks east to Elm Avenue and board the number nine bus.
Wait at Oak Street for the number 12 bus.
Take a taxi across the bridge on Harbor Road.
Call the bus company to request a new route.
questions.explanation: 「This bus stops on Elm Avenue, about two blocks east of the closed stop.」より、オーク通りから2区画東のエルム通りまで歩き、9番のバスに乗る。12番は工事中は橋を渡らず、オーク通りの停留所も閉鎖されている。

title: Real-Life: Warning light
situation: Tonight the red oil warning light came on while you were driving your car. You need the car for a job interview tomorrow morning. You call Eastside Auto Service and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do tonight?
choices: Pull over, switch off the engine, and phone the 24-hour line for a free pickup.
Drive to the service center and wait for a walk-in check.
Book an appointment online for Monday morning.
Keep driving carefully until you reach home.
questions.explanation: 「If the red oil pressure light is on, stop the engine right away and do not drive」と「only if you call the emergency line first」をつなぐ。赤い警告灯なので運転せず、先に緊急用の電話にかけて無料のけん引を頼む。月曜の予約は黄色い警告灯の場合の手順なので、今夜の対応としては誤り。

title: Real-Life: Pottery workshop change
situation: You signed up for a pottery workshop at Hillside Community Center. You hear the following message on the phone, and you are not sure when and where the workshop is now.

questions.question: When and where should you go to attend the workshop?
choices: Go to Room 3 on Thursday evening.
Head to the ground-floor studio on Saturday morning.
Go to Room 7 on Friday evening with your own apron.
Go to the ground-floor studio on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The workshop will take place on Saturday morning in the ground-floor studio」。木曜の3号室は水漏れで、金曜の7号室は窯の修理で使えないと訂正されている。土曜の午後は誤りで、場所は同じ1階のスタジオでも時間が違う。

title: Real-Life: Planned power outage
situation: You live in an apartment in Northern City. You receive the following recorded message from the electric company.

questions.question: Which task should you finish before Sunday morning?
choices: Fully charge your phones and other devices.
Move your bicycle to the garage on Saturday.
Contact the city council about the road repairs.
Send a payment to the power company by Friday.
questions.explanation: 「Please charge your phones and other devices before Sunday morning」より、日曜の朝までにスマートフォンなどを充電しておく。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Dog vaccination reminder
situation: You have a dog named Max, and its rabies vaccination is due this month. You call the animal clinic and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you keep your dog's vaccination on schedule?
choices: Walk your dog into the clinic on Saturday afternoon.
Email the vaccination record to the city council.
Phone the clinic to schedule a time before the month is over.
Give your dog the vaccination at home this weekend.
questions.explanation: 「your dog's rabies vaccination is due by the end of this month」「please call us to book a time」より、今月末までに電話で予約を取る。土曜の午後は休診で、予約なしの接種もできない。

title: Real-Life: Wrong bookshelf delivered
situation: You ordered a tall bookshelf from Oakwood Furniture, but the one delivered yesterday is the standard size and does not fit your room. You call the store and hear the following conversation with the clerk.

questions.question: What should the man do to get the tall model at no charge?
choices: Stay home on Thursday and wait for the truck.
Pay the extra fee for a collection on another day.
Take the old shelf and the receipt to the downtown branch by Friday.
Ask the store to refund the full price of the bookshelf.
questions.explanation: 「the downtown branch can exchange it at no charge if the old shelf is brought in by Friday」「please bring the receipt with the shelf」より、金曜までに古い棚とレシートを持ち込む。男性は木曜に仕事で家にいられないので、無料の木曜の引き取りは使えない。

title: Real-Life: Essay submission during maintenance
situation: You are a university student. Your essay is due on Sunday, and it is now Saturday night. The file is large, and you have not finished it. You hear the following message from the university's IT department.

questions.question: How should you submit your essay on time?
choices: Submit the essay through the student portal on Sunday morning.
Request a one-day extension through the portal right now.
Upload the essay to the library's cloud drive on Monday morning.
Shrink the file below the size limit and email it to your professor by midnight.
questions.explanation: 「professors will accept them by email until midnight」と「please compress large files before you send them」をつなぐ。土曜の夜なので延長は申請できず、日曜の午前はポータルが停止している。大きいファイルは圧縮してメールで提出する。

title: Real-Life: Boat tour departure change
situation: You booked a boat tour for this Saturday afternoon. You hear the following message from the tour company on your voicemail.

questions.question: Where should you go to join the boat tour on Saturday?
choices: Go to Pier 2 at one p.m. for the first boat.
Head to the small marina beside the lighthouse for the one-thirty departure.
Go to Pier 5 and then take the bus from the train station.
Wait at the train station for a boat to pick you up.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The final departure point is the small marina next to the lighthouse, and boats will leave at one thirty p.m.」。2番埠頭は修理、5番埠頭は工事で使えないと訂正されている。駅のバスは駐車場が混むときの移動手段で、駅で船を待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Fire drill at work
situation: You work in an office building. You hear the following announcement over the speaker on Tuesday morning.

questions.question: What should you do when you hear the alarm?
choices: Call the building manager from your desk.
Finish the report on your computer first.
Gather in the cafeteria on the second floor.
Go down the nearest staircase right away.
questions.explanation: 「When you hear the alarm, leave your desk immediately and walk to the nearest staircase.」より、警報が鳴ったら机をすぐ離れ、いちばん近い階段で降りる。エレベーターは使わない。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Restaurant booking change
situation: You booked a table for four at a restaurant for this Saturday. Now one friend cannot come, so you call the restaurant to change the booking. You hear the following conversation.

questions.question: How can you keep the new booking?
choices: Bring a fourth friend to the table at seven.
Phone the restaurant to confirm the change by Friday noon.
Pay the full price of the meal in advance.
Keep the booking at seven and cancel on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 「please confirm the change by phone before Friday noon, or the booking will be released」より、金曜の正午までに電話で変更を確認する。7時のままにする、友人を追加する、前払いするという内容は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Daycare pickup change
situation: Your son attends Sunnyside Daycare. You are on your way to work when you hear the following voicemail from the daycare.

questions.question: Where and when should you collect your son today?
choices: Collect your son at the Maple Street side entrance after five forty-five.
Use the front entrance at five thirty p.m.
Park in the daycare lot and wait inside.
Pick him up at the Maple Street side door at five thirty.
questions.explanation: 「Children will be dismissed at the side door on Maple Street」と「please come after five forty-five」をつなぐ。正門は閉まっていて、先生が忙しい5時30分は避ける。駐車場は修理中なので、駐車して中で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Driver's license renewal
situation: You are sixty-eight years old. Your driver's license expires in six days, and you have not renewed it yet. You call the licensing office and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How should you renew your license?
choices: Visit a licensing office in person before it expires.
Mail the renewal form and a copy of the license today.
Take an eye test at home and send the result by mail.
Renew online using the renewal form on the website.
questions.explanation: 「Renewal forms must be postmarked at least ten days before the expiration date.」と「expires in six days」をつなぐ。郵送の期限に間に合わないので、有効期限の前に窓口へ行く。視力検査は75歳以上の人の条件で、この人は対象外。

title: Real-Life: Stadium gate update
situation: You have a lower-section ticket for tonight's baseball game at Northfield Stadium. On the way there, you receive the following urgent message on your phone.

questions.question: Which gate should you use with your lower-section ticket?
choices: Use the north gate, as announced first.
Proceed through the east gate, which lower-section fans may also use.
Wait at the west gate until it reopens at four thirty.
Head to the main gate near the parking lot.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Lower-section fans may also enter through the east gate」。北ゲートは機材で使えず、西ゲートは安全点検で閉鎖され、今夜は再開しないと訂正されている。午後4時30分の西ゲートを待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Zoo talk change
situation: You are visiting Westbridge Zoo today and want to see the penguins. You hear the following announcement at the zoo entrance.

questions.question: Where should you go at three p.m. today?
choices: Head to the North Pond for the penguin talk.
Ride the train around the zoo at noon.
Visit the gift shop before closing time.
Wait at the main gate until the zoo closes.
questions.explanation: 「a short talk about penguins will take place at three p.m. at the North Pond」より、午後3時に北の池で行われるペンギンの話を聞きに行く。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Mobile plan cancellation
situation: You want to cancel your mobile phone plan because you are moving abroad next week. You cannot visit a store, so you call the phone company and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you cancel the plan from abroad?
choices: Call the cancellation agent and wait on the line.
Send your SIM card to the company by mail.
Use the online cancellation form before the month ends.
Visit a store after the next month begins.
questions.explanation: 「use the cancellation form on our website」と「If you cancel before the end of the month, you will not be charged for the next month」より、月末までにウェブサイトの解約フォームから解約する。電話での解約は受け付けていないので、電話で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Car insurance claim
situation: You had a small accident in a parking lot yesterday. Your car bumper is cracked, and you need to file a claim with your insurance company. You hear the following conversation with the claims agent.

questions.question: What should the man do to get the claim processed in time?
choices: Upload the photos through the app on his phone.
Visit the nearest office and hand in the photos.
Post the printed pictures to the claims department by Friday.
Send the photos by email tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 「you can mail the printed photos to our claims center」と「if they arrive after Friday, the claim may be delayed」をつなぐ。アプリは使えず、営業所は遠く、メールは使えないので、印刷した写真を金曜までに郵送する。

title: Real-Life: Job center interview
situation: You are a job seeker with an interview at Crown Logistics on Tuesday, but you are also registered for a training session at the job center at the same time. You call the job center and hear the following conversation.

questions.question: Which step will let you attend the interview on Tuesday?
