choices: Attend the training session at the job center on Tuesday.
Go to Crown Logistics after the training is finished.
Retake the safety course before the interview.
Provide proof of your completed safety course to the center by Monday.
questions.explanation: 「people who have already completed the safety course are exempt」と「You must give us a copy of your certificate by Monday」をつなぐ。修了証の写しを月曜までに出せば研修は免除され、面接に行ける。火曜の研修に出る、講習を受け直すという内容は誤り。

title: Real-Life: Elevator repair and moving
situation: You need to move a heavy piano out of your apartment this week. You hear the following announcement from the building manager.

questions.question: How should you move your piano?
choices: Use the freight elevator on Thursday afternoon.
Arrange to use the rear ramp on Friday morning.
Move the piano in a passenger elevator this week.
Leave the piano in the hallway until the freight elevator is fixed.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the rear ramp can be used on Friday morning」。木曜の荷物用エレベーターは故障で使えず、客用エレベーターはピアノを運ぶのに使えないと訂正されている。水曜の夕方までに受付で予約する必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Holiday cake pickup
situation: You ordered a holiday cake from Sweet Crumb Bakery. You have not picked it up yet, so you hear the following recorded message when you call the shop.

questions.question: How can you keep your cake from being sold?
choices: Pay the full price on the phone tomorrow.
Order a different cake for the next holiday.
Ask the shop to deliver the cake to your house.
Claim your cake before six p.m. today.
questions.explanation: 「We can keep it at the counter until six p.m. today.」より、今日の午後6時までに店で受け取る。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容か、本文と食い違う内容。

title: Real-Life: International parcel
situation: You want to send a sweater to your cousin in Canada. At the post office counter, you hear the following conversation with the clerk.

questions.question: How can you make sure the box arrives next week?
choices: Send the box by standard mail, which takes about three weeks.
Choose the express service and attach a customs form to the box.
Mail the sweater without a form, using the standard service.
Ask the clerk to hold the box until next month.
questions.explanation: 「For the speed you need, express service is faster, but it requires a customs form.」より、速達を選び、税関申告書を箱に付ける。標準郵便は約3週間かかるので来週には間に合わない。申告書なしの郵送は受け付けられない。

title: Real-Life: Ski lift closure
situation: You are skiing with your friend at a mountain resort. You are now at the summit, and you want to get back to the base area. You hear the following announcement on the mountain radio.

questions.question: How can you get back to the base area?
choices: Ride the cable car from the summit to the base.
Ski down the Eagle run to the base area.
Take the Summit Express, which is now open again.
Ride the gondola from the base area back to the top.
questions.explanation: 「Skiers at the top are asked to use the Blue Ridge gondola instead」より、山頂からブルーリッジのゴンドラ(ロープウェイ)で麓へ戻る。イーグル・コースは氷のため閉鎖、サミット・エクスプレスは再開時間が未定で使えない。

title: Real-Life: Tax filing deadline
situation: You are a freelance designer. All of your records for this year are on paper, and you have not finished your tax return. It is Thursday, and you call the tax office. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: Which option should you choose before Friday?
choices: Telephone the office to request more time before Friday.
Hand in the paper forms at the office on Friday evening.
Attach scanned receipts to the online form before midnight.
Request an extension through the website tonight.
questions.explanation: 「Filers who keep their records only on paper cannot file online.」と「they must request an extension by phone before Friday」をつなぐ。紙の記録しかないので、オンラインは使えず、金曜より前に電話で延長を申し込む。金曜の夕方は閉庁後で、延長はウェブサイトでは受け付けない。

title: Real-Life: Loan meeting schedule
situation: You applied for a home loan at Eastbank. The loan officer calls you about your appointment, and you hear the following conversation.

questions.question: What should you do to keep the Thursday appointment?
choices: Visit the Lake Street branch on Monday at ten.
Provide this year's income statement to the bank by Wednesday.
Meet the manager on Tuesday at two in the afternoon.
Send last year's income statement to the bank tonight.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the income statement by Wednesday」と「this year's statement」。月曜の10時は最初の時間、火曜の2時は取りやめで、去年の書類は使えないと訂正されている。

title: Real-Life: Tap water boil notice
situation: You live on Pine Street. You hear the following recorded message from the water company.

questions.question: What should you do before drinking tap water?
choices: Heat tap water to a boil before drinking it.
Bring your own bottle to the water company office.
Use the tap water only for washing the floor.
Wait until the notice is lifted by text message.
questions.explanation: 「please boil all water before you drink it」より、水道水は沸騰させてから飲む。水道会社の事務所で水を受け取る、床だけに使う、通知が解除されるのを待つという内容は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Festival shuttle bus
situation: You are going to a summer music festival by car, but the parking lot at the park may be full. You hear the following announcement on the radio.

questions.question: How should you get to the festival if you plan to drive?
choices: Drive to Green Park and park in the main lot.
Pay ten dollars to park at the main gate.
Leave your car at Riverside Station and ride the free shuttle bus.
Take the shuttle from Green Park every fifteen minutes.
questions.explanation: 「park your car at the Riverside Station car park and take the free shuttle bus」より、車はリバーサイド駅の駐車場に停め、無料のシャトルバスに乗る。グリーンパークの駐車場は満車で、正門の駐車場は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Brake repair estimate
situation: Your car makes a grinding noise when you brake. You are taking it to a garage, and you are planning a trip to the coast tomorrow. You hear the following conversation with the mechanic.

questions.question: What should the man do to drive to the coast safely tomorrow?
choices: Skip the brake work and drive carefully to the coast.
Ask for the rear discs to be replaced today.
Get the worn front brake pads changed today.
Drive to the coast and have the brakes checked there.
questions.explanation: 「The front brake pads are worn out, so they need to be replaced today.」より、前のブレーキパッドを今日交換する。後ろのディスクは取り寄せになり今日はできず、ブレーキの作業を飛ばすのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Blood test results
situation: You had a blood test at Greenway Clinic last week. The doctor said the results would be ready today, but you have not received them. You call the clinic and hear the following conversation with the nurse.

questions.question: How can you find out your test results?
choices: Ask the nurse to read the results to you over the phone.
Come to the clinic on Monday to receive the results.
Wait at home until the results arrive in the mail.
Head to the clinic in person on Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「Dr. Patel asked me not to share them over the phone」と「Dr. Patel is available on Friday afternoon」をつなぐ。結果は電話では伝えられず、金曜の午後に直接診察室で説明を受ける。月曜は予約がいっぱいなので、月曜に来るのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Spring recital venue
situation: Your daughter is performing in the spring recital at Lakeside Music School. You hear the following message from the school on your phone.

questions.question: Where and when should your daughter arrive for the recital?
choices: Take her to the main hall on Sunday at six p.m.
Escort her to the side entrance of the small hall by five thirty.
Go to the small hall on Saturday at four p.m.
Enter the small hall through the main entrance at six p.m.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the recital will take place in the small hall on Sunday at six p.m.」と「Performers must arrive at the side entrance by five thirty」。大ホールは壊れ、土曜の小ホールは結婚式で使われるため変更されている。正面の入口は保護者用で、出演者は通用口から入る。

title: Real-Life: Tennis court moved indoors
situation: You booked an outdoor tennis court at Westbridge Sports Club for this morning. When you arrive, you hear the following announcement.

questions.question: How can you play tennis today?
choices: Play on the outdoor courts once the rain stops.
Cancel the reservation and get a refund by mail.
Ask the coach for a private lesson at home.
Head to Court Two inside the Sports Hall.
questions.explanation: 「Your reserved court time has been moved to indoor Court Two in the Sports Hall.」より、予約した時間はスポーツホールの屋内2番コートで使う。屋外コートは大雨のため閉鎖されている。払い戻しやコーチのレッスンは本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Community bike repair clinic
situation: Your bicycle has a flat tire, and the brakes do not work well. You hear the following announcement from the community center.

questions.question: How can you make sure your bicycle is repaired on Saturday?
choices: Bring your electric bicycle for a frame repair.
Book a time slot on the website by Thursday.
Arrive at the community center on Saturday evening.
Buy spare parts from the volunteers on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 「please reserve a time slot on our website by Thursday」より、木曜日までにウェブサイトで時間枠を予約する。予約なしでも来られるが、必ず修理できるとは限らない。電動自転車やフレームは修理の対象外。

title: Real-Life: Orchestra rehearsal location
situation: You play the violin in a youth orchestra. You hear the following voicemail from the conductor's assistant.

questions.question: What should you do on Thursday if you play the violin?
choices: Arrive early at the upstairs music room of the community school.
Go to the main hall at the usual time.
Use the elevator to reach the second-floor room.
Go to the community school on Monday for the sectional.
questions.explanation: 「only the string players should bring their music stands」と「Everyone should arrive fifteen minutes early」をつなぐ。バイオリンは弦楽器なので、コミュニティスクールの2階の音楽室へ15分早く行く。主ホールは塗装中で、エレベーターは止まっている。月曜のパート練習は管楽器と金管楽器だけ。

title: Real-Life: Cinema seats for wheelchair users
situation: You use a wheelchair, and you want to watch a movie this Saturday with two friends at Star Cinema. You call the cinema and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you and your two friends sit together?
choices: Phone the cinema a day ahead to reserve the seats next to you.
Book the accessible seats online on the day of the show.
Arrive at the cinema fifteen minutes after the show starts.
Ask the box office to hold extra seats on the day.
questions.explanation: 「can be reserved only by phone」と「the front-row seats next to you will be held for you only if you book at least one day in advance」をつなぐ。電話で少なくとも1日前までに予約すれば、隣の席を確保できる。オンライン予約や当日の追加席は確保できない。

title: Real-Life: Rescheduled hospital appointment
situation: You have a hospital appointment on Tuesday. You hear the following message on your voicemail from Lakeside Medical Center.

questions.question: What should you do before your Thursday appointment?
choices: Go to Dr. Ito's office on Tuesday at ten a.m.
Obtain your blood test results from the second-floor laboratory before Thursday.
Visit the clinic on Wednesday for the rescheduled visit.
Have the results faxed to the clinic this week.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Dr. Shah cannot see you unless you bring your blood test results」と「the laboratory is closed on Wednesdays」。火曜の予約は医師が休暇のため変更され、水曜の受診は取りやめ、結果のファックスも今回は不可と訂正されている。

title: Real-Life: Coffee shop loyalty card
situation: You are a regular customer at Bean Corner, and you have been collecting stamps on your loyalty card. You hear the following announcement at the shop.

questions.question: How can you get your free drink?
choices: Present your membership card at the register before ordering.
Pay for ten drinks at the counter in advance.
Mail your loyalty card to the head office.
Download a new card from the shop website.
questions.explanation: 「When you have ten stamps, you can get one free drink.」と「show your card at the register before you order」より、スタンプが10個たまったら、注文の前にレジでカードを見せる。ほかの選択肢は本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Address change at city hall
situation: You moved to a new apartment in the city last week. You visit the city hall counter and hear the following conversation with a staff member.

questions.question: How should you update your address today?
choices: Visit the post office to report your new address.
Send your lease agreement to the city hall by mail.
Present your residence card and lease agreement at this counter.
Wait two weeks before reporting your move.
questions.explanation: 「you need to bring your residence card and proof of your new address」と「a lease agreement is fine」より、窓口で住民カードと賃貸契約書を見せる。郵便局への届け出は不要で、引っ越しから14日以内に手続きする必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Campus parking permit change
situation: You are a new student who drives to campus. You hear the following announcement from the university's parking office.

questions.question: What should a new student do to park on campus?
choices: Visit the paper counter at the Student Center on Friday.
Wait for a plastic card at the Parking Office this week.
Submit an online request through the university portal and print the temporary permit.
Park in the reserved spaces until the card arrives.
questions.explanation: 「New students should apply through the university portal. Once approved, they can print a temporary permit at home.」より、新入生はポータルから申請し、承認されたら仮の許可証を自宅で印刷する。紙の窓口は金曜に閉まり、プラスチックのカードは学期の1週目のあとでしか受け取れない。

title: Real-Life: Health screening sign-up
situation: You are a forty-five-year-old resident of Westbridge City. You have not had a health check-up for three years. You hear the following announcement at the city hall.

questions.question: How can you join the free screening?
choices: Join the waiting list online, since you had a check-up two years ago.
Register on the day at the community hall before the session.
Send a letter to the city council by Friday.
Phone the hall by Wednesday to book a Saturday slot.
questions.explanation: 「Residents who have had a screening in the last two years are not eligible」より、3年前に受けた人は対象。「Appointments are made by phone」と「register by the Wednesday before the session」をつなぐ。水曜までに電話で予約する。当日受付やオンライン予約は、この事業では受け付けていない。

title: Real-Life: Sports day rain plan
situation: Your son is in the fourth grade at Oakridge Primary School. You hear the following message from the school.

questions.question: What should your son wear and bring on Saturday?
choices: Wear outdoor shoes and go to the main field at nine a.m.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a water bottle.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a towel.
Arrive at the school gate by twelve thirty.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Students should wear indoor sports shoes, not outdoor shoes, and bring a water bottle」。運動会は体育館で午後1時から行う。メイングラウンドの午前9時は最初の案内で取り消され、タオルは本文にない。12時30分は保護者の集合時間。

questions.question: What is the current release plan for the domestic market?
choices: It has been delayed until October for repairs.
It will go ahead on the original schedule.
It will wait for the European certificate.
It will begin after the TV campaign is moved.
questions.explanation: 女性が「the engineers fixed the firmware faster than expected, so the September date is back on」と言い、ファームウェアのための10月への延期は撤回されて元の9月に戻った。男性2の「that won't arrive until late October」はヨーロッパ版だけの話。10月に延期という選択肢は撤回された予定、認証を待つという選択肢はヨーロッパ版の話、テレビ広告を移すという選択肢は却下された案。

questions.question: Why does the woman reject the suggestion to hold the whole campaign?
choices: The European certificate has already been issued.
Retailers have already placed orders for the launch.
The firmware problem has not been fully solved.
The agency cannot change the TV schedule now.
questions.explanation: 女性は「The domestic stores have already ordered stock for September, so waiting would just leave it sitting in their warehouses」と言い、店がすでに在庫を注文しているので広告を止めるべきではないと考えている。認証は「won't arrive until late October」でまだ届いておらず、ファームウェアは「fixed」と言われている。代理店がテレビ広告を変えられないという発言はない。

questions.question: What does the second man mean when he says, "we'll be advertising something people can't buy"?
choices: The domestic stores have already run out of the earbuds.
The whole TV campaign should be cancelled for now.
The online ads cost too much to keep running.
Buyers in Europe could not get the product yet.
questions.explanation: 男性2は「the online ads we booked for Europe should be moved」と言った直後にこの発言をしている。ヨーロッパ版は認証が「late October」まで届かず売れないので、広告だけ先に流れてしまうという意味。国内の在庫切れの話はなく、テレビ広告全体を止める案は女性が「I'd rather not」と却下している。広告費の話はない。

title: Private room for a client dinner
graphic:

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which room will the man most likely request?
choices: The Terrace Room
The Captain's Room
The Cellar Room
The Lantern Room
questions.explanation: ランタン・ルームは「won't work」、テラス・ルームは「that room is partly outdoors」で雨のため外れ、キャプテンズ・ルームはピアノのため「We'd be shouting over the music」と退けられた。男性の「we also need somewhere we can show slides」と表の「Built-in screen」を合わせると、セラー・ルームになる。

questions.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "We'd be shouting over the music"?
choices: The guests have asked for live entertainment.
The piano should be moved to another room.
The room would be too noisy for a presentation.
The dinner should end before the music starts.
questions.explanation: 女性は直前に「we need to walk them through our proposal after dessert」と言っており、ピアノが「plays all evening」の部屋では提案の説明ができないという意味。お客様が演奏を望んだという話はなく、ピアノを動かす・夕食を早く終えるという発言もない。

questions.question: Why will the man mention the printed menus today?
choices: The guest list may grow again by tomorrow.
The finance team has asked to see the menu.
The Lantern Room booking must be changed first.
The restaurant needs advance notice to prepare them.
questions.explanation: 男性は「Last time they told me that takes three days' notice, so I'll mention it today」と言っている。名前入りのメニューには前もっての連絡が必要だからである。財務チームは夕食会に加わるだけで、メニューを見たいとは言っていない。ランタン・ルームは「won't work」と言われたが、メニューの話とは関係がない。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which session will the woman most likely attend?
choices: The Tuesday afternoon session
The Wednesday morning session
The Thursday afternoon session
The Monday morning session
questions.explanation: 月曜は「That one's full」、水曜は女性が「I'm meeting suppliers on Wednesday morning」で外れ、火曜は表では席が残っているが「The Tuesday session has been cancelled」と訂正された。女性の「the only option left is the last one of the week」と表を合わせると、木曜の15時のオンライン研修になる。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "the trainer can see exactly where you get stuck"?
choices: The trainer will visit her desk on Thursday.
An online session can still give her personal help.
She should record her screen before the session.
The trainer has already noticed her problem.
questions.explanation: 女性が「I'd prefer to learn in a room with someone」と対面を望んだのに対し、男性は「the online ones let you share your screen」と続けている。オンラインでも画面を見ながら一人一人に合わせて教えてもらえるという意味。講師が席に来る・事前に録画する・講師がすでに気づいているという発言はない。

questions.question: Why will the man contact IT before sending the guide?
choices: His copy does not match the new app.
IT must approve every document he shares.
The guide was cancelled along with the session.
The woman has asked for a different guide.
questions.explanation: 男性は「the copy I have is for the old system, so let me ask IT for the updated one first」と言っている。手元の手引きは古いシステム用で、新しいアプリには合わないからである。中止になったのは火曜の研修で、手引きではない。IT部の承認が必要だという発言もない。

questions.question: What does the second woman imply when she says, "the sales team holds meetings next door every morning"?
choices: The training room may be too noisy in the mornings.
The training room has already been booked by sales.
The sales team will share the room with callers.
The desks in the training room are not suitable.
questions.explanation: 女性2は「the walls are thin」と言ってから、隣で毎朝会議があると続けている。男性も「Callers would hear everything」と受けているので、午前中は研修室がうるさくて電話の仕事に向かないという意味。机については「The desks are fine」と否定されており、営業チームが研修室を予約した・同じ部屋を使うという発言はない。

questions.question: Why does the second woman suggest asking the director today?
choices: The director will be away from the office tomorrow.
Approval usually has to be requested in advance.
The painters will start their work this afternoon.
The training room does not have enough desks.
questions.explanation: 女性が「she usually wants a week's notice」と言い、女性2が「Then let's ask her today」と続けている。塗装は「next Monday」に始まるので、前もって頼む必要がある。研修室は「It has enough desks for everyone」と言われており、部長が明日不在という発言はない。

questions.question: What will the man most likely do this afternoon?
choices: Ask for permission for some staff to work remotely.
Move his team's phones down to the second floor.
Reserve the training room for the sales team.
Ask the painters to finish the work more quickly.
questions.explanation: 男性の「I'll email her this afternoon」の her は、在宅勤務を承認する部長のこと(「Only with the director's approval」)。電話を移せるかは「could you check」と女性に頼んでおり、男性自身がすることではない。営業チームの予約や、塗装を早めてもらう話はない。

title: Final interview for an overseas candidate

questions.question: How will the final interview most likely be held?
choices: By video call on Thursday morning
In person at the head office next week
In person at a partner's office abroad
By telephone after the next quarter
questions.explanation: 木曜の対面面接は「we switched it to a video call」でビデオ通話に変わったが、部長が「won't make a hiring decision without meeting a candidate face to face」ため、それも「I'll cancel Thursday's video call」で取り消された。こちらに来てもらう案は「All travel spending is frozen」で却下された。最終的に「ask Ms. Okafor whether she can come to the partner's office on Friday」となり、ラゴスの提携先での対面になる。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "a video call won't satisfy her"?
choices: The director will insist on meeting the candidate in person.
The candidate would prefer to be interviewed in person.
The video system is not reliable enough to use.
The director is not available on Thursday morning.
questions.explanation: 男性2が「she won't make a hiring decision without meeting a candidate face to face」と伝えた直後の発言で、her は部長のこと。部長は直接会うことを求めるので、ビデオ通話では足りないという意味。対面を望んでいるのは候補者ではなく部長で、機材や木曜の都合の話はない。

questions.question: Why is flying the candidate in not an option?
choices: The candidate cannot leave Lagos next week.
Travel costs have been suspended for now.
The director will be away on Friday.
Finance has already paid for another trip.
questions.explanation: 男性は「All travel spending is frozen until next quarter」と言っている。候補者が来週末までラゴスにいることは、ビデオ通話に変えた理由であって、飛行機の案を断った理由ではない。部長が金曜に不在なのはラゴスを訪れるためで、飛行機の案とは別の話。

title: Missing figures for the forecast review

questions.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "Nobody's going to pick up"?
choices: Calling the regional office now would be pointless.
The Singapore office has closed down permanently.
The director will not answer her phone calls.
The report has already been sent by email.
questions.explanation: 女性は直前に「it's already past midnight in Singapore」と言っており、今は夜中なので電話しても誰も出ない、つまり今かけても意味がないという意味。事務所は「opens at around seven」と言われており閉鎖されたわけではない。部長に電話する話や、メールで届いたという話はない。

questions.question: Why does the woman not want to use last month's figures?
choices: Last month's figures contained several errors.
The region asked for its data to be withheld.
The meeting no longer needs that region's data.
The director has refused estimates in the past.
questions.explanation: 女性は「She turned that down the last time we tried it」と言い、部長が「estimates make the whole summary look unreliable」と考えていることを伝えている。男性の「The director wants every region in the summary」から、その地域の数字は今も必要。先月の数字に誤りがあるという発言はない。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do tomorrow morning?
choices: Ask the director to postpone the review.
Send the summary with estimated figures.
Call the Singapore office at midnight.
Contact the regional office before the meeting.
questions.explanation: 男性の「Their office opens at around seven our time」を受けて、女性が「I'll come in early, call them first thing, and finish the summary before nine」と言っている。推定値を使う案は部長が以前「turned that down」しており、会議を延ばす話や夜中に電話する話はない。

questions.question: Where will the cooking demonstration take place?
choices: In a room on the store's upper floor.
In a tent beside the front entrance.
In the bakery corner near the ovens.
At the customer service desk area.
questions.explanation: 最終的な会場は「the demonstration will take place in the community room upstairs」の2階の部屋。正面入口のテントは強風のため(「we can't put up the tent」)、ベーカリーの一角はオーブンで暑すぎるため(「too hot for a crowd」)取りやめになった。カスタマーサービスカウンターは整理券を受け取る場所。

questions.question: Who can receive free samples?
choices: Only members of the rewards program.
Only shoppers who are buying produce.
Any customer who visits the store.
Only people holding a seat ticket.
questions.explanation: 今朝の「free samples would go only to rewards members」は「That was a mistake.」と訂正され、「Samples are for every customer」と言っている。リワード会員だけという案内は撤回された情報。青果は会員のポイントが2倍になる対象で、整理券は実演の席のためのもの。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "the desk opened at ten this morning"?
choices: Shoppers should get a ticket soon.
The demonstration will start early.
The desk will close before noon today.
Samples are handed out at the desk.
questions.explanation: 「The community room has only forty seats」「Tickets ran out within an hour last year」に続けて、カウンターはもう10時に開いたと言っているので、整理券がすぐになくなるかもしれないから早めに受け取るよう促している。実演は2時ではなく2時半に遅くなっており、早まるわけではない。

title: Dental office voicemail: Cleaning rescheduled
graphic:
Open Appointments - Week of June 9
-----------------------------------
 Day         Time         Dentist

 Thursday    11:00 a.m.   Dr. Kim

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which day is the speaker offering the listener?
choices: Tuesday.
Wednesday.
Thursday.
Friday.
questions.explanation: 「mornings are hard for you ... so I've left out the early openings」で午前の枠を外し、「That leaves one time with Dr. Patel」と言っている。図表でパテル先生の午後の枠は水曜日の午後4時30分だけ。木曜日はキム先生が学会のため予約を変更する日で、火曜日と金曜日は午前の枠。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "has received excellent feedback from patients"?
choices: She hopes the listener will accept a different dentist.
She is explaining why Dr. Kim is attending a conference.
She is asking the listener to write a review of the clinic.
She is suggesting that Dr. Patel's schedule fills up quickly.
questions.explanation: 「I know you usually see Dr. Kim」と、いつもと違う先生になることを気にかけたうえで、新しく来たパテル先生の評判が良いことを伝え、安心して予約してもらおうとしている。学会はキム先生の不在の理由で、評判とは関係がない。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply about waiting until July?
choices: The listener's plan might not pay for it.
It would let the listener keep Thursday.
It is what Dr. Patel recommends.
It would require a morning visit.
questions.explanation: 7月まで待つ場合について「your insurance covers cleanings only once every six months, and July would be past that date」と言っているので、保険が使えなくなるおそれがあると示している。木曜日の枠はキム先生の学会でなくなった予定で、7月の空きは「next free afternoon」と午後。

title: Cleaning company: New office contract schedule

questions.question: When will the crews clean Harlow Tower?
choices: In the evening after the tenants go home.
On weekends when the offices are closed.
Before the office workers get in each day.
Between seven and nine o'clock at night.
questions.explanation: 最終的に「we've agreed on early mornings」「finish before the tenants come in at eight」と決まった。テナントが帰った後の夜の清掃は、搬入口が9時までしか開かないため取りやめになった予定。週末は保険の問題で却下された管理者の案。

questions.question: Why was the weekend option turned down?
choices: The crews' insurance would not apply then.
The loading entrance would be locked then.
The tenants use the offices on weekends.
Harlow's manager decided it cost too much.
questions.explanation: 「our insurance doesn't cover crews working when no building staff are on site」と言っている。週末はビルの職員がいないため、清掃員が保険の対象にならない。搬入口が閉まるのは夜の案を取りやめた理由で、週末の案とは別の話。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "That's no longer the case"?
choices: The client will deliver supplies on Friday.
The night schedule has been approved after all.
Jenna will no longer order cleaning products.
The company will now provide its own products.
questions.explanation: 「the client would supply the cleaning products」という先週の説明を取り消し、「we'll be using our own certified supplies」と言っている。金曜日は名簿を確定する日で、ジェナは今日用品を注文する。夜の清掃は取りやめのまま。

title: Fitness club: Pool heater repairs and aqua classes

questions.question: Why will the evening aqua class not be held at the Eastside branch?
choices: That branch refused to take any members.
That pool's heating system is being repaired.
That pool is too crowded at that time of day.
That class's instructor works only in the studio.
questions.explanation: 「Eastside's pool is smaller than ours, though, and it's already packed with their own members in the evenings」と「The evening aqua class won't move there」をつなぐと、夕方は混んでいるので移さないと分かる。イーストサイド店は「they've agreed」と受け入れを了承しており、修理するのは当クラブのプールの暖房設備。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "It runs on a separate heater"?
choices: The sauna will close for the next two weeks.
The sauna will not be affected by the repairs.
The sauna is available only at Eastside.
The sauna's heater will also be replaced.
questions.explanation: 「The sauna stays open as usual.」に続けて、サウナはプールとは別の暖房設備で動いていると説明しているので、プールの暖房の修理の影響を受けないという意味。

questions.question: What is mentioned about the morning aqua classes?
choices: They will be replaced by a studio workout.
They will keep their six thirty start time.
They will be canceled during the repairs.
They will begin a little later at another site.
questions.explanation: 「Our morning aqua classes will still run at Eastside, but they'll start at seven instead of six thirty」と言っている。イーストサイド店で、開始が30分遅くなる。スタジオでの運動に替わるのは夕方のクラス。

title: Library: Study room plan for language group
graphic:
Study Rooms - Second Floor
---------------------------------------
 Room   Seats   Equipment
 201    4       Whiteboard

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which room will the language exchange group use?
choices: Room 202.
Room 203.
Room 201.
Room 204.
questions.explanation: 「the group will stay in the room it originally booked」で、最初に予約した「our largest study room」のままになった。図表でいちばん席の多い部屋は14席の203号室。プロジェクターのあるもう1つの部屋(6席の202号室)は「it can't hold the twelve people」のため却下された案。

questions.question: Why was the main reading area not chosen?
choices: It does not have enough seats for twelve people.
The technician cannot bring a projector there.
The director wants to keep it for other visitors.
Group members would have to stay silent there.
questions.explanation: 「the quiet rule applies there until closing, and the group practices speaking」と言っている。話す練習をするグループが、静かにしなければならない場所は使えない。12人が入らないのは、プロジェクターのあるもう1つの部屋を却下した理由。閲覧エリアは館長自身が提案した場所。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Please ignore it"?
choices: The group will now begin at six thirty.
The time shown online is not correct.
The website is closed for maintenance.
The new booking rule is not in effect yet.
questions.explanation: ウェブサイトのお知らせの「the group starts at six thirty」について、「the start time is still seven」と言っているので、ウェブサイトの開始時刻は誤りだという意味。6時半はその誤った時刻。

title: Concert hall: Guest violinist replaced tonight

questions.question: What does the speaker mean when she says, "the music is in very good hands"?
choices: She is explaining why the concert will end early tonight.
She is suggesting that Ms. Ruiz may still join later.
She is assuring listeners that the replacement is capable.
She is announcing a change to the order of the program.
questions.explanation: 代わりの奏者について「He has performed this piece with the orchestra many times」と言った後なので、代役でも十分な演奏が期待できると聴衆を安心させている。曲順の変更は次の発言の内容で、この発言の意味ではない。ルイスさんは「cannot perform this evening」と言われている。

questions.question: What is suggested about the album signing?
choices: Mr. Cho will sign the albums in Ms. Ruiz's place.
The albums can be bought, but none will be signed.
The signing has been moved to the intermission.
The albums will be signed at the gift shop.
questions.explanation: 「That event is canceled, but her albums are still on sale at the gift shop」と言っている。サイン会は中止だが、アルバムは買える。ギフトショップは販売の場所で、サインをする場所ではない。

questions.question: Why would some listeners go to the box office during the intermission?
choices: To purchase one of Ms. Ruiz's recordings.
To get a refund for the canceled signing.
To meet Mr. Cho before the concerto begins.
To trade their tickets for a different concert.
questions.explanation: 「Guests who came mainly to hear Ms. Ruiz may exchange their tickets for another concert」と「Please visit the box office by the end of the intermission」をつなぐと、別の公演とチケットを交換するためだと分かる。アルバムを売っているのはギフトショップ。

questions.question: Is the product launch still scheduled for the fifteenth?
choices: It was, but marketing pushed it back to wait for the new packaging.
The launch party had about fifteen guests in the end.
The schedule is posted on the wall by the lunch room.
questions.explanation: 「製品の発売はまだ15日の予定か」。以前はそうだったが、マーケティング部が新しい包装を待つために延期したと、予定の変更を伝えている。「launch party … fifteen guests」は launch と fifteen を繰り返しただけで、日程に答えていない。「lunch room」は launch と音が似た語のひっかけで、予定表の場所を言っているだけ。

questions.question: Didn't you say the client wanted the blue design?
choices: The design team sits in the corner by the window.
The blue folder with the contract is on your desk.
At first, but they changed their minds after seeing the samples.
questions.explanation: 「顧客は青のデザインを希望していると言っていなかったか」。最初はそうだったが、見本を見て考えを変えたと、撤回された希望を伝えている。「design team」は design を、「blue folder」は blue を繰り返しただけで、顧客の希望に答えていない。

questions.question: Who's replacing Ms. Tanaka as head of the Osaka office?
choices: They'd picked Mr. Lee, but he turned it down last night.
Yes, the Osaka office is being renovated this year.
She's placing an order for new desks this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「大阪支社の責任者として田中さんの後任は誰か」。リーさんが選ばれていたが、昨夜断ったと答え、後任がまだ決まっていないことを伝えている。「Yes, the Osaka office …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。「placing an order」は replacing と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: I thought the shuttle to the conference center left at eight.
choices: That was the old timetable. It leaves at seven thirty now.
The conference center has a large parking area.
I left my name badge at the hotel this morning.
questions.explanation: 「会議場へのシャトルは8時発だと思っていた」に、それは古い時刻表で、今は7時半発だと訂正している。「conference center … parking area」は場所を繰り返しただけで、出発時刻に答えていない。「I left my name badge」は left を「置き忘れた」の意味で使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: Are we using the same caterer as last year, or a new one?
choices: Last year's party was held in the main hall downstairs.
Yes, the caterer's trucks are parked outside the gate.
A new one was booked, but they canceled, so it's last year's again.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「去年と同じ仕出し業者か、新しい業者か」。新しい業者を予約したが取り消されたので、結局去年の業者に戻ったと答えている。「Last year's party」は last year を繰り返しただけで、会場の話をしている。選択疑問文に Yes で答えている「Yes, the caterer's trucks …」も、どちらかを選んでいない。

questions.question: Would you like me to reserve a table for the client dinner?
choices: The new dining table was delivered to the lounge.
Thanks, but the client said they'd rather meet at their office.
The tablet's battery needs to be charged again.
questions.explanation: 「顧客との夕食のためにテーブルを予約しましょうか」。顧客は先方の事務所で会うほうがいいと言っていたと答え、予約は要らないと間接的に断っている。「dining table」は table・dinner から連想される語のひっかけ。「tablet」は table と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Where are the extra chairs for the seminar?
choices: Yes, the seminar was very helpful for our team.
Facilities only brought enough for the speakers.
The chairperson will open the session at ten.
questions.explanation: 「セミナー用の予備のいすはどこか」。施設管理部は講演者の分しか持ってこなかったと答え、予備のいすはないことを間接的に伝えている。「Yes, the seminar …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。「chairperson」は chairs と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Why hasn't the software update been installed yet?
choices: The updated price list is attached to the e-mail.
I installed a new shelf in my office last week.
IT is waiting until everyone logs off tonight.
questions.explanation: 「ソフトウェアの更新がまだインストールされていないのはなぜか」。IT 部は今夜全員がログオフするまで待っていると、理由を間接的に答えている。「updated price list」は update を、「installed a new shelf」は install を繰り返しただけで、理由に答えていない。

questions.question: The quarterly report needs a few more charts.
choices: Daniel's already on it, so you can leave that to him.
Quarterly sales rose by four percent this year.
Our train is departing at a quarter past nine.
questions.explanation: 「四半期報告書にはもう少しグラフが必要だ」に、ダニエルがもう取りかかっているので彼に任せてよいと答えている。「Quarterly sales rose」は報告書から連想される内容で、グラフの追加に応じていない。「a quarter past nine」は quarterly と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: When can you send me the signed contract?
choices: Legal still hasn't finished reviewing the last page.
I signed up for the evening course yesterday.
Yes, the contract is valid for two years.
questions.explanation: 「署名済みの契約書はいつ送ってもらえるか」。法務部が最後のページの確認をまだ終えていないと答え、まだ送れないことを間接的に伝えている。「signed up」は signed を別の意味で使ったひっかけ。「Yes, the contract …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。

questions.question: Has the budget for the trade show been finalized?
choices: The trade show booth is right by the entrance.
It had been, but finance cut it again this morning.
The final round of interviews is held today.
questions.explanation: 「見本市の予算は確定したか」。一度は確定したが、今朝経理部がまた削ったと答え、確定した予算が覆されたことを伝えている。「trade show booth」は trade show を繰り返しただけで、予算に答えていない。「final round」は finalized と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Isn't Ms. Rivera leading the workshop on Tuesday?
choices: She was going to, but she's at the Chicago branch this week.
Tuesday's workshop room has a brand-new projector.
The riverside hotel is fully booked for the week.
questions.explanation: 「火曜の研修はリベラさんが担当するのではないのか」。その予定だったが、今週はシカゴ支店にいると答え、予定が変わって彼女は担当しないことを伝えている。「Tuesday's workshop room」は Tuesday と workshop を繰り返しただけで、担当者に答えていない。「riverside」は Rivera と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Which supplier did we go with for the packaging?
choices: Yes, the packages arrived at the warehouse this morning.
We chose Delta first, but switched to Hanson over the price.
I went with my manager to visit the factory.
questions.explanation: 「包装の仕入れ先はどこに決めたか」。最初はデルタ社を選んだが、価格を理由にハンソン社に切り替えたと答えている。最終的に有効なのはハンソン社。「Yes, the packages …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答え、packaging と似た packages を使ったひっかけ。「went with my manager」は go with を「一緒に行く」の意味で使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: I heard the office move has been delayed until spring.
choices: The moving boxes are stacked in the storage room.
That was the plan, but now it's back on for next month.
The spring catalog was mailed out yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「事務所の移転は春まで延期されたと聞いた」に、そういう予定だったが、今は来月に戻ったと答え、延期が取り消されたことを伝えている。「moving boxes」は move から連想される語、「spring catalog」は spring を繰り返しただけで、移転の時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Should we take the train to the plant, or will the company send a car?
choices: The plants in the lobby need to be watered daily.
Training for the new staff starts on Monday morning.
A car was arranged, but it fell through, so we'll take the train.
questions.explanation: 選択疑問文「工場まで電車で行くか、会社が車を出すか」。車を手配したが話が流れたので、電車で行くと答えている。最終的に有効なのは電車。「plants in the lobby」は plant を「植物」の意味で使ったひっかけ。「Training」は train と音が似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Can you help me move these boxes after lunch?
choices: The lunch boxes are in the fridge in the kitchen.
I've got a call with a client at one, unfortunately.
We're moving to a bigger office next year.
questions.explanation: 「昼食後にこの箱を運ぶのを手伝ってもらえるか」。あいにく1時に顧客との電話があると答え、手伝えないことを間接的に伝えている。「lunch boxes」は lunch と boxes を組み合わせたひっかけ。「moving to a bigger office」は move を「引っ越す」の意味で使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: How did the presentation go this morning?
choices: Yes, I presented the sales data to the board.
The present was wrapped in gold paper.
The client asked for a second meeting, so pretty well.
questions.explanation: 「今朝の発表はどうだったか」。顧客が2回目の打ち合わせを求めてきたので、かなりうまくいったと答えている。「Yes, I presented …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。「present … wrapped」は presentation と音が似た語(贈り物)のひっかけ。

questions.question: Who's going to pick up the visitors from the airport?
choices: They've said they'll take a taxi to the hotel.
The visitors' center opens at nine every day.
I picked a window seat on the flight.
questions.explanation: 「空港まで来客を迎えに行くのは誰か」。来客はホテルまでタクシーで行くと言っていると答え、迎えは要らないことを間接的に伝えている。「visitors' center」は visitors を繰り返しただけ。「picked a window seat」は pick を「選ぶ」の意味で使い、空港から連想される flight を加えたひっかけ。

questions.question: The new filing system is pretty confusing.
choices: The filing cabinets were moved upstairs.
The files were sent by courier yesterday.
Kenji wrote a short guide. I'll forward it to you.
questions.explanation: 「新しい書類整理の仕組みはかなり分かりにくい」に、ケンジが短い手引きを書いたので転送すると、解決策で答えている。「filing cabinets」は filing を、「files … by courier」は files を繰り返しただけで、分かりにくさに応じていない。

questions.question: Don't you think we should hire another designer?
choices: The higher floors have a better view of the park.
Let's see how busy we get after the holidays first.
The designer's name is printed on the label.
questions.explanation: 「もう1人デザイナーを雇うべきだと思わないか」。まず休暇明けにどれだけ忙しくなるか様子を見ようと答え、今は決めないことを間接的に伝えている。「higher floors」は hire と音が同じ higher のひっかけ。「designer's name」は designer を繰り返しただけ。

questions.question: When does the new parking policy take effect?
choices: Starting on the first of next month.
Yes, it's a very effective policy.
In the lot behind the main building.
questions.explanation: 「新しい駐車規則はいつから適用されるか」。来月1日からと、時期を答えている。「Yes, it's a very effective policy」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答え、effect と似た effective を使ったひっかけ。「In the lot behind …」は parking から連想される場所で、時期に答えていない。

questions.question: Could you give me a hand with this spreadsheet?
choices: Sure, what seems to be the problem?
I'll hand it in to my manager tomorrow.
The clean sheets are in the closet.
questions.explanation: 「この表計算シートを手伝ってもらえるか」。もちろん、何が問題かと、手伝いを引き受けている。「hand it in」は hand を「提出する」の意味で使ったひっかけ。「clean sheets」は spreadsheet と音が重なる sheets のひっかけ。

questions.question: Where should I leave the delivery for Mr. Chen?
choices: He's leaving for Tokyo on Friday morning.
Delivery is usually free for large orders.
His assistant can sign for it at the front desk.
questions.explanation: 「チェンさん宛ての配達物はどこに置けばよいか」。受付で彼のアシスタントが受け取れると、場所と受け取る人で答えている。「leaving for Tokyo」は leave を「出発する」の意味で使ったひっかけ。「Delivery is usually free」は delivery を繰り返しただけで、置き場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Have you met the new accountant yet?
choices: The meeting was very productive.
I opened a new account at the bank.
We had lunch together on Monday.
questions.explanation: 「新しい会計士にもう会ったか」。月曜に一緒に昼食をとったと、会ったことを言い換えて答えている。「meeting」は met と似た語、「account」は accountant と似た語のひっかけ。

questions.question: Why is the east entrance closed today?
choices: It's closer to the station.
They're repainting the doors.
Yes, it's the main entrance.
questions.explanation: 「今日はなぜ東口が閉まっているのか」。ドアを塗り直していると、理由を答えている。「closer」は closed と音が似た語のひっかけ。「Yes, it's the main entrance」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。

title: A stalled train before a client pitch

questions.question: What will the man most likely do at the start of the meeting?
choices: Ask the client to start the meeting an hour later.
Share the woman's screen during a video call.
Open the final slides from the shared folder.
Give the presentation using a file the woman emails him.
questions.explanation: 男性は最後に「Then I'll present from your file」と言っており、その直前に女性が「I can email you the file now」と申し出ている。女性がメールで送るファイルを使って男性が説明する、が正解。開始を11時に遅らせる案は、バイヤーが正午に出発するため「Let's not」と退けられた。ビデオで画面を共有する案は「The signal here is too weak for video」で却下された。共有フォルダの最終版は「I never uploaded the final version to the shared folder」とあり、そもそも存在しない。

title: Taking parents to a riverside restaurant

questions.question: What will the man probably do on Sunday?
choices: Bring his parents to the restaurant soon after it opens.
Book a table at the restaurant for a group of six.
Take his parents to the restaurant for dinner instead.
Wait in line with his parents at the restaurant at noon.
questions.explanation: 女性の「they open at eleven, and when I walked past at ten past, there were only a few people outside」と、それを受けた男性の「My parents are up by six every day, so that wouldn't be hard for them at all」をつなぐと、開店直後に両親を連れて行くつもりだとわかる。予約は「Only for groups of six or more」で3人では使えない。夕食は「dinner is even busier」で退けられた。正午は行列ができる時間で、父親は待つのが嫌いなので選ばない。

title: Weekend shifts at a food bank

questions.question: What has the man agreed to let his daughter do?
choices: Sort donations at the food bank on Saturday mornings.
Work the full four-hour shift on Sunday afternoons.
Do a short Sunday shift until her exams end.
Help at the food bank every other week only.
questions.explanation: 日曜の午後の案に対する、いとこの訪問という反対は「they're switching their visits to Saturday evenings」で取り消された。続く4時間は長いという反対には「high school students can do a two-hour shift instead」と答え、父親は「Then do the shorter shift」と認めている。さらに「but only until your exams are over」と期限を付けているので、最終的に有効なのは、試験が終わるまで日曜の短いシフトで手伝うこと。土曜の午前は模試があるので退けられた。4時間のシフトは長すぎるとされ、短いシフトに変わった。「every other week」はいとこの訪問の頻度で、ボランティアの頻度ではない。

title: Hotel rules for a trade fair trip

questions.question: What will the man most likely ask the travel desk to do?
choices: Book a room at one of the contract hotels.
Approve a stay at a hotel outside the contract.
Cover his meals while he stays with a friend.
Arrange a flight to Osaka for the trade fair.
questions.explanation: 女性の「stays anywhere else aren't reimbursed」と、サンジェイについての「the travel desk made an exception for him」、さらに「I'd do what Sanjay did」をつなぐと、男性が出す「that request」は契約外のホテルへの宿泊を例外として認めてもらう申請だとわかる。契約ホテルは「both of them are fully booked」で使えない。友人宅に泊まる案は「the company won't cover your meals either」とされ、男性も採らなかった。大阪はサンジェイが出張した場所で、男性の行き先は福岡。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do?
choices: Attend the training session held overseas.
Take the online version in March.
Wait for the September course instead.
Ask to delay the Lindgren launch.
questions.explanation: 部長の反対は「The Lindgren launch has been moved up to February」で解消し、パスポートの問題には女性自身が「I'll renew my passport this week and register before Friday」と答えている。パスポートを更新して申し込むのはシンガポールで行われる3月の研修なので、それに参加すると判断できる。オンライン版は「That was cancelled」で取り消された。9月の研修は3月に出られない場合の話で、3月が空いたので不要になった。リンドグレンの開始は延期ではなく前倒しになっており、延期を頼む話は出ていない。

title: Where to put a new city hall

questions.question: What did the council finally decide to do?
choices: Construct a new building where the old one stood.
Build a new city hall on farmland outside town.
Rent offices inside a downtown shopping mall.
Move its departments permanently into a former school.
questions.explanation: 「In the end, the council voted to rebuild on the original site in the city center」とあり、最終的には元の場所に建て直すことになった。町はずれの農地に建てる案と、ショッピングモールを借りる案は、どちらも却下された案。かつての学校は「temporary offices ... for three years」とあるように一時的な移転先で、恒久的に移るわけではない。

questions.question: Why was the shopping mall plan rejected?
choices: Residents could only reach the mall easily by car.
The building might not be open whenever the city needed it.
The rent was higher than the cost of new construction.
Shop owners refused to share their space with city staff.
questions.explanation: 「the city could not guarantee access to the building outside the mall's business hours」とあり、営業時間外に建物を使えないおそれがあったため却下された。車でなければ行きにくいというのは、農地の案に対する住民の反対理由。家賃が建設費より高い、店主が場所の共有を拒んだ、は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the accuracy of the volunteers' counts?
choices: They are too unreliable to be used in serious scientific studies.
They reflect general patterns well but can overlook uncommon birds.
They are more precise than the counts made by professional experts.
They became accurate only after hunters joined the project.
questions.explanation: 「the overall trends matched closely, although beginners did tend to miss rare species」をまとめると、全体の傾向は正しく表すが珍しい鳥を見落とすことがある、となる。科学に使えないほど不正確というのは、当初の「some researchers doubted」で、後の研究で否定された内容。専門家より正確、狩猟をする人が加わってから正確になった、は本文にない。

questions.question: What concern do the organizers have about the project's future?
choices: Photos of unusual birds are becoming difficult to verify.
Birds may soon move too far north to be counted at all.
It may struggle to attract enough participants in coming years.
Experienced volunteers are unwilling to train new members.
questions.explanation: 「the project depends entirely on people giving up their free time」と「few younger people have joined in recent years and ... the average age of participants keeps rising」をつなぐと、将来、十分な参加者を集められなくなるおそれがあると分かる。写真の確認が難しい、鳥が北へ移りすぎて数えられない、経験者が新人の指導を嫌がる、は本文にない。

title: Saving a mountain town's harvest festival

questions.question: What has the committee finally decided about the procession?
choices: The shrines will travel on carts, with student helpers allowed.
The procession will be held on just one of the two days.
Paid carriers from other areas will carry the heavy shrines.
Only elders will be allowed to take part in the procession.
questions.explanation: 「the shrines will be moved on lighter wheeled carts, and students from a nearby university who join the town's preservation society will be allowed to help」が最終的な合意。1日に短縮する案は商店主の抗議で撤回され、外部の専門の担ぎ手を雇う案は長老の反対で採用されなかった。長老だけが参加できる、は本文にない。

questions.question: Why was the plan to shorten the festival withdrawn?
choices: Elders insisted that only local people should carry the shrines.
Young residents offered to carry the shrines after all.
The festival was moved to a different weekend in autumn.
Businesses relied on the visitors who came on the second day.
questions.explanation: 「Local shop owners protested, saying the second day brought in most of their visitors, so that plan was withdrawn」とあり、商店が2日目の客に頼っていたため撤回された。地元の人だけが担ぐべきだというのは、外部の担ぎ手を雇う案に対する長老の反対理由。若者が結局担ぐと申し出た、別の週末に移した、は本文にない。

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the evidence for social prescribing?
choices: Its advantages appear more modest than early reports suggested.
It has been shown to replace medicine for most patients.
Larger studies found that it brought no benefits at all.
It works best for patients who have serious illnesses.
questions.explanation: 初期の報告(「patients who joined such activities visited their doctors less often」)に対し、「More recent studies with larger groups have found smaller benefits, though still positive ones」とあり、効果は当初の報告より控えめだと分かる。大規模な研究で効果がまったくなかった、は「still positive ones」で否定されている。多くの患者で薬の代わりになる、重い病気の患者に最も効く、は本文と合わない。

questions.question: Why do some health officials want community groups funded from the health budget?
choices: Doctors are refusing to prescribe medicine to lonely patients.
Programs fail where there are too few local activities to join.
Community groups currently charge patients very high fees.
Gardening clubs have proven more effective than any drug.
questions.explanation: 「the programs work only when local communities have enough clubs and volunteers, which is often not the case in poorer areas」を受けて「For this reason」と続くので、参加できる地域の活動が足りない所では取り組みが機能しないことが理由。医師が薬の処方を拒んでいる、団体が高い料金を取っている、ガーデニングがどの薬よりも効く、は本文にない。

questions.question: What rule is currently in effect for the scooters?
choices: They are banned from all of the city's streets entirely.
Each company may run only a limited number of them.
They must be left only in specially marked parking areas.
They may be used only by commuters during rush hour.
questions.explanation: 「Under the rules now in force, scooters may be parked only in marked zones」とあり、現在は指定区域にだけ止められる。全面禁止は採決前に見送られた案で、各社の台数の上限は後に取りやめになった案。通勤時間帯に通勤者だけが使える、は本文にない。

questions.question: Why did the council decide against a complete ban?
choices: Companies threatened to move scooters to the busiest areas.
Pedestrians said the scooters were no longer a problem.
Injury data showed that scooters were safer than cars.
Evidence showed that riders were making fewer short car trips.
questions.explanation: 「a transport study showed that many riders had stopped driving for short trips, so the ban was put aside」とあり、利用者が短い移動で車を使わなくなったという調査結果が理由。各社が混雑地域に移すと言ったのは、台数の上限の案が取りやめになった理由。歩行者がもう問題ないと言った、は本文にない。けがのデータは来年そろう予定で、まだ出ていない。

title: Real-Life: Sunday engineering works
situation: You need to travel from Ashford to Kingsley this Sunday morning with a large suitcase. You hear the following announcement at Ashford Station.

questions.question: How should you travel to Kingsley on Sunday?
choices: Ride the Dunmore line and transfer at Dunmore.
Catch a replacement bus in front of the station.
Get a taxi voucher from the ticket office.
Board a replacement bus at the Elm Street car park.
questions.explanation: 大きなスーツケースを持っているので、「suitcases and other large items cannot be taken on the replacement buses」により振替バスは使えない。タクシー券も「the voucher scheme has now ended」で撤回され、最終的な案内は「passengers with large luggage should take a train on the Dunmore line ... and change at Dunmore for Kingsley」。駅前のバス乗り場は「please ignore that information」で取り消され、エルム・ストリート駐車場のバスは大きな荷物がなければ使える、ほかの乗客向けの案内。

title: Real-Life: First pilates class
situation: You want to start taking pilates classes at Harbor Wellness Studio. You have never done pilates before, and you work until seven p.m. on weekdays. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Join the Tuesday beginner class at six p.m.
Call the studio to book an evening class.
Book a weekend class for beginners online.
Reserve a Saturday orientation on the website.
questions.explanation: 「anyone joining the studio for the first time must complete a thirty-minute safety orientation before taking any class」と「Orientations are held only on Saturday mornings, and they must be booked through our website, not by phone」をつなぐと、まず土曜日のオリエンテーションをウェブサイトで予約する必要がある。平日は午後7時まで仕事なので午後6時の初心者クラスには出られず、電話での予約は受け付けていない。週末のクラスは「for advanced members only」で初心者は受けられない。

title: Real-Life: Jazz festival day exchange
situation: You have a Saturday ticket for the Riverside Jazz Festival, but you now have to work on Saturday. You want to go on Sunday instead. You hear the following message on the festival's information line.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Swap your ticket in the festival app by Thursday.
Exchange your ticket at the box office on Sunday.
Ask for a refund because Sunday is sold out.
Buy a Sunday ticket at the gate on the day.
questions.explanation: 当日のチケット売り場での交換は「that service has now been withdrawn」で取り消され、最終的な方法は「all exchanges must be made through the official festival app, and the deadline is midnight this Thursday」。日曜日の完売も「a limited number of Sunday places have been released」で訂正され、その席は「available only to people exchanging a Saturday ticket」なので、土曜日のチケットを持つあなたは交換できる。払い戻しと入口での販売は「refunds are not available」「no tickets will be sold at the gate」で否定されている。

title: Real-Life: Cat not eating on Sunday
situation: Your cat has not eaten anything since this morning. It is now Sunday afternoon, and you call your local animal clinic. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Send a question through the online advice service.
Leave a message for the clinic on this line.
Call Riverside Animal Hospital before going there.
Take your cat to Maple Clinic on Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 「cats who stop eating can become seriously ill very quickly, so we treat this as an emergency」で、あなたの猫は緊急の扱いになる。「In an emergency, please go to Riverside Animal Hospital」と「Riverside asks owners to phone ahead before arriving」をつなぐと、リバーサイド動物病院に電話してから行けばよい。オンライン相談は一般的な質問向けで返事に最大1日かかり、留守番電話のメッセージは月曜日まで確認されない。月曜日まで待つのは緊急の対応にならない。

title: Real-Life: Apartment viewing rescheduled
situation: You booked a viewing of an apartment for this Friday at five p.m. You hear the following voicemail from the real estate agent, Ms. Clarke.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the apartment on Friday at five p.m.
Show your ID at the agent's office on Saturday.
Meet Ms. Clarke at the apartment at ten.
Email a copy of your ID to Ms. Clarke.
questions.explanation: 金曜日の内見は「Friday's viewing can't go ahead」で中止、土曜日10時の案内も「another client has since taken that time」で撤回された。残る土曜日3時は一人で見るので「you'll need to pick up the keys from our office on Main Street」、そのためには「We can only hand over keys to people who show photo ID in person」。メールでのコピーは「we can't accept that」で却下されているので、土曜日に事務所で身分証明書を見せて鍵を受け取る。クラークさんと10時に会う予定はなくなっている。

questions.question: Has the budget meeting been moved to Thursday?
choices: The travel budget was finally approved yesterday afternoon.
I moved into my new apartment last Thursday evening.
It was going to be, but the director kept it on Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 「予算会議は木曜日に移ったか」。移る予定だったが、部長が水曜日のままにしたと、取りやめになった変更を伝えている。「travel budget」は budget を繰り返しただけで、会議の日程に答えていない。「moved into my new apartment」は moved を「引っ越した」の意味で使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: Didn't Sarah agree to lead the training session?
choices: She did, until her flight to Seoul was moved up a week.
The training room is on the third floor, next to the lab.
Yes, we all agreed that the lead time was far too short.
questions.explanation: 「サラが研修の進行役を引き受けたのではなかったか」。引き受けていたが、ソウルへの出張が1週間早まったのでできなくなったと、撤回された予定を伝えている。「training room」は training を繰り返しただけで場所を言っている。「agreed … lead time」は agree と lead を別の意味で使ったひっかけ。

questions.question: Which supplier did we choose for the new packaging?
choices: The package arrived at the front desk this morning.
Legal turned down Westline's terms, so it's still open.
Yes, I chose the larger boxes for the free samples.
questions.explanation: 「新しい包装の仕入れ先はどこに決めたか」。法務部がウェストライン社の条件を却下したので、まだ決まっていないと答えている。「package arrived」は packaging と音が似た語のひっかけ。「Yes, I chose …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。

questions.question: I heard the client dinner is at the Italian place downtown.
choices: That was the first plan, but they asked for somewhere near their hotel.
The client signed the contract right after dinner on Friday night.
Downtown traffic is usually very heavy in the early evening.
questions.explanation: 「顧客との夕食は繁華街のイタリア料理店だと聞いた」に、それは最初の案で、先方がホテルの近くを希望したと、変わった予定を伝えている。「signed the contract right after dinner」は client と dinner を繰り返しただけ。「Downtown traffic」は downtown から連想される内容で、会場に答えていない。

questions.question: The handouts for tomorrow are ready to print, aren't they?
choices: The printer on this floor was repaired on Monday.
They were, but the sales figures have been revised.
Tomorrow's weather should be clear and warm.
questions.explanation: 「明日の配布資料は印刷できる状態ですよね」。そうだったが、売上の数字が修正されたので、まだ印刷できないと伝えている。「printer … repaired」は print から連想される語のひっかけ。「Tomorrow's weather」は tomorrow を繰り返しただけで、資料に答えていない。

title: A surprise party for a retiring teacher

questions.question: What will the woman probably do tonight?
choices: Book the back room of the café across from the school.
Ask the school to share former students' contact details.
Ask Mr. Ellis's daughter to help reach his former students.
Tell the café staff to keep the party plan a secret.
questions.explanation: 女性は「we can't reach most of them」と教え子に連絡がつかないことを悩み、男性の「His daughter might know a few」を受けて「I'll send her a message tonight」と言っている。2つをつなぐと、娘に教え子への連絡を手伝ってもらうつもりだとわかる。カフェは「the staff might mention it to him」で退けられた。学校は「doesn't keep students' contact details」ので頼めない。店員に口止めするという発言はない。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about the critics' concern?
choices: It is unlikely to be a serious problem because of how the system works.
It was shown to be correct after many false warnings had been sent.
It led researchers to stop collecting data from phones in large cities.
It has made professional seismic stations more expensive to build.
questions.explanation: 「Critics initially argued that phones would produce too many false alarms」に続けて「However, the system only reacts when hundreds of phones shake together, which rarely happens by chance」と言っている。2つをつなぐと、システムの仕組みのために誤報の心配は大きな問題にならないとわかる。誤報が多く出て正しいと分かったという内容は「However」で否定されている。都市の端末を使うのをやめた、観測所が高くなった、という話はない。

questions.question: What is one limitation of the system?
choices: Its warnings for quakes far from cities may come with little time to react.
Phone sensors are unable to feel the first, weaker waves of a quake.
It costs more to run than a network of professional seismic stations.
It sends too many alarms when people drop or run with their phones.
questions.explanation: 「phones are mostly concentrated in cities」と「warnings for earthquakes that begin in remote mountains or under the sea may arrive later, when there is little time left to act」をつなぐと、都市から遠い地震では警報が遅れ、行動する時間が少ないことが弱点だとわかる。センサーは「can also feel the first, weaker waves」とあり、観測所は「cost tens of thousands of dollars each」と高いのは観測所のほう。誤報の多さは批判として出たが「rarely happens by chance」と否定されている。

title: Real-Life: Washing machine will not drain
situation: Your two-year-old washing machine will not drain, even after you cleaned the filter. You work on weekdays from nine a.m. to six p.m., but your adult brother, who is staying with you, is at home all day. You do not want to pay for the repair.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Book an evening visit for a time after you finish work.
Take the machine to the company's service center.
Clean the filter at the bottom front of the machine.
Book a weekday visit and enter your brother's name.
questions.explanation: 「Machines under three years old are covered by our warranty, but only for visits on weekdays between eight a.m. and four p.m.」から、無料にするには平日の日中の訪問が必要。あなたは平日の日中は仕事だが、「This does not have to be the account holder, but please enter that person's name when you book」から、家にいる兄の名前を入力して予約すればよい。夜間の訪問は「for a fee of eighty dollars」で有料、持ち込みは「we do not accept machines brought to our service center」で受け付けていない。フィルターはすでに掃除してある。

questions.question: What title will be printed on Mr. Haas's business cards?
choices: Sales Manager
Regional Sales Manager
Regional Director
Design Director
questions.explanation: 注文の「Sales Manager」は、女性の「His promotion was announced this morning, so the title should be "Regional Director."」で訂正され、男性も「They haven't, so I'll update it now」と変更を受けている。Sales Manager は訂正前の肩書き。Regional Sales Manager と Design Director は本文に出た語を組み合わせただけで、言われていない。

questions.question: What will appear on the name badges?
choices: The logo planned for January
The company's current logo
Mr. Haas's new job title
The official trade fair logo
questions.explanation: 女性は昨日、新しいロゴを頼んだが、デザイナーが「keep the old logo until the rebranding becomes official in January」と連絡しており、女性も「Then the badges stay as they are」と受け入れている。名札は今のロゴのまま。1月のロゴは撤回された依頼。新しい肩書きは名刺の話で、見本市のロゴの話はない。

questions.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "we leave Thursday night"?
choices: The printing plates must be made by Thursday.
She will not be able to collect the order.
The trade fair has been moved to Thursday.
The badges should be printed with a new logo.
questions.explanation: 男性の「Everything will be ready on Friday morning. Will you pick it up here?」に対して、見本市は金曜の朝にハンブルクで始まり、木曜の夜に出発すると答えている。金曜の朝には店に取りに行けないという意味で、男性も「I'll have a courier deliver the order straight to your booth instead」と応じている。見本市は「opens in Hamburg at nine on Friday」で木曜には移っていない。印刷版の期限やロゴの話をしているのではない。

questions.question: What is true about the branch during the renovation?
choices: It is closed until the end of March.
Its main entrance is on Elm Street.
It is open for fewer hours each day.
Its services are at the Riverside branch.
questions.explanation: 先週の手紙の「closed completely」は「That information was incorrect」と訂正され、「The branch will remain open, but only from ten a.m. to three p.m.」と言っている。営業は続けるが、時間が短くなる。全面閉鎖は訂正された情報、エルム通りの正面入口は「will be closed」、リバーサイド支店への移転は「does not have enough space」で取りやめになった案。

questions.question: How can customers use their safe deposit boxes?
choices: By going to the Riverside branch
By arranging a visit to the Elm Street branch
By using the Parker Lane door at any time
By sending a letter to the bank's main office
questions.explanation: リバーサイド支店に移す案は「that branch does not have enough space」で取りやめになり、「customers can still access their safe deposit boxes here, by appointment only」と言っている。エルム通り支店に予約して行けばよい。パーカー通りの通用口は入口の案内で、予約なしでいつでも使えるわけではない。手紙を送るという話はない。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "you may wait several minutes"?
choices: Callers may prefer to book online.
The branch will open later than planned.
The phone system is not working today.
Safe deposit services have ended.
questions.explanation: 「Because our staff are handling a large number of calls」と待ち時間の理由を述べた直後に「You can also book an appointment on our website, which is available twenty-four hours a day」と続けている。電話で待つより、いつでも使えるウェブサイトで予約するほうがよいことをほのめかしている。開店時間が遅れる・電話が使えないという話はなく、貸金庫は「can still access」で続いている。

questions.question: Could you send me the agenda for tomorrow's call?
choices: I called the travel agent back yesterday.
Tomorrow's call should take about an hour.
Mr. Patel is still adding items to it.
questions.explanation: 「明日の電話会議の議題を送ってもらえますか」。パテルさんがまだ項目を追加していると答え、今はまだ送れないことを間接的に伝えている。「travel agent」は agenda と音が似た語、called は call を繰り返したひっかけ。「take about an hour」は会議の長さで、依頼に応じていない。

questions.question: Where should I put these boxes of brochures?
choices: Anywhere but the lobby—it's being cleaned.
Yes, the new brochures look great.
About two hundred copies in each.
questions.explanation: 「このパンフレットの箱はどこに置けばいいですか」。ロビーは清掃中なので、ロビー以外ならどこでもよいと答えている。「Yes, the new brochures …」は疑問詞の質問に Yes で答えている。「two hundred copies」は箱から連想される数量で、場所に答えていない。

questions.question: Why is the elevator closed this morning?
choices: There's a notice about it by the stairs.
It usually closes at nine on weekends.
Take the elevator up to the fifth floor.
questions.explanation: 「今朝エレベーターが止まっているのはなぜですか」。階段のそばに掲示があると答え、理由はそこに書いてあると間接的に伝えている。「closes at nine on weekends」は closed を繰り返しただけで、今朝の理由に答えていない。「Take the elevator」は elevator を繰り返したひっかけ。

questions.question: Do you want to review the proposal before I submit it?
choices: I trust you—just double-check the prices.
Yes, I submitted my report on time.
The review was posted on the website.
questions.explanation: 「提出する前に提案書を確認したいですか」。任せるので価格だけ再確認してほしいと答え、自分では見なくてよいと間接的に伝えている。「submitted my report」は submit を、「The review was posted」は review を繰り返しただけで、質問に答えていない。

questions.question: Isn't the new cafeteria opening next week?
choices: The cafeteria serves lunch from noon.
The kitchen equipment hasn't arrived yet.
I'll be away on business next week.
questions.explanation: 「新しい社員食堂は来週開くのではないのですか」。厨房の設備がまだ届いていないと答え、来週は開かない見込みであることを間接的に伝えている。「serves lunch from noon」は cafeteria を、「away on business next week」は next week を繰り返しただけで、開店の予定に答えていない。

questions.question: Which days will the woman probably work from home?
choices: Mondays and Fridays
Wednesdays and Thursdays
Thursdays and Fridays
Mondays and Thursdays
questions.explanation: 金曜は「our team meetings are moving to Fridays, and she wants everyone there in person」で外れ、水曜は「Wednesday is the only day the building's gym is free for staff」で出社したい日。木曜は「Thursdays would be perfect」。月曜は顧客との電話会議のために一度は外れかけたが、上司の新しいメッセージ「The client wants to hold the calls online, so we can join from anywhere」で問題がなくなり、男性も「that Monday-and-Thursday plan works after all」と言っている。月曜と金曜は最初の予定で、金曜が使えなくなった。
